title: High-Ticket Account Manager | US Clients - $1,500–$2,000 Base + Bonuses
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Certification is performance-based, usually reviewed after 30-60 days, and requires consistent performance, quality-control review, and leadership approval



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Respond to client messages within 24 weekday hours

- Close loops and avoid dangling threads

- Handle difficult conversations calmly and professionally

- De-escalate frustrated or emotional clients

- Identify refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and satisfaction risks early

- Escalate issues quickly according to SOPs

- Keep clear notes in Airtable / CRM

- Coordinate internally when support or escalation is needed

- Support renewals, referrals, testimonials, and upsell opportunities when appropriate

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility



CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- Account Management

- Coaching

- High-ticket programs

- Online education

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

- AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, or Submagic

- Working with U.S. clients



WE’RE THE RIGHT FIT IF



You’ll likely thrive here if you:



- Enjoy client-facing communication

- Stay calm when clients are emotional, frustrated, or confused

- Take ownership without needing to be micromanaged

- Follow through consistently and stay organized

- Want a long-term role with growth potential

- Can balance empathy with accountability

- Are comfortable working with U.S.-based clients



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here:



IMPORTANT: Put “CSM” + Your Full Name in the Name field.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: Philippine Attorney – U.S. Legal Support (Remote)
description:
Philippine Attorney - U.S. Legal Support (Part-Time)



Company: The Brown Law Firm

Location: Remote - Philippines

Position: Part-Time Independent Contractor

Compensation: $9-$15 USD per hour, depending on experience

Hours: Approximately 10-20 hours per week. Some overlap with U.S. Central Time business hours is required for meetings and client communication. Remaining work may be completed asynchronously.





ABOUT THE ROLE



The Brown Law Firm is a growing Texas-based law practice seeking an experienced Philippine legal professional to join our team.



Our practice includes consumer and business bankruptcy, debt settlement, contract review, and related legal matters.



We are looking for someone with exceptional legal writing, research, analytical, and client communication skills.



This is not a basic virtual assistant or administrative position.



You will work directly with our attorney and legal support staff to prepare legal documents, conduct research, communicate with clients, and help move matters forward.



We need someone who can take an assignment, understand the objective, identify missing information, and produce accurate, polished work for attorney review.





YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



LEGAL DRAFTING AND RESEARCH



- Draft motions, pleadings, responses, proposed orders, contracts, settlement agreements, demand letters, and legal correspondence.

- Conduct legal research and prepare concise summaries for attorney review.

- Verify legal citations, facts, and supporting documentation.

- Identify inconsistencies, procedural issues, and missing information.

- Revise documents based on attorney feedback.



CLIENT COMMUNICATION AND CASE MANAGEMENT



- Communicate directly with clients by phone,
, and video conference.

- Gather information, request documents, and clarify case details.

- Provide case updates and relay attorney-approved information and instructions.

- Track deadlines, manage assigned tasks, and maintain accurate case notes.

- Escalate questions requiring legal advice or attorney judgment.



BANKRUPTCY SUPPORT



- Assist with consumer and business bankruptcy matters, including Chapters 7 and 13.

- Prepare draft petitions, schedules, statements, motions, and related documents.

- Review financial records, creditor information, and supporting documentation.

- Research bankruptcy statutes, procedural requirements, local rules, and applicable case law.

- Monitor court dockets and identify deadlines and deficiencies.



CONTRACT REVIEW AND DEBT SETTLEMENT



- Review contracts and identify relevant provisions and potential issues for attorney consideration.

- Prepare contract summaries, revisions, and redlined documents.

- Draft settlement proposals, agreements, and correspondence.

- Communicate with creditors within attorney-approved parameters.

- Track offers, deadlines, and settlement documentation.





REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



- Law degree from a recognized Philippine law school.

- At least 2 years of substantial legal drafting or litigation-support experience.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong legal research and analytical abilities.

- Demonstrated experience preparing complex legal documents.

- Professional and confident client communication skills.

- Exceptional attention to detail.

- Proficiency in Microsoft Word, PDF software, and online legal research.

- Ability to work independently, manage deadlines, and collaborate remotely.

- Reliable computer, internet connection, and private workspace.





STRONGLY PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



- Admission to the Philippine Bar.

- Previous experience supporting a U.S. law firm.

- Familiarity with U.S. bankruptcy, contract law, debt settlement, or civil litigation.

- Experience drafting motions, agreements, and court documents.

- Familiarity with PACER, CM/ECF, and legal case management software.





WHAT WE VALUE



We are looking for someone who takes ownership of their work.



You should be able to produce complete, organized drafts rather than documents requiring extensive rewriting.



You should recognize missing information, ask thoughtful questions, communicate proactively, and take pride in producing accurate work.



We value accountability, initiative, professionalism, and a willingness to learn.





IMPORTANT: SCOPE OF THE POSITION



This is a supervised legal-support role with a U.S. law firm.



You will communicate directly with clients and third parties, conduct legal research, draft documents, and coordinate matters under the direction of our U.S.-licensed attorney.



You will not independently practice law in the United States, provide independent U.S. legal advice, establish attorney-client relationships, or represent clients before U.S. courts.



The supervising attorney retains responsibility for legal advice, strategy, substantive decisions, and approval of legal work.





HOW TO APPLY



Please apply through OnlineJobs.ph and provide the following:



- Your resume or CV.

- Your Philippine law degree and Bar admission status.

- A brief description of your legal drafting experience, including the types of documents you have prepared.

- Details of any experience working with U.S. law firms.

- Your expected hourly rate in USD and availability during U.S. Central Time business hours.



Please also answer these three questions:



QUESTION 1:

What types of legal documents have you personally drafted from initial instructions rather than simply editing an existing template?



QUESTION 2:

Describe a situation where you discovered an error, missing information, or legal issue while preparing a document. How did you handle it?



QUESTION 3:

A client asks you for a recommendation about their legal options, but the supervising attorney has not yet reviewed the matter. How would you respond?



Include the word PRECISION in the subject line of your application.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a compensated drafting assessment using a hypothetical case, followed by an interview.



We look forward to hearing from qualified candidates.

title: Client Relationship Manager | No Graveyard Shift - $1,500–$2,000 Base + Bonuses
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Certification is performance-based, usually reviewed after 30-60 days, and requires consistent performance, quality-control review, and leadership approval



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Respond to client messages within 24 weekday hours

- Close loops and avoid dangling threads

- Handle difficult conversations calmly and professionally

- De-escalate frustrated or emotional clients

- Identify refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and satisfaction risks early

- Escalate issues quickly according to SOPs

- Keep clear notes in Airtable / CRM

- Coordinate internally when support or escalation is needed

- Support renewals, referrals, testimonials, and upsell opportunities when appropriate

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility



CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- Account Management

- Coaching

- High-ticket programs

- Online education

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

- AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, or Submagic

- Working with U.S. clients



WE’RE THE RIGHT FIT IF



You’ll likely thrive here if you:



- Enjoy client-facing communication

- Stay calm when clients are emotional, frustrated, or confused

- Take ownership without needing to be micromanaged

- Follow through consistently and stay organized

- Want a long-term role with growth potential

- Can balance empathy with accountability

- Are comfortable working with U.S.-based clients



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here:



IMPORTANT: Put “CSM” + Your Full Name in the Name field.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

We are a growing restoration and mitigation company based in Staten Island, New York, helping homeowners, property owners, and businesses navigate property damage involving water, fire, storm, mold, and other covered losses.



We are seeking a highly motivated, detail-oriented, and experienced Virtual Assistant / Mitigation Estimator to join our team. This is a hands-on role combining virtual administrative and customer service responsibilities with mitigation estimating.



The ideal candidate is organized, analytical, proactive, and comfortable communicating with clients, contractors, insurance professionals, and other parties involved in property damage claims.



Prior hands-on experience writing mitigation/restoration estimates is REQUIRED and is not negotiable. Candidates must be able to demonstrate actual experience preparing mitigation estimates for insurance claims.



Key Responsibilities



**Mitigation Estimating**



* Prepare detailed mitigation estimates for water, fire, mold, and other property damage losses

* Write estimates accurately based on scope of work, mitigation procedures, and industry standards

* Review photos, moisture documentation, drying logs, equipment usage, and other claim documentation to develop accurate estimates

* Accurately document labor, equipment, materials, demolition, cleaning, drying, monitoring, and other mitigation-related work

* Review estimates for accuracy, completeness, and consistency

* Make revisions and supplements when additional damage or work is identified

* Communicate with project managers, technicians, contractors, insurance carriers, and adjusters regarding estimate scope and pricing

* Identify missing documentation or information needed to support an estimate

* Maintain organized estimate and claim files



**Virtual Assistant / Administrative Responsibilities**



* Answer and make phone calls to public adjusters, clients, insurance carriers, contractors, and other parties involved in claims

* Follow up on claim status updates and outstanding documentation

* Maintain accurate records and notes within our systems

* Organize claim files, estimates, reports, photos, invoices, and correspondence

* Track deadlines and ensure timely completion of tasks

* Analyze claim information and identify missing items or inconsistencies

* Assist with scheduling, customer communication, and general administrative tasks

* Perform other operational and administrative duties as needed



### Required Skills & Qualifications



* **Demonstrated hands-on experience writing mitigation/restoration estimates — REQUIRED**

* Experience preparing estimates for water, fire, mold, storm, or other property damage claims

* Strong understanding of mitigation and restoration processes

* Strong knowledge of estimating procedures and documentation requirements

* Excellent verbal and written English communication skills

* Strong phone skills and confidence speaking with clients and professionals

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

* Exceptional attention to detail

* Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple claims and tasks simultaneously

* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

* Ability to accurately interpret photos, reports, work documentation, and claim information

* Reliable internet connection and quiet work environment



### Preferred Qualifications



* Experience working for a U.S. restoration or mitigation company

* Experience writing estimates using **Xactimate**

* Xactimate certification or formal estimating training

* Experience working with insurance carriers, adjusters, or public adjusters

* Familiarity with U.S. property insurance claims and restoration documentation

* Experience with CRMs, project management software, claim management systems, or restoration software

* Experience preparing supplements and responding to estimate questions or revisions



### What We're Looking For



We value **CHARACTER as much as skill.** The ideal candidate:



* Has a strong work ethic and takes pride in producing accurate, high-quality work

* Has genuine hands-on estimating experience and can demonstrate their ability to write mitigation estimates

* Takes ownership and responsibility for assigned tasks

* Is dependable, accountable, and follows through on commitments

* Is committed to maintaining consistent attendance and being available during scheduled work hours

* Is punctual, reliable, and respects team schedules and deadlines

* Communicates proactively regarding any scheduling conflicts or unexpected absences

* Is proactive and looks for solutions rather than waiting for instructions

* Is willing to learn and continuously improve

* Communicates clearly and professionally

* Can work independently while knowing when to ask questions or escalate an issue

* Understands that accuracy and attention to detail are critical when preparing insurance estimates



**Please note: Estimating experience is a mandatory requirement for this position.** Applicants who do not have actual experience preparing mitigation/restoration estimates for property damage claims will not be considered.



**Reliability and attendance are also critical to this role.** We are seeking someone who can consistently adhere to their assigned schedule and be fully engaged during working hours. Frequent tardiness, unexcused absences, or recurring schedule issues are not compatible with this position.



### Position Details



* Remote / Work-from-home

* Competitive compensation based on experience

* Opportunity for growth and increased responsibilities

* Work with a U.S.-based restoration and mitigation company

* Primarily supporting operations in **Staten Island, New York**

Raspberry Pi/Linux SBC, camera/audio integration, PCB design and IoT product-development experience are strong advantages.

title: Design QA + Operations Specialist
description:
We’re looking for a highly detail-oriented Design QA + Operations Specialist to be the final quality check before work reaches our clients. We are a purpose-driven design studio that supports nonprofits who make the world better.



Your job is simple:



Nothing leaves QA with an error that a checklist could have caught.



You’ll review every design round, catch errors, verify client feedback was addressed, and make sure files are technically ready for print or digital delivery.



This is not primarily a design role. You should be comfortable in InDesign, but your superpower is accuracy and attention to detail.



What you'll own



70% — Quality Assurance



* Proof every round before it reaches our clients.

* Check copy against the approved document: names, numbers, titles, captions, credits, etc.

* Verify long lists name-by-name.

* Check print specs: page count, pagination, spreads, bleed, margins, image resolution, color, fonts, packaging, etc.

* Check digital specs: dimensions, links, alt text, file naming, exports, etc.

* Review every feedback comment and confirm it has been addressed.

* Make sure collateral is delivered in the correct sizes from Round 1.

* Send anything that fails QA back to the designer.



30% — Design Operations



* Keep files, versions, assets, and final packaging organized.

* Maintain the designer QA checklist and SOPs.

* Prepare files for Tuesday critique and capture takeaways.

* Track recurring errors and help improve our processes.



How we'll measure success



* Zero preventable QA errors reach the client.

* 100% of rounds have a completed QA sheet.

* 100% of feedback comments are closed or answered.

* Print files pass production specs before handoff.



You’re a good fit if…



* You've proofed or produced real multi-page printed publications.

* You understand spreads, pagination, bleed, trim, and multiples of 4.

* You're fluent enough in InDesign to inspect, fix, package, and export files.

* You're EXTREMELY detail-oriented and call yourself Type-A.

* You communicate clearly and concisely.

* You aren't afraid to send work back when something isn't right.

* You flag problems early instead of saying, “Looks good.”

* You are reliable and committed

* You have experience with tools like ClickUp, Slack, Google Workspace, and Design Markup tools





Please apply with:



* A short intro (video is a bonus!)

* Your InDesign/print production experience

* Your availability

title: Financial Operations Manager / Controller (Commercial Accounting / Full-Cycle / Xero / CPA Preferred)
description:
Job Description



Company: Priority Haulage Limited

Job Title: Financial Operations Manager

Job Type: Part-Time

Job Hours: Starting at ~15 hours per week, plus additional hours during the monthly close process (typically 15-20 hours in the first 2-weeks of each month).

Job Location: Remote

Reports to: Financial Controller

Start Date: August



About Priority Haulage



Priority Haulage is a reputable and reliable heavy machinery and equipment transport business based in Auckland, New Zealand. We specialise in the safe and efficient transportation of a wide range of civil machinery and heavy access equipment. 



Our company motto, “Your Assets, Our Priority”, reflects our commitment to the secure and dependable movement of our clients’ valuable machinery. We take pride in delivering a high level of client satisfaction through trusted service and operational excellence.



Job Summary



Priority Haulage is seeking a part-time, reliable and capable Financial Operations Manager to oversee day-to-day finance operations and support the monthly close process within a lean, systems-focused environment. 



Our finance function is built around well-documented processes, automation, and modern business systems. Routine bookkeeping and operational finance activities are supported by integrated and automated workflows, enabling the successful candidate to focus on financial accuracy, month-end reporting, continuous improvement, and optimising finance processes as the business grows.



Role Overview 



The primary responsibility of this role is the preparation and ownership of Priority Haulage's monthly management accounts and financial close process. Day-to-day financial operations support this objective by ensuring accurate, timely financial information is maintained throughout the month.



This role suits someone who is organised, dependable, systems-minded, and comfortable working autonomously within a structured operational environment. They will be confident using modern business systems and technology to optimise workflows and maintain strong financial controls.



Availability & Working Hours

This role requires consistent daily coverage during New Zealand morning business hours, with a structured morning schedule and flexible, outcome-focused afternoon support. Philippine Time (PHT) is typically 4 hours behind NZT (5 hours during NZ daylight saving).



Core Daily Hours (NZT)

9:30 AM – 12:00 PM NZT (5:30 AM – 8:00 AM PHT)

These hours are required each business day and cover core financial operations, daily processing, reconciliations, payroll coordination (Monday only), and communication with the New Zealand team.



The operational finance workload during this period is expected to be manageable within these core hours under normal operating conditions.



Month-End & Management Accounts Cycle

Additional hours are required during the monthly close process.



This includes:



• Close preparation during the final 1–2 business days of the month; and

• Completion of the monthly management accounts package within 8 working days following month-end.



During this period, responsibilities include:



• Reconciliations

• Working papers

• Management accounts preparation

• Review updates

• Close-related coordination



This workload is expected to average approximately 15–20 hours per month depending on the cycle and business activity.



Flexible Support & Process Improvement

Outside core operational and month-end responsibilities, additional flexible hours may be available to support:



• Finance process improvements

• Reporting and documentation enhancements

• Workflow optimisation

• Additional reconciliation and operational finance support as required



These hours will be agreed based on operational priorities.



Job Responsibilities



Reporting & Compliance

• Prepare monthly management accounts, reconciliations, and reporting using Xero and CCH Workpapers, ensuring accuracy and timely month-end close. 

• Support GST preparation and adherence to New Zealand accounting standards. 

• Maintain financial data integrity, documentation standards, and contribute to ongoing reporting improvements.



Bookkeeping & Financial Operations

• Perform day-to-day bookkeeping activities in Xero.

• Manage the general ledger and maintain the chart of accounts.

• Complete all required financial reconciliations accurately and on time.



Payroll Administration

• Review approved driver timesheets.

• Process weekly payroll, submit payments, and manage IRD filings.

• Ensure payroll accuracy and compliance with New Zealand standards.



Client Management

• Issue client statements and prepare, manage, and communicate job quotations.

• Resolve client account, billing, and payment enquiries.

• Support accounts receivable and debt collection activities via the Client Services Coordinator.



Supplier Management

• Manage supplier accounts, payments, reconciliations, and resolve queries.

• Coordinate subcontractor bills and ensure accurate reconciliation.

• Oversee recurring subscriptions, licensing, registrations, and compliance costs.



Operational Support & Continuous Improvement

• Drive process improvements, system optimisation, and efficiency opportunities.

• Collaborate cross-functionally to support timely, high-quality workflows

• Partner with leadership to ensure accurate and reliable financial data while contributing to automation initiatives.



Required Experience & Capability



Applicants should demonstrate proven experience operating in a structured, deadline-driven finance environment.

• Minimum 7+ years’ hands-on accounting experience.

• Advanced proficiency in Xero is essential.

• Strong Microsoft Excel capability, with proven ability to reconcile and analyse data using XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, pivot tables, and financial modelling functions.

• Proven experience preparing monthly management accounts, conducting financial analysis, and supporting budgeting and forecasting activities.

• Working knowledge of New Zealand tax regulations, accounting standards, and statutory compliance requirements.

• Demonstrated ability to operate independently in a remote environment, with strong self-management, reliability, and a consistent track record of meeting deadlines without oversight.

• Strong ability to collaborate cross-functionally, supporting finance-related workflows across the business.

• High level of technical proficiency, including the Microsoft platform, with working familiarity in modern business tools.



Preferred Experience 



• CPA qualification required, preferably a Regular Member of PICPA, with a recognised tertiary qualification in accounting.

• Experience within New Zealand or Australian Chartered Accounting firms, including use of CCH Workpapers.

• Exposure to a commercial business environment, ideally within transport, logistics, or fleet-based operations.

• Experience using Notion, ChatGPT, workflow automation tools, and modern business systems to improve finance operations, documentation, and process efficiency.

• A relevant tertiary qualification in finance, business administration, or a related field.



Personal Attributes



• Highly organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities reliably.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, able to operate autonomously while contributing effectively in a remote team environment.

• Analytical and problem-solving capability, particularly in identifying, investigating, and resolving financial discrepancies.

• Proactive and improvement-oriented, with the ability to adapt, optimise workflows, and navigate operational change.

• Professional, client-focused mindset, demonstrating integrity, quality standards, and accountability in delivery.



Required Equipment and Setup



• Dedicated Workspace: Quiet, distraction-free home office suitable for video calls and focused work.

• Computer & Internet: Desktop PC or laptop with minimum Intel Core i5 processor, 8GB RAM (16GB preferred), Windows 10/11 compatibility, and a stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 10 Mbps upload/download).

• Monitor Setup: Dual monitors, or a laptop paired with an external monitor.

• Headset: Noise-cancelling headset for clear communication during virtual meetings where operating outside a fully quiet workspace.

• Webcam: High-quality external or integrated camera for video calls.

• Power Backup: Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) or generator ensuring at least 3 hours of operational uptime during outages.

• Internet Backup: Secondary internet connection (e.g., mobile data or alternative wireless) for uninterrupted connectivity.



Application Requirement

In your application submission, include the word “Motivated!” in the title.

title: Executive Assistant - Remote
description:
Company Overview



The Compliance Services Organization didn't exist. We built it.



MedPro Disposal is the nation's largest privately-held medical waste company, serving 35,000+ healthcare providers across 48 states for the past 15 years. On that foundation, we launched MP1 Solutions to pioneer the Compliance Services Organization (CSO) — a new category of operating partner built to replace the fragmented vendor model that has defined healthcare compliance for decades. MP1 Solutions extends MedPro Disposal's operational infrastructure, vendor network, and customer trust into a category we're actively building — and leading — with a technology-forward approach that's making this model smarter, faster, and more scalable as we grow.



What we do: We operate as the single compliance partner for non-acute healthcare facilities — consolidating every obligation into one coordinated program, assigning one dedicated account manager as the point of accountability, and actively managing the underlying vendor ecosystem through continuous evaluation, negotiation, and optimization on the practice's behalf.



Why it matters: Regulated facilities across the country are managing compliance the same fragmented way they always have. We're changing that, backed by 15 years of MedPro Disposal's operational credibility — and we're looking for people who want to help build what comes next.



Our technology: We're actively building the AI infrastructure that sits behind this model — automating compliance tracking, surfacing risks before they become problems, and creating a system that gets smarter with every client we add. If you want to build at the intersection of compliance and technology, you're in the right place.



Our impact: Our clients never have to worry about something falling through the cracks — obligations are coordinated, tracked, and documented in one place. We audit costs, eliminate overcharges, and deliver proof of compliance that always keeps practices inspection ready. Every client has one dedicated account manager who owns their program end to end. And unlike a traditional vendor relationship, our model is designed to get better over time — continuously re-evaluated, optimized, and improved with every client we serve.



Position Overview:

We are seeking a highly proactive and experienced Executive Assistant to support executive leadership across multiple business entities. This role sits within our Executive Division under Executive Operations, directly supporting senior leadership in driving day-to-day effectiveness and execution.



This is a high-impact, fully remote role requiring someone who can operate independently, manage competing priorities, and communicate effectively in an asynchronous environment. The ideal candidate brings 7–10+ years of experience, strong organizational discipline, and the ability to engage confidently with executives — both verbally and in writing.



Beyond task execution, we're looking for an impact-driven professional who can point to how they've made leadership roles easier and more efficient — improving workflows, streamlining communication, and supporting company priorities and direction.



Key Responsibilities:

Executive Support & Impact



• Manage and optimize executive calendars, priorities, and scheduling across multiple stakeholders

• Proactively identify ways to save time, reduce friction, and improve executive productivity

• Track deliverables, follow-ups, and key priorities to ensure consistent execution

• Demonstrate ownership in making leadership workflows more efficient and scalable



Communication & Coordination



• Draft, edit, and manage executive-level communications 
s, updates, reports, presentations)

• Serve as a liaison across teams, ensuring clear, timely, and effective communication

• Support executives in both synchronous and asynchronous environments

• Ensure alignment across stakeholders, priorities, and deadlines



Operations & Organization



• Prepare and organize reports, dashboards, and executive-level materials

• Maintain structured systems for tracking tasks, projects, and key initiatives

• Manage competing priorities with a high level of organization and attention to detail

• Anticipate needs, identify gaps, and proactively solve problems



Technology, AI & Tools



• Leverage AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude) to streamline workflows, documentation, and communication

• Utilize Asana (or similar tools) for task tracking, project management, and accountability

title: Senior Local SEO & AI Search Manager
description:
We are not looking for someone who needs an SEO task list.



We are looking for the person who creates the task list.



Leap Windows & Doors is a family-owned replacement window and door company serving homeowners In North Carolina. Our owner has almost 30 years in the industry. We hold a 4.9 star Google rating and we are A+ rated and accredited by the Better Business Bureau. We operate from two offices and plan 1 to 2 new locations in the next 6 months.



We are bringing SEO in-house and want one experienced Local SEO professional to take ownership of our organic search growth.



You will own:

Local SEO

Both Google Business Profiles + new locations

Google Maps visibility

Website SEO

Technical SEO

On-page optimization

Location and service-page growth

Content map, content calendar, and AI-assisted drafts written to our brand knowledge base and approved before publishing

Internal linking

Citation management

Parasite SEO strategy and execution

Link strategy and local authority building

Digital PR opportunities

Competitor research

GA4, Search Console, call tracking, and CRM attribution reporting

AI-search, AEO, and GEO visibility, where we already get real leads from ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, and Perplexity

SEO launch planning for new physical locations



You will make normal website changes yourself. Our site runs on a proprietary CMS, not WordPress, and we do not have an in-house developer, so template-level competence matters. This CMS uses a simple to use editor for quick changes and the CMS support staff is available for larger page builds and technical updates. Long term, we will be moving off of this CMS and you will be involved in that migration. 



We already have:

A real operating company with a physical HQ in Burlington, NC and a second office in Greensboro

Over 2,000 North Carolina homeowners served

Strong reviews

An established website with existing search visibility

Existing paid, direct mail, radio, and local events marketing

A written brand knowledge base for you to inherit

A budget for approved tools and outside resources



This role is about growing qualified leads measured in our CRM, not creating reports that only show activity.



We want someone who:

Has 4 to 7+ years of real, hands-on SEO experience

Has personally produced measurable Local SEO results for US service businesses

Understands Google Business Profile beyond posting updates

Can explain why one company outranks another

Understands technical, on-page, local, and off-page SEO

Can work confidently inside a proprietary CMS (WordPress experience is a fine proxy)

Can build and improve normal website pages

Writes and validates schema by hand

Uses Search Console and GA4 at an advanced level

Understands local rank-grid tracking

Has built citations and quality links without chasing junk volume

Understands how SEO, Local SEO, and AI search fit together as one system

Uses AI heavily where it improves the work, and checks important output instead of accepting it blindly

Writes natural US English a homeowner would read without noticing it was written offshore

Notices problems without being told to look, and tells us early when something is wrong

Follows a brand rulebook exactly, and pushes back with data when a rule seems wrong

Can turn data into a clear action plan

Works independently and takes deadlines seriously

Keeps learning as search changes



Home-services SEO experience is a major plus. Multi-location, digital PR, advanced off-site SEO, third-party publishing, social-search strategy, or CRM attribution experience is also a plus.



AI use matters:



We do not care whether you prefer ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or another strong AI system. We do care how you use it.

We are looking for someone who uses AI to improve work such as:



Keyword clustering and intent classification

Search Console analysis

Competitor research and content-gap analysis

Content briefs and first drafts against a written knowledge base

Internal-link analysis

Schema drafting and checking

Technical research

Large spreadsheet and data analysis

Reporting

Simple scripts and automations

Repeatable workflows



Using AI only to write blog posts is not enough for this role. You should know what data the model is using, what must be checked, what cannot be trusted without outside proof, and when AI is creating noise instead of useful work.



How we work:



You will have a weekly meeting with the marketing director and maintain a simple SEO scorecard.



Each week we expect you to tell us what changed, what you completed, what you learned, what needs attention, and what you are doing next.



We judge results measured in our CRM, not activity reports and not platform-reported numbers. We would rather hear a flat month explained accurately than a good-looking report we cannot trust.



We have strict, written rules about how certain facts about our company are worded. You will get the knowledge base. You will follow it exactly. You will never invent a statistic or a claim to fill a page.



You will have a budget for approved SEO tools, citations, memberships, PR, and link opportunities.



You are being hired for your judgment, not just your labor.



Schedule:



We need 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern business hours every working day, agreed in writing and sustained. We do not need you awake all night. If a full US day shift is not realistic for you long term, tell us what is. We would rather agree on a schedule you can keep for years than one that collapses in month three.



Equipment and connection:



Reliable high-speed internet with a backup connection or backup power, and a computer that can run crawls and screen-share without lag. You will be asked to show a speed test.



Compensation:



$1,400 to $1,700 USD per month depending on experience and verified results. Strong candidates may be considered above the listed range.



Also included:



13th month pay

Paid time off

Company-paid SEO tools and memberships

A 6-month performance review with a defined raise path

Long-term, full-time position with one employer



Shortlisted candidates complete a paid practical test before the final interview. Every finalist who completes it in good faith is paid.



How to Apply:



Do not send only a generic resume. Generic applications are deleted.



Use this subject line exactly: SEO - [Your Name] - Frog



Answer these seven questions. Short, specific answers beat long general ones. Links, screenshots, and proof are welcome.



1. Local SEO proof



Give us your two strongest Local SEO results. For each, include: business type, market, website URL if you are allowed to share it, what you personally did, starting situation, measurable result, and how you verified the result.



2. Google Business Profile proof



Give us one example where you materially improved Google Maps or GBP visibility. Tell us the problem, what you changed, what happened, and how you measured it.



3. AI use



Tell us how you currently use AI in your SEO work. Give us three specific workflows you actually use today. For each: which AI tool you use, what you give it, what it produces, and what you still check or do manually.



4. AI judgment



Give us one example of a time AI gave you an SEO recommendation, analysis, or output that was wrong or weak. How did you catch it? What did you do instead?



5. Independent thinking



Imagine you start Monday and nobody gives you an SEO task list. You have access to our website, both Google Business Profiles, Search Console, GA4, rank tracking, and SEO tools. What would you want to understand first before d
 what to work on?



6. Brand rules



While writing a page under a strict brand rulebook, you find a claim you cannot verify. What do you do? Two or three sentences.



7. Logistics



Desired monthly compensation, normal working hours, US Eastern Time availability, and whether you currently work for any other clients or employers.



We care much more about clear thinking and proven results than certifications. Applicants who follow these instructions exactly are reviewed first.

title: Production & Supplier Relations Virtual Assistant
description:
About Us



The Jade Jewelers is a growing U.S.-based jewelry company specializing in authentic jade jewelry and custom-designed pieces. We work closely with overseas manufacturers and wholesalers to develop new products, manage inventory, and bring unique jewelry designs to market.



We are looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to work directly with our management team and serve as our primary point of contact with our Chinese wholesalers and manufacturers.



This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable communicating with international suppliers, negotiating prices, tracking production orders, and keeping accurate records. You will play an important role in ensuring that our products are manufactured correctly, delivered on schedule, and purchased at competitive prices.



Key Responsibilities



1. Supplier Communication & Coordination



Communicate directly with our Chinese wholesalers and manufacturers on our behalf.



Request quotations, discuss product specifications, confirm order quantities, and obtain production timelines.



Follow up regularly with suppliers to ensure production stays on schedule.



Relay important updates, questions, and issues to management.



Maintain professional relationships with existing suppliers and assist with sourcing new manufacturers when needed.



2. Production Tracking & Documentation



Maintain an organized Google Sheets production tracker that management can access and review at any time.



Your responsibilities include tracking:



Product names, images, specifications, and quantities ordered.



Supplier names, quoted prices, negotiated prices, and total order costs.



Order placement dates, estimated completion dates, and shipping dates.



Production status, including pending approval, sampling, in production, completed, and shipped.



Tracking numbers and shipping updates.



Outstanding payments, production delays, and quality-control concerns.



All production records must be kept accurate and updated regularly. You will also be responsible for organizing product photos, quotations, invoices, and relevant supplier conversations in Google Drive.



3. Price Negotiation & Cost Management



Request pricing from suppliers for new and existing products.



Report all initial quotations to management before committing to an order.



Negotiate with suppliers to secure our target prices when instructed.



Compare quotations from different manufacturers when necessary.



Look for opportunities to reduce manufacturing costs without compromising product quality.



Obtain management approval before confirming prices, payments, or production orders.



4. Production Follow-Ups & Quality Control



Follow up with manufacturers throughout the production process.



Request production photos and videos to verify progress and specifications.



Ensure that product details, materials, quantities, and design requirements match approved orders.



Immediately communicate production mistakes, unexpected price increases, or delays.



Help resolve supplier-related issues under management's direction.



5. Daily Reporting



Provide management with a concise daily report covering production progress, supplier communications, outstanding quotations, negotiation results, upcoming deadlines, and issues requiring attention.



You are expected to be proactive. We do not want to constantly ask for updates or follow up on missing information.



Qualifications

Required



Excellent written and spoken English.



Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.



Experience using Google Sheets, Google Drive, and other Google Workspace tools.



Comfortable communicating with Chinese wholesalers and manufacturers through WeChat,
, and other messaging platforms.



Ability to negotiate professionally and follow specific pricing instructions.



Comfortable working independently and managing multiple production orders simultaneously.



Reliable internet connection and a computer suitable for remote work.



Availability to work the required overnight schedule.



Preferred



Previous experience in purchasing, procurement, supplier relations, manufacturing coordination, or e-commerce.



Experience working with Chinese manufacturers, especially through WeChat or Alibaba.



Mandarin Chinese proficiency is a strong advantage but not required.



Experience in jewelry, fashion accessories, or other customized manufactured products.



Familiarity with international shipping, freight forwarders, and production lead times.



We value someone who is resourceful, communicates clearly, catches mistakes early, and takes ownership of their work.



Compensation & Working Hours



Monthly compensation: $500 USD.



Payment schedule: $250 on the 1st and $250 on the 15th of each month.



Working hours: 8:00 PM–4:00 AM Pacific Time, Monday through Friday.



Employment: Full-time, remote.



The schedule is designed to overlap with our manufacturers' working hours in China. Applicants must be comfortable consistently working overnight in the Philippines.



How to Apply



Please submit your application through OnlineJobs.ph with the following information:



Your resume and a brief introduction about yourself.



Your experience working with Chinese suppliers, manufacturers, or wholesalers, if any.



Your proficiency with Google Sheets and production or order tracking.



Your experience negotiating prices or handling supplier communications.



Whether you speak or write Mandarin Chinese.



Confirmation that you can work the required schedule and accept the advertised compensation.



To help us identify applicants who pay attention to detail, please include the phrase "JADE PRODUCTION" at the beginning of your application.



Shortlisted applicants may be asked to complete a small, paid practical assessment involving production tracking and supplier communication.

title: Inbound Sales & Client Care Specialist
description:
Inbound Sales & Client Care Specialist – Home Services



NW Cleaning Crew is a small and growing residential cleaning company based in Washington State, USA.



We’re looking for an experienced phone-first Client Care & Inbound Sales Specialist who can be one of the first voices our potential clients hear.



This is not primarily an admin role.



Your main responsibility will be responding to incoming leads, having warm and natural conversations, helping clients understand the right service for their needs, following up, and confidently asking for the booking.



We’ll teach you NW Cleaning Crew, our services, systems, scripts, and standards.



You should already know how to:

• Speak clearly and confidently with U.S.-based clients

• Build rapport naturally over the phone

• Listen and ask good questions

• Handle objections professionally

• Follow a sales process without sounding robotic

• Ask for the booking

• Follow up consistently

• Think on your feet while knowing when to verify instead of guessing



This is not an entry-level phone role. We are looking for someone who already has experience in customer service, inbound sales, appointment setting, phone sales, or closing.



Because we are still growing, this is not a nonstop call-center environment. There will be quieter periods. During that time, you’ll help with light client care and admin, follow-up, call review, learning our services, and continued sales practice.



This role works during U.S. Pacific Time business hours, so you must be comfortable working a schedule aligned with Washington State.



WHAT WE LOVE ABOUT OUR COMPANY



We’re small enough that your work really matters.



We value kindness, ownership, communication, growth, and people who want to get better.



You won’t just be answering phones. You’ll be helping shape how clients experience NW Cleaning Crew and helping us grow.



TO APPLY



Please send a short 2–3 minute video answering all three questions below.



Applications without a video will not be considered.



Please start your video by saying the word "RESET."  Then:



1. Tell me briefly about your experience with inbound calls, customer service, sales, appointment setting, or closing.



2. What is something you’ve done professionally that you’re genuinely proud of, and why?



3. Mini phone scenario:



Pretend I’m a new client calling NW Cleaning Crew and I say:



“Hi, I’m looking to get my house cleaned and I’m just trying to get an idea of pricing.”



Respond exactly how you would if you were answering that call.



Please speak naturally and do not read from notes.



I’m listening for clear spoken English, warmth, confidence, natural conversation, listening skills, and how comfortably you guide a potential client through a phone call.



If this sounds like a role you’d be excited to grow into, I’d love to hear from you.

title: Unreal Engine Game Developer
description:
*** READ BEFORE APPLYING*** 

* Send your Resume.

* Send a work sample that you will be willing to walk us through should you get an interview. Personal projects count too!

* Send your portfolio.

* Read the job description. 

If you have questions before submitting this, feel free to reach out and ask! 



Who We Are:

At Happy Little Games, games are art. We are an independent studio built by gamers, for gamers, making the kinds of games we would want to play ourselves. We care about creating games that are fun, memorable, and worth the time players spend with them. Every project is a chance to build something distinct that we are genuinely proud of.



Why Work Here:

If you love games and enjoy building things, this is a place where you can do both in a flexible, supportive environment. We are fully remote, you can set your own schedule, and we do not believe in crunch. We care about the quality of your work and whether you get things done, not how many hours you sit at a desk.



You also get to work closely with a small team and d
 how you want to grow. You can deepen your expertise in the work you already enjoy, explore other areas of game development, or grow into a different role over time. Being good at one thing does not mean you have to do only that thing forever.



Role Overview

* Build and prototype gameplay features in Unreal Engine using Blueprints.

* Work on gameplay systems, basic AI, physics, interactions, and related gameplay functionality.

* Create focused test environments that clearly show how a feature works.

* Test and debug your own work before submitting it for review.

* Keep implementation focused on the requested scope and avoid unnecessary files, systems, or dependencies.

* Document what you build, how it works, and how it should be tested.

* Manage assigned user stories, communicate progress, and raise questions, blockers, or risks early.

* Learn and follow the studio’s technical standards, workflows, and development practices.





What You Need to Bring:

You do not need to know every Unreal Engine system before joining us, but you should already be able to work productively without constant step-by-step instruction. You should already be able to:



* Work comfortably within Unreal Engine.

* Build functional gameplay features using Blueprints.

* Build simple gameplay systems and basic AI behavior.

* Apply basic software-development principles, including logic, data flow, organization, and debugging.

* Test and debug your own work before submitting it for review.

* Test both the expected behavior and a basic control case where the feature should not activate or behave the same way.

* Research unfamiliar but well-documented problems and make reasonable progress independently.

* Manage your own time and keep assigned work moving toward completion.

* Keep your work focused on the requested scope.

* Ask useful questions when requirements or technical direction are unclear.

* Communicate progress, blockers, and risks early.

* Create and maintain basic documentation for your work.

* Keep project files and implementation reasonably clean and organized.

* Explain how your work functions and why you made important implementation decisions.

* Remain professional, dependable, and honest about what you do and do not know.



What You Can Learn Here:

You are not required to already know every tool, framework, or production practice used by the studio. You can learn or further develop the following after joining:



* Git and the studio’s source-control workflow.

* Notion and the studio’s user-story workflow.

* Agile and Scrum practices.

* The Gameplay Ability System and how it is used within our projects.

* The studio’s architecture, naming conventions, and technical standards.

* Formal system-design and diagramming practices.

* Stronger documentation practices.

* Multiplayer replication.

* Basic C++ as your responsibilities grow.

* More advanced gameplay, AI, animation, physics, and Unreal Engine systems.



You should be willing to research these areas, learn from available documentation and examples, and apply feedback to future work.



Compensation:

Your final hourly rate will be based on your experience, demonstrated skills, technical ability, communication, and level of independence. We will determine the appropriate rate through the interview and trial process.



Work Progression:

New developers begin with a trial project so we can evaluate how they work, communicate, and deliver against a real set of requirements. Developers who complete the trial successfully may continue with project-based work. From there, strong and consistent contributors may move into hourly work as availability and studio needs allow.

As the company grows, hourly developers may also have the opportunity to move into a full-time role if both sides are interested.



How to Apply:

Please apply through OnlineJobs.ph whenever possible and include your resume, portfolio, and any relevant Unreal Engine work samples.

Your editing software

Pay

Your availability in Eastern Time

This is a production role. We need a LOT of videos every week: new ads, new hooks, new avatars, new languages, and many variations of winning ads. If you like doing one polished video per day, this is not for you. If you are fast, organized and can produce all day without losing quality, keep reading.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Produce video ads from start to finish, every day: brief/script → AI generation → editing → final export

- Create UGC-style videos with AI: AI actors/avatars, talking-head videos, product b-roll, lifestyle scenes (tools like Arcads, HeyGen, Veo, Kling, Runway, ElevenLabs — we pay for the subscriptions)

- Generate AI voiceovers in several languages (we give you the scripts and translations)

- Edit in CapCut (or Premiere): strong hooks in the first 3 seconds, cuts every 2–4 sec, captions, sound design, pattern interrupts

- Mass-produce variations of winning ads: new hooks, new intros, new avatars, different lengths, different languages

- Export in 9:16, 4:5 and 1:1, named and organized so the media buyers can launch immediately

- Occasionally create static image ads with AI + Canva/Photoshop



REQUIREMENTS

- Proven experience creating AI videos for ads (this is a must, not a plus). You must show us AI-generated videos YOU made

- 2+ years editing paid social / UGC ads for ecommerce or dropshipping brands

- CapCut Pro (Premiere/After Effects a plus)

- You understand direct response: hooks, retention, why an ad converts

- Speed and organization: you can work with templates, batches and clear naming to produce a high number of ads per week

- Good written English

- Strong PC and reliable internet

- At least 4 hours overlap with 9am–6pm Dubai time (GMT+4)



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with image AI (Midjourney, Nano Banana, Flux)

- Experience with VSLs and long-form ads

- Basic motion graphics



WHAT WE OFFER

- Full-time, long-term position (40h/week), paid monthly via Wise or PayPal

- $1,000–$1,500/month depending on experience, raises based on output and ad performance

- All AI tools and software paid by us

- Constant feedback with real ad data: you will see which ads win and why

- Growing team with more brands coming



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your application with the word "HOOK" so I know you read this

2. Send links to 3 AI-generated video ads you created (say exactly which tools you used and what you did)

3. Send links to 2 ads you edited (not necessarily AI)

4. Tell me how many finished ads you can produce per week working full time, and be honest — we will test it

5. Tell me your CapCut/Premiere level, your availability and your expected monthly salary

6. Shortlisted candidates will do a PAID test: several AI UGC ads from one brief in 48h

title: YouTube Niche Researcher (Remote, Full-Time)
description:
You already fall down YouTube rabbit holes. We'll pay you to do it on purpose.



We're a remote-first YouTube media company running a portfolio of faceless channels, and we're hiring a YouTube Niche Researcher! The person who finds the next niche before everyone else does.



Your job is to answer one question, over and over, with evidence: what should we make next, and why will it work? You'll hunt for outlier videos, the ones pulling 10x their channel's normal views and figure out why they popped, and hand our team a short, clear recommendation they can film this month.



We are not asking for a degree or a certain number of years. We're asking whether you can look at a video with 4 million views on a 20,000-subscriber channel and tell us what actually happened. If you can do that, we want to read your application — whether you learned it at a job, on your own channel, or from three years of watching YouTube more closely than your friends think is normal.



How we work, so nobody's time gets wasted:



🌏 100% remote / work from home — anywhere in the Philippines

📅 We do need flexible availability across all 7 days. Our channels publish every day, so research can't stop on Friday. The workload is steady and you set your own rhythm — but if you need a strict Monday-to-Friday week, this particular role isn't the right fit, and we'd rather say that up front than waste your application.

📈 Long-term role with room to grow. Researchers here move into content strategy and channel management.



What You'll Do



Niche discovery - the core of the job



Hunt for untapped and under-served YouTube niches worth building a channel in, and make the case with numbers: search demand, competition level, view velocity, monetisation potential

Find outlier videos — the ones massively out-performing their channel's average — across the niches we watch, and log them with the metrics that prove it

Answer why: was it the thumbnail, the title, the hook, the topic, a trend, or luck? Your read d
 what we make next.

Track faceless content formats — compilations, top-10s, documentary narration, AI-assisted formats, explainers, reaction-free commentary — and flag which ones are rising and which are saturated



Competitor & trend monitoring



Keep a daily eye on a watchlist of competitor channels; surface what's new, what's working, and what they just stopped doing

Spot trends early — a format, a topic, a title pattern — while there's still room to enter

Maintain a living swipe file of high-performing titles, thumbnails, hooks and formats, organised so the team can actually use it



Research output the team can act on



Build a weekly research brief: what you found, the evidence, and your recommendation — short, clear, no fluff

Do keyword and search-demand research (YouTube search, Google Trends, VidIQ / TubeBuddy or similar) to find topics with real demand and beatable competition

Estimate the money side at a basic level: which niches carry higher RPM, which audiences advertisers pay more to reach

Keep clean, organised research in Google Sheets so nothing you find gets lost



What You Need (this list is honest — read it before you count yourself out)



You watch YouTube analytically. You notice why a video worked. This is the actual requirement.

No degree required. No minimum years required. Self-taught counts. Your own channel counts. A spreadsheet you keep for fun counts.

Basic Google Sheets — you can build a clean, sorted, readable list. Formulas beyond that, we'll teach you.

Good written English. Your briefs need to be understood at a glance by a busy team.

Genuinely curious and self-directed. You'll spend hours looking for something nobody told you to look for. The best people in this role can't help doing it.

Comfortable with a flexible, 7-day rhythm and reliable about deadlines without being chased

Reliable internet, a working computer, and a quiet place to focus



Nice to have — genuinely not required



Experience with faceless, niche, or AI-assisted channels

VidIQ, TubeBuddy, Social Blade, Google Trends, or similar

Your own YouTube channel, at any size — even one that didn't work out. We'll ask what you learned.

Familiarity with CTR, average view duration, retention, RPM — or the willingness to learn what they mean this week

Any editing, thumbnail, or copywriting instinct



If you can do the mini-task at the bottom of this post, you meet the bar. Everything else on this list is a bonus.



How to Apply? Fill out the form!







We are an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and hire on curiosity, judgement and reliability alone. We're reviewing applications as they come in and want this person onboard within the next few weeks.

title: Job Title: Inbound Sales Closer & VA (GoHighLevel & Mapping Experience)
description:
We are seeking high-performing Inbound Sales Closers to handle inbound calls and web inquiries for our fast-paced Christmas light installation business. You will manage full-funnel phone sales: warmly greeting leads, pre-screening project budgets, building live custom design mockups using mapping software, and closing jobs on the first call.



Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8 AM–5 PM PST Multiple shift options may be available, with opportunities for additional coverage.



Pay: $6.00/hour base + uncapped sales performance bonuses.



Key Responsibilities:



-Lead Handling: Answer incoming phone calls and follow up immediately with newly submitted web inquiries.

-Sales & Pitching: Deliver a natural, engaging introduction to explain our full-service offering without reading off a rigid script.

-Budget Screening: Pre-screen potential clients by establishing our $700 minimum project starting price early in the call.

-Live Custom Mockups: Locate property photos via Google Maps and Zillow to generate live design mockups while on the line with the customer.

-Closing Deals: Walk clients through their customized proposals, address objections, and secure deposits on the spot.

-Pipeline Management: Maintain and update contact records and deal stages inside GoHighLevel (GHL).



Requirements & Qualifications:



-Flawless Spoken English: Native or near-native English fluency with zero to minimal accent to ensure effortless, high-trust communication with US homeowners.

-Sales Competency: Confident handling price objections, guiding conversations, and directly asking for the sale.

-US Home Familiarity: Ability to visually identify standard American home architectural features (e.g., rooflines, dormers, peaks, gutters) from photos.

-Software Proficiency: Familiarity with GoHighLevel (GHL) and navigation of Google Maps/Zillow (design/mapping tool experience is a major plus; training provided).

-Home Office Setup: High-speed internet connection, quiet dedicated environment, and a noise-canceling headset.



How to Apply (Mandatory Instructions)

To be considered for this position, please submit:



1. Your Resume

2. Weekly Availability: State your preferred working hours and available days per week (e.g., 5 days/week, weekends, M-F).

3. 1-2 Minute Audio Audition: Submit a recording (via Vocaroo or Google Drive link) performing the roleplay script below.



Note: Applications submitted without a voice recording will be automatically disqualified.



[Roleplay Audition Script]

Read the script below as the VA. We are evaluating tone, clarity, pacing, and conversational flow—do NOT read like a robot!



VA: "Thanks for calling Fresh Christmas Lights, how can we brighten up your day?"   

(Pause 2 seconds | imagine customer says: "Hi, I saw your yard sign down the street and wanted to get a quote for Christmas lights on my house.")   



VA: "Great! We’d love to help light up your house. We put lights on thousands of homes every year, so you’re in great hands! Do you mind if I share a quick outline of how our service works so we can see if we're a good fit?"   



(Pause 2 seconds | imagine customer says: "Sure, go ahead.")   



VA: "Awesome! We’re a full service Christmas light company. That means we custom fit the lights directly to your house by cutting wires and attaching custom plugs and bulbs. You won't have any messy cords hanging down—it looks extremely clean and professional.   



We also provide automated timers set to your schedule, and all high quality materials are included under our light leasing program, so you never have to buy or store the lights yourself. That means full maintenance is included free of charge—if a bulb or plug ever goes out, you just call us and we come fix it at zero extra charge.   



Then in January, we reach out, take all the lights down, and store them safely in our warehouse for next season. Plus, while we're out there, we offer discounts on our other business services like gutter cleaning! How does all that sound?"   



(Pause 2 seconds | imagine customer says: "That sounds really great.")   



VA: "Wonderful! Our custom projects start at $700 and go up from there depending on the home size and design complexity. If that's within your starting budget, I’d love to take down your address right now and pull up a live picture of your house with lights on it in just a couple of minutes!"

 and LinkedIn messages. Neither bot ever phones or joins a video call.

Write and maintain the standing orders for each bot, including explicit guard rules covering what each bot must never do, and fail any draft that breaks them.

Enrich and score one assigned prospect group from a targeting blueprint, capturing name, title, organization,
, LinkedIn, phone where available, latest public topic, a verbatim public quote, warm relationship flag, decision maker plus up to two lieutenants, and the events contact. Score zero to five against a published rubric and release only the top tier, roughly twenty organizations for the live test rather than two hundred.

Keep every contact's pipeline stage current in GoHighLevel, from first request through called, booked, interviewed, and closed states. GoHighLevel is the only source of truth. No side spreadsheet.

Wire the GoHighLevel intake form and the group-labeled calendar link so the booking, the prep fields, and the status card all agree, then test the whole flow yourself as a prospect would experience it.

Hold send discipline: daily caps per channel, staggered
 and LinkedIn to the same person, one follow-up and then stop, and an immediate channel freeze plus supervisor alert if bounces or platform warnings spike.

Queue drafts for supervisor approval before sending, log subject, body variant, channel, and result, and bring a weekly short list of which copy to keep and which to retire.

Produce the one-page pre-interview brief the same day a slot books, and send a nightly written note to the supervisor covering asks, replies, bookings, no-shows, and next actions.



Schedule and setup



Hours: 20 hours per week

Working hours: the business operates 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Pacific time. You choose which 20 hours you work inside that window, and you keep the same schedule week to week so the supervisor knows when to expect you. For applicants in the Philippines this is a night shift, roughly 11:00 PM to 8:00 AM Manila time

Setup: reliable internet and a dedicated computer for the bot workspace. The approved sending Gmail and an approved test LinkedIn profile are provided. Personal accounts are never used for outreach



Must-have skills and tools



Hands-on experience building and operating AI agents or bots: standing orders, group chats, send queues, connected
 accounts, guard rules

GoHighLevel: pipelines, stages, forms, calendars, contact records

List enrichment and prospect scoring against a written rubric

Writing instructions precise enough for a bot to obey, with a clear line between what it does and what it must not do

 and LinkedIn deliverability fundamentals: sending caps, staggering, follow-up limits, and when to freeze a channel

Ability to follow a tight build brief without redesigning the project

Escalates in writing with a proposed option the same day, not with a verbal debug dump

Strong written English



Nice to have



Direct experience inside Grok Bot workspaces

Gmail deliverability and domain warm-up experience

Experience supporting interview, podcast, or speaker booking outreach



Compensation



USD 500 per month for 20 hours per week.
