title: Short-Form Content Clipper — Pass Our Trial & Earn $1,000/Month
description:
Short-Form Content Clipper — Pass Our Trial & Earn $1,000/Month



Remote | Full-Time / Long-Term Contractor



WHO WE ARE



We a social media content company focused on short-form video, content repurposing, and performance-driven growth.



We work with high-volume social content across platforms like TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels. Our team focuses heavily on identifying the right moments, creating strong hooks, and turning long-form content into clips that can reach large audiences. We have generated over 100m+ views over the past year for our clients. 



We care about results, speed, consistency, and building systems that help great content perform.



We’re growing our clipping team and looking for people who want to become strong content operators, not just video editors.



PASS OUR 30-DAY PERFORMANCE TRIAL → UNLOCK A $1,000/MONTH LONG-TERM CONTRACT + PERFORMANCE BONUSES



We’re building a long-term content team and looking for people who are genuinely good at recognizing what people want to watch.



This is not just a video editing position.



We care about editing, but clip selection is even more important.



We need people who can watch a podcast or long-form video and identify the 30–90 seconds that have the best chance of becoming a successful TikTok, YouTube Short, Instagram Reel, or Tweet 



If you can do that consistently, there is a long-term position waiting for you.



THE OPPORTUNITY



Selected candidates begin with a 30-Day Performance Trial.



During the trial, your compensation is based on the performance of the content you create.



Any performance compensation you earn during the trial is guaranteed to be paid, even if you do not ultimately pass the trial. 



The trial is based on hitting a fixed performance target, not on hours worked.



You have up to 30 days to complete the trial, but if you hit the required target early, you can finish the trial early.



Strong performers may be able to complete the trial in significantly less than 30 days.



The exact performance target and compensation structure will be provided before the trial begins.



Trial earnings are paid biweekly.



Different campaigns may have different performance expectations and compensation structures. You will always receive the specific performance targets and compensation terms for your assignment before beginning.



PASS THE TRIAL → $1,000/MONTH



Candidates who successfully complete the 30-day trial and demonstrate strong performance will be offered a:



$1,000 USD/month long-term contractor position



with opportunities for additional performance bonuses.



The $1,000/month position is designed for people who have already proven they can consistently produce results.



Continued performance, reliability, communication, and quality are expected after promotion.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



* Review podcasts and long-form videos

* Identify highly engaging moments

* Create vertical short-form clips

* Add captions and strong opening hooks

* Edit for pacing and retention

* Prepare or upload content when assigned

* Review performance and learn from analytics

* Follow campaign-specific instructions

* Work with TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels,
 Reels, and similar platforms



WE’RE LOOKING FOR CONTENT JUDGMENT



A beautiful edit of a boring clip is still a boring clip.



We’re looking for someone who understands questions like:



Why would someone stop scrolling for this?



What makes this moment interesting without knowing the entire podcast?



Where should the clip actually begin?



Does this clip create curiosity, emotion, controversy, humor, surprise, or value?



We’ll teach you our systems, but you need to have strong instincts and be willing to learn from performance data.



WHAT YOU GET



* Training in short-form content strategy

* Real-world experience working with high-volume social content

* Premium tools/software when required for assignments

* Clear performance expectations

* Biweekly performance payouts during your trial

* $1,000/month contract opportunity after passing

* Additional performance bonuses

* Opportunities to work on higher-value campaigns

* Career advancement opportunities

* Long-term remote team environment



Strong performers may eventually move into positions such as:



Clipper → Senior Clipper → Team Lead → Content Manager



SCHEDULE



This role supports U.S.-based operations.



You must be comfortable working hours that overlap with U.S. time zones.



For applicants in the Philippines, this will likely include overnight hours.



Reliable communication during your agreed schedule is required.



OUR HIRING PROCESS



Step 1 — Portfolio Application



Show us your previous work.



Step 2 — Sample Video Challenge



If we like your portfolio, we’ll send you a sample challenge using real podcast content.



You’ll select the clip yourself. We want to see your judgment, not just your editing ability.



Step 3 — Interview



Strong samples move to a short interview.



Step 4 — 30-Day Performance Trial



Candidates who pass the interview enter our 30-day performance trial.



Your earned performance compensation during the trial is paid biweekly and is guaranteed even if you don’t pass the trial.



Step 5 — $1,000/Month Position



Prove you can consistently perform and we’ll offer you our long-term $1,000/month contractor position, plus additional performance opportunities.



IMPORTANT — READ BEFORE APPLYING



This is not a guaranteed $1,000/month position from Day 1.



Your first 30 days are a performance-based trial.



If you’re looking for guaranteed compensation regardless of content results during your first month, this probably isn’t the right role.



If you’re confident in your ability to create content people actually want to watch, this could become a very strong long-term opportunity.



HOW TO APPLY



Do not send a long cover letter.



Our initial application takes only a few minutes.



We primarily want to see your portfolio.



Apply here:







Candidates whose portfolios match what we’re looking for will receive the next step automatically.

title: Excel Operations Specialist
description:
About Self Bill Pro:

Self Bill Pro is a rapidly growing startup dedicated to solving one of the most persistent challenges in the employee benefits ecosystem: the complexity of monthly benefits billing. We provide a tech-enabled service where our dedicated team leverages proprietary software to eliminate the administrative burdens of manual invoice audits and costly billing errors. Our mission is to streamline this critical operation, freeing up employers, brokers, and carriers to focus on their strategic priorities.



About the Role:

The Excel Operations Analyst supports core billing workflows within Self Bill Pro’s Manual Data Operations (MDO) team, working primarily in Excel to manage, clean, and structure complex data.

This role is hands-on and execution-focused, requiring you to work through high-volume, often imperfect datasets to ensure accurate invoicing and reconciliation. You’ll transform raw inputs, identify inconsistencies, and produce reliable outputs that power our billing processes.



While there are established workflows, success in this role requires independent problem-solving and sound judgment when working through unclear or incomplete data.

This is not a traditional business analyst role. The ideal candidate is highly detail-oriented, strong in Excel, and comfortable balancing structured processes with practical, day-to-day data problem solving in a fast-paced environment.

Requirements



Key Responsibilities:

Work directly in Excel to manage, clean, and transform data used in billing workflows

Execute data preparation for invoicing and reconciliation across multiple clients

Identify, investigate, and resolve data discrepancies, inconsistencies, and missing information

Perform detailed data validation and quality checks prior to output delivery

Support plan setup and billing preparation activities for new and existing clients

Work through incomplete or unclear datasets, applying judgment to move work forward accurately

Maintain and update Excel files, templates, and structured datasets

Partner with internal teams to ensure accurate and timely data delivery

Identify recurring data issues and contribute to process improvements



Qualifications:

Advanced Excel proficiency, including complex formulas, lookups, data manipulation, and efficient handling of large datasets

Experience working with large, complex, or high-volume datasets

Proven ability to clean, validate, and transform data from multiple sources

High attention to detail with a focus on accuracy and auditability

Ability to identify, investigate, and resolve data discrepancies and inconsistencies

Comfortable working with incomplete or unclear data, applying judgment to move work forward

Ability to follow structured processes while also adapting when needed

Strong organizational and time management skills in a fast-paced environment

Clear written and verbal communication skills

Required shift of US ET business hours (8pm–5am PHT), with potential transition to a second shift (3pm–12am PHT) following onboarding



Preferred Qualifications:

Experience working in employee benefits, insurance, or HR-related operations

Familiarity with billing, invoicing, or reconciliation workflows

Experience working with structured data formats (e.g., CSV, XML, LDE/LDEX)

Exposure to process improvement or workflow optimization in a data-heavy environment

Advanced Excel capabilities (e.g., Power Query, dynamic arrays, VBA/scripting)



**Compensation is structured as monthly base pay inclusive of night differential, reflecting the scheduled working hours for this role. Scheduled hours are intended to align with U.S. Eastern Time. The 13th month pay is provided in addition to the stated base compensation in accordance with local requirements. **



Why Join Self Bill Pro:

At Self Bill Pro, you’ll join a collaborative and ambitious team dedicated to transforming outdated processes through smart, scalable technology. If you are a highly motivated individual with a passion for technology and a desire to make a difference in the employee benefits landscape, we encourage you to apply!

title: Vacation Rental Maintenance Coordinator
description:
MAINTENANCE COORDINATOR - Getaway and Stay



Hi there. Please read the whole posting before you apply. The application link is at the bottom.





OVERVIEW



We manage about 50 vacation rental (Airnbnb) properties across multiple US markets. We are a growing company. Our team includes 5 amazing Online Filipino Specialists. 



Right now maintenance is everybody's job, which means it is nobody's job. Five people on our team message the same contractors. Our vendors have to ask us what is still open. Things get noticed and then they sit.



We are hiring one person to own it.



This is a brand new role. You would be the first person to hold it, which means you will help build it. We have great systems and we are always improving. You will work along side our ops team, not on an island by yourself.





WHAT YOU WOULD DO



Every day, five things.



1. Intake. Read every new issue from guests, cleaners, inspectors and owners. D
 how urgent each one is. Write it up so a contractor can act on it. Look at our maintenance board. 



2. Dispatch. Send the job to the right contractor by text, with photos, the property, the access details and a date you are asking for. Confirm they took it. We have the list of contractors. 



3. Timing. Fit the repair between guests. Pull the booking calendar, pick the window, give the contractor the door code, tell the cleaner what to expect.



4. Chase. Nothing sits. No reply in 48 hours gets a second message. Five days and it moves to someone else. 



5. Close and log. Get the photo if appropriate. Match the invoice to the quote. Log the cost. Close it out. Flag anything that keeps breaking. Everything gets documented, otherwise it never happened. 



You would also run our preventive maintenance calendar. Water softener refills, HVAC filters, gutters, septic, dryer vent, etc. 



We always are thinking about how to improve the process and create systems to support the work. I do some pretty deep work in Claude and have built out some very helpful dashboards. I will expect your feedback and ideas to make the maintenance dashboard even better.



You would own the contractor side of bringing new properties onto management. Setting up pest control, landscaping, hot tub service, trash and a handyman at each new house. You are going to be working with those people for years, so you should be the one who meets them first. Once again, we have the systems in place. We have the tracking modules. We need someone to own certain aspects of the on boarding process so it is not scattered amongst the ops team. 





WHAT YOU WOULD NOT DO



You are not fixing anything yourself. You are not a plumber. You are the person who makes sure the plumber shows up, does the work, and sends the invoice.



You are not on the phone all day either. We run on text and Slack. Our contractors get a message with photos, not a phone call. To start, we have folks here who can make the first call to a new vendor and the call when something has gone wrong. You handle everything after that.





WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Critical thinking is the number one thing we are grading. More than experience. More than your resume. The application below is built to test it, and we read every answer.



We want someone who knows something about how houses work. You do not need to be a tradesperson. Maybe you helped in a family business. Maybe you fixed things at home. Maybe you are just the person who watches three videos and figures it out. If you cannot tell a water heater from a furnace and you have no interest in learning, this is not your job.



Beyond that:



You figure out how to figure it out. 



You write clearly. A contractor should be able to read your message once and know exactly what to do.

You follow through without being asked twice.

You are comfortable saying "I do not know, here is how I will find out."

You are honest about mistakes.

You can work for us and only for us. No side jobs.

You have reliable internet and a backup plan for when it goes down.





THE SHIFT



“Our” Monday through Friday, 7am to 4pm US Central time. That is roughly 8pm to 5am Manila time, shifting by an hour when the US changes clocks. This is a new role. I do not know how it will look in a year. You will be part of the conversation regarding any potential changes. 



That window covers our cleaning turnovers and ends right before guest check-ins, which is when problems show up. You would be the person who gets ahead of the problems before guests see the problems. 





TOOLS



OwnerRez, Slack, Quo, SuiteOp, Google Drive, a custom dashboard our team built, among other systems. We will train you on all of it. You do not need to know any of them today. We think about things like "Innovation.”





PAY AND THE RAISE PATH



Starting: $3.50 per hour, 40+  hours per week. We will have a clearly described path to quick raises based on specific metrics and your ability to handle the job. Our goal is about $5 per hour and we want to get you there quickly.



We also pay 13th month. We have a medical reimbursement system. We have other bonuses that we can discuss. We think about ideas like “Family first.”





WHAT THE FIRST FEW WEEKS LOOK LIKE



Week 1-3: Daily calls with various members of our team. You shadow, you learn the markets, you learn who fixes what and where. We show you our systems. You learn the various systems.



Week 4: You write every contractor message, we approve and send them.



Week 5: You start dispatching routine work on your own. You also start writing down how to do the things you learn.



Week 6: Routine work in all markets. First new property setup. Formal performance review.





WHY WORK HERE



We are a small team and we are going to be around for a long time. Several of our Online Filipino Specialists have been with us for several years. Our Filipino ops team is currently a group of 5. This role will allow them to provide an even better, more hospitable guest experience. They will also be able to focus on other business development related tasks like SEO, better bookkeeping, tracking other KPI’s, etc. 



We are also honest with you about what we are. We move fast, we expect you to think, and we would rather you make a call and get it wrong than wait for permission on everything. Autonomy is the point of this job. We discuss ideas like “Fix the process, not the person” and “Extreme accountability.” I want to empower you to do your job and not question yourself. We have a lot of support, whether its a team member or in our database to support the decisions. 



When the Google Form asks for a “number,” the number is 1776.



We will ask for a brief intro video. “Tell us about something you fixed or figured out on your own. Unlisted YouTube or Loom, please.”







HOW TO APPLY



Fill out the application form here:







It is mostly open-ended questions and short scenarios, and there are no trick answers. We want to see how you think. I am confident we have a great business to work with. If you are a great fit, we are a great business and a great team.



Do not send a resume by
 instead. Applications that skip the form do not get read.



One more thing. The form asks you to look up a “level” before you start. Do it. This is separate from the “number" mentioned above.



Thanks for reading all the way down. We are looking forward to meeting you.



Tom Ackley

Getaway and Stay LLC

title: SEO Specialist
description:
About GlowMD



GlowMD Aesthetics & Wellness Institute is a physician-led aesthetics and wellness practice in Katy, Texas.



We provide personalized aesthetic, skin, medical weight management, and wellness services. We are looking for an experienced SEO Specialist with strong Squarespace experience to help more potential patients discover GlowMD through Google and turn organic website traffic into inquiries and bookings.



This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys improving rankings, researching opportunities, optimizing websites, and implementing those improvements directly within Squarespace.



Your Main Goal



Help GlowMD increase its organic visibility and qualified local traffic, with the ultimate goal of generating more patient inquiries and booked services.



We are not looking for traffic just to increase a number on a report. We want the right people finding GlowMD when they are searching for the services we provide.



What You'll Work On

SEO Strategy



• Develop and implement an ongoing SEO strategy

• Conduct keyword and search-intent research

• Identify high-value local search opportunities

• Research competitors and identify ranking opportunities

• Monitor keyword rankings and organic performance

• Recommend new pages or content opportunities based on search demand



Local SEO



GlowMD serves patients in Katy, Texas and surrounding communities, so local SEO will be an important part of this role.



You will help:



• Improve visibility for relevant local searches

• Optimize our Google Business Profile

• Strengthen location signals across our website

• Research local keywords and competitors

• Improve consistency of business information online

• Identify citation and directory opportunities

• Recommend strategies to improve local search visibility



Squarespace Website Management & SEO



Strong Squarespace experience is required for this position.



This is not a role where you will only provide recommendations. You should be comfortable going into our Squarespace website and implementing approved SEO and website updates yourself.



You will be expected to:



• Update and optimize existing Squarespace pages

• Create and edit service pages and landing pages when needed

• Update page titles, SEO titles, and meta descriptions

• Improve headings and page structure

• Optimize URLs and page slugs

• Add and improve internal links

• Upload and optimize website images, file names, and alt text

• Update website copy and calls-to-action

• Add and optimize blog posts

• Improve navigation and booking pathways

• Make mobile-friendly page adjustments

• Implement local SEO improvements throughout the website

• Add or manage redirects when necessary

• Identify and correct basic Squarespace SEO issues

• Make approved website changes without requiring a developer for routine updates



You should understand both SEO strategy and how to execute that strategy within Squarespace.



Website SEO



You will regularly review and optimize pages for:



• Page titles and meta descriptions

• Headings and page structure

• Keywords and search intent

• Internal linking

• Image optimization

• URLs

• Service-page content

• Local relevance

• Calls-to-action

• Technical SEO issues



You should also be comfortable identifying issues that may be preventing pages from ranking or converting and implementing solutions within Squarespace whenever possible.



Content & Blog SEO



GlowMD regularly publishes educational content about aesthetics, skin health, wellness, medical weight management, and treatments.



You will help determine:



• What topics we should target

• Which keywords have the best opportunities

• How existing blogs can be improved

• How blogs should link to our service pages

• Which content gaps exist

• How content can support both rankings and patient inquiries



You will work alongside our content and social media team rather than being responsible for producing all marketing content yourself.



You may also be responsible for uploading, formatting, and optimizing approved content within Squarespace.



SEO Audits & Technical SEO



You should be comfortable reviewing the website for issues such as:



• Indexing problems

• Broken links

• Duplicate content

• Page speed

• Mobile usability

• Core technical SEO issues

• Sitemap and crawlability

• Schema opportunities

• Search Console errors



You do not need to be a web developer, but you should understand Squarespace well enough to know what can be corrected directly within the platform, what may require custom code, and when outside technical assistance may be necessary.



Traffic to Bookings



Ranking is important, but it is not the final goal.



We also want you to look at what happens once someone reaches our website.



You may recommend and implement improvements to:



• Service pages

• Calls-to-action

• Booking pathways

• Page structure

• Website messaging

• Internal links

• Mobile experience

• Conversion opportunities



The goal is to create a stronger journey from:



Google Search → GlowMD Website → Inquiry → Booking



Who We're Looking For



You may be a good fit if you have:



• Proven SEO experience

• Strong hands-on Squarespace experience

• Experience editing and managing Squarespace websites

• Experience with local SEO

• Strong keyword research skills

• Experience with Google Search Console and Google Analytics

• Understanding of on-page and technical SEO

• Experience improving organic website traffic

• Understanding of SEO content strategy

• Experience with competitor analysis

• Understanding of conversion optimization

• Ability to implement SEO recommendations directly on a website

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Good written English

• Clear communication

• Ability to work independently and meet deadlines



Experience with healthcare, medical spas, aesthetics, wellness, beauty, or other local service businesses is a plus, but not required.



Please do not apply if you have SEO experience but are not comfortable independently updating and optimizing a Squarespace website.



What Success Looks Like



Your key performance indicators will include:



• Increased organic website traffic

• Improved rankings for relevant local keywords

• Increased Google search visibility

• Growth in qualified organic leads

• Increased inquiries originating from organic search

• Improved organic lead-to-booking conversion

• Improved performance of key service pages

• Consistent progress in local SEO visibility

• Timely implementation of approved Squarespace website improvements



We understand that SEO takes time. We are looking for steady, measurable improvement rather than unrealistic promises of overnight rankings.



Compensation



Base Pay: $7/hour



How to Apply



Please submit your application through OnlineJobs.ph only and include:



• A short introduction about yourself

• Your SEO experience

• Your local SEO experience

• Your experience working specifically with Squarespace

• Examples of Squarespace websites you have managed or optimized

• Examples of other websites you have worked on

• Examples of measurable SEO results

• Case studies, screenshots, or reports if available

• SEO tools you regularly use

• A short explanation of how you would approach SEO for a medical spa serving Katy, Texas



Please also briefly explain what types of SEO and website updates you are personally comfortable implementing inside Squarespace without developer assistance.



Want to Stand Out?



This is optional, but applicants who would like to demonstrate their skills may provide a short SEO audit of:







We are not asking for a full unpaid SEO project.



Please provide approximately 5–10 bullet points covering:



• Key SEO issues you notice

• Keyword opportunities

• Local SEO opportunities

• Content opportunities

• Squarespace or website improvements you would recommend

• Any website conversion opportunities you notice

• Your top priorities for the first 30 days



We are more interested in how you think and prioritize than in receiving a lengthy audit.



Who Will Thrive in This Role



We are looking for someone who is knowledgeable but also willing to learn, test, implement, and improve.



You should be comfortable working independently, communicating your recommendations clearly, looking at data, identifying opportunities, and making approved website changes directly in Squarespace.



We don't expect you to promise #1 rankings.



We want someone who can build a strong SEO foundation, consistently improve GlowMD's organic visibility, maintain and optimize our Squarespace website, and help connect more potential patients with our services.



Only applications submitted through OnlineJobs.ph will be considered. Thank you!

Experience with business phone systems such as Avaya, NEC, or Mitel.

Experience supporting multiple locations or working in a healthcare environment.

CompTIA Network+, CCNA, or similar networking certification.

Why This Job Matters



Our customers are nursing homes and assisted living facilities, where reliable communication is critical. When a phone cannot reach a nurse station or a facility loses connectivity, it can become more than just a technical inconvenience.



We take these issues seriously. Our goal is to stay on the problem, communicate with the customer, and follow through until the site is fully working again.

title: Project Accountant
description:
The Role



The Project Accountant will report to the VP, Accounting & Financial Reporting and be the primary liaison between Accounting and the Finance, Development, Construction, and Operations teams.



This is a high-visibility role for someone who wants to take ownership of their projects and help improve how the work gets done. The Project Accountant will gain broad exposure across the business and have a real hand in shaping process improvements.



Key Responsibilities



• Own project-level accounting for assigned projects — reviewing and validating invoice coding and project allocation, partnering with Accounts Payable on invoice and payment support, and coordinating the project financing (draw) package as the accounting point of contact.



• Collaborate with Accounts Payable, Finance, Development, Construction, Operations, and Procurement to ensure accurate accounting and cost allocation across a multi-entity organization. This is a highly visible role with significant cross-functional interaction and the opportunity to influence and improve business processes.



• Prepare and own monthly and quarterly project reconciliations, continuously improving processes, controls, and supporting documentation.



• Help document and improve accounting processes and procedures to support a growing organization.



• Prepare internal and external project-level reporting.



• Support month-end close and financial audits, recommending procedural improvements to ensure accounting and reporting conform to generally accepted accounting principles.



• Perform other ad hoc duties as requested.



The company seeks individuals eager to develop their core professional knowledge, learn new areas of the business, and take on additional responsibilities within the company's dynamic team. Secondary responsibilities will be tailored to individual candidate backgrounds as well as company priorities.



Minimum Qualifications



• Degree in accounting or business administration, or equivalent business experience demonstrating an understanding of accounting practices and procedures.

• CPA preferred



• Strong computer skills with proficiency in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.



Key Attributes for Success



• Eager to take ownership, bring ideas to improve processes, and grow within a fast-moving environment.



• Attention to detail and good time management skills.



• Proficiency in Microsoft Office products such as Word, Excel, and Outlook. Familiarity with Ramp, Expensify, Corpay, and/or Sage Intacct or similar platforms is preferred.



• Experience working on multiple projects/developments simultaneously.



• Ability to adhere to monthly, quarterly, and annual department-driven deadlines.



• Strong organizational and interpersonal skills – able to work effectively in a team environment and attentive to timelines.



• Confidentiality and integrity.

title: Senior Executive Assistant/ Operations Manager
description:
**To Apply:** Please submit your updated resume here for our review.



# Senior Executive Assistant / Operations Manager



**Work Setup:** Remote

**Location:** Philippines

**Schedule:** US Business Hours

**Employment Type:** Full-Time



## About the Role



We are looking for a **Senior Executive Assistant / Operations Manager** who can become a trusted right hand to our client, a business owner managing a growing remote operation.



This is **not a traditional administrative assistant role**. We need someone who can take ownership of day-to-day operations, coordinate a remote team, communicate confidently with clients and leads, solve problems independently, and make sure important tasks and follow-ups never fall through the cracks.



The ideal candidate is an experienced professional who has worked closely with an executive, business owner, or leadership team and has been trusted with responsibilities beyond scheduling,
 management, and administrative support.



Over time, this person will take increasing ownership of the business's day-to-day operations, allowing the owner to focus more heavily on sales, business development, and growth.



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. Operations & Team Leadership



* Oversee and coordinate day-to-day operational activities across the remote team.

* Keep team members accountable for assigned responsibilities, deadlines, and follow-through.

* Delegate tasks and coordinate multiple people or functions to keep work moving.

* Identify operational issues before they become larger problems and take appropriate action.

* Make sound day-to-day judgment calls without needing constant direction.

* Create structure and improve workflows, processes, and team efficiency.

* Follow up on incomplete or delayed tasks and ensure commitments are fulfilled.

* Serve as a reliable point of contact between the business owner and the remote team.

* Gradually take ownership of additional operational responsibilities as trust is established.



### 2. Customer & Lead Follow-Through



* Ensure leads, customers, inquiries, and opportunities are properly followed up with.

* Monitor CRM activity and make sure leads do not become neglected or forgotten.

* Handle customer and client communication professionally through phone,
, and other communication channels.

* Re-engage leads and customers when appropriate.

* Identify gaps in follow-up and proactively address them.

* Ensure customer issues are tracked through resolution.

* Maintain accurate notes, records, statuses, and next steps in the CRM.



### 3. Executive Support & Business Coordination



* Work closely with the business owner to help organize priorities and keep initiatives moving.

* Anticipate needs rather than waiting to be given instructions for every task.

* Prepare information, updates, and reports needed for decision-making.

* Track projects, priorities, deadlines, and outstanding action items.

* Help translate business priorities into actionable tasks for the team.

* Take ownership of routine operational decisions and escalate matters that genuinely require executive involvement.



### 4. Social Media & Marketing Support



* Assist with social media and marketing execution when needed.

* Coordinate content, scheduling, and basic marketing-related tasks.

* Support lead-generation and customer engagement initiatives.

* Help ensure marketing activities are followed through and connected to business objectives.



### 5. Technology & Systems



* Work confidently with CRM and business management systems.

* Maintain accurate information and activity within GoHighLevel or similar CRM platforms.

* Utilize communication tools such as RingCentral or similar VoIP systems.

* Work efficiently within Google Workspace.

* Identify opportunities to improve processes through automation and technology.

* Use ChatGPT and other AI tools meaningfully to improve productivity, research, documentation, communication, and workflows.



## What We’re Looking For



The ideal candidate has **senior-level experience and demonstrated ownership**, not simply experience completing assigned administrative tasks.



### Strongly Preferred Backgrounds:



* Senior Executive Assistant / Executive Business Partner with operational ownership

* Operations Coordinator or Operations Manager who worked directly with an executive or business owner

* Senior EA with experience leading, delegating to, or coordinating remote team members

* Project Manager / Operations Manager with strong client-facing responsibilities

* Executive Operations or hands-on Chief of Staff experience

* Experienced EA who has progressively taken on business operations, team coordination, and decision-support responsibilities



### Required Qualifications:



* **3+ years of relevant experience** in senior EA, operations, project management, executive support, or a similar role

* Demonstrated experience working directly with an executive, business owner, or leadership team

* Experience coordinating or managing people, preferably remote teams

* Strong organizational and follow-through skills

* Excellent written and spoken English

* Strong customer/client communication skills

* Ability to prioritize multiple competing responsibilities

* Strong judgment and problem-solving ability

* Comfortable making routine decisions independently

* Highly proactive and able to anticipate what needs to be done

* Strong technology skills and willingness to learn new systems quickly



### Technical Skills – Strong Advantage:



* GoHighLevel

* CRM systems

* RingCentral or similar VoIP platforms

* Google Workspace

* Automation tools

* ChatGPT / AI tools

* Project management and team collaboration platforms



## This Role Is NOT a Good Fit If You:



* Have primarily performed basic administrative or data-entry tasks

* Prefer to wait for instructions before taking action

* Have little or no experience coordinating people or operations

* Are uncomfortable communicating directly with customers or clients

* Require constant supervision or approval for routine decisions

* Have experience mainly in social media without substantial operations experience

* Are looking for a junior VA or purely administrative position



## What Success Looks Like



Success in this role means becoming someone the business owner can **fully trust with the day-to-day operation of the business**.



You will be successful when you can:



* Keep the team organized, accountable, and moving forward

* Identify and solve routine operational problems independently

* Make sure leads and customers receive timely follow-up

* Keep projects and priorities from falling through the cracks

* Communicate confidently with customers, team members, and leadership

* Improve processes and introduce better ways of working

* Reduce the amount of day-to-day operational involvement required from the business owner

* Gradually take more ownership of the business so the owner can focus on sales, growth, and strategic priorities



## Priority Areas



Candidates will be evaluated primarily on:



**1. Operations & Team Leadership**

**2. Customer/Lead Follow-Through & Re-Engagement**

**3. Social Media & Marketing Execution**



If you are an experienced EA or operations professional who is ready to move beyond simply completing tasks and become a true operational partner to a growing business, we would like to hear from you.



**To Apply:** Please submit your updated resume here for our review.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Full-time Personal Executive Assistant: Personal and Business duties Overview: 



About the Role: I am looking for a professional, reliable, long-term Personal Executive Assistant who can support both the owner’s personal and business responsibilities. This role involves working directly with the owner to support his work managing multi-step tasks in multiple work areas: real estate development, photo and film studio, property management, leasing, construction, business operations, tennis sports management, family scheduling, travel logistics, and other one-time, unique tasks.  



The personal executive assistant will assist the owner in managing a constant stream of unique situations and to help extend his execution reach by keeping tasks moving forward to the point where he can make a decision. On a daily basis, you will be analyzing, anticipating, problem-solving, organizing, researching, communicating with partners and presenting, and collaborating. I value daily consistency, resourcefulness and initiative. This is not a flexible data-entry or call-center position. 



Overnight Shift:  

1. Full-time position Monday-Friday, 8:00am-5:00pm PDT (Pacific Daylight Time) California time, with 1-hour lunch starting at 12:00pm.  

2. In Philippines time (PHT), this is Tuesday through Saturday 11:00am to 9:00am (overnight shift) with a 1-hour meal break starting at 3:00am.

4. Ideal candidate will have 2+ years previous experience in comprehensive, deep support of one executive rather than supporting multiple executives in a limited capacity. 



Personal Work Activities

8. Cost management 

9. Other miscellaneous tasks. 



Business Work Activities

 inbox — summarizing, clarifying, flagging priorities

2. Excellent English — both spoken and written (you will be customer-facing and vendor facing)

4. Ability to work with autonomy (low supervision needed) and collaboratively (excellent communication skills).

 Ideal Fit You are someone who:

3. Resourcefully problem-solves to push through obstacles

Tools We Use  (Experience with several is expected)

Task/Project tracking: ClickUp 

Application Requirements (Read Carefully) 



Application must include ALL of the following items to be considered. Incomplete applications will not be reviewed.  



Written confirmation:

2. Please confirm you can work overnight shift Mon-Fri from 8am to 5pm PDT (California time). In PHT, this would be Tuesday to Saturday 11:00pm to 8:00am. 8hrs/day x 40hrs/week 

3. Please confirm you will be able to provide 1-2 professional references from executives whom you worked as their full-time Executive Assistant. 



Attachments or links:

title: Family Personal Assistant & Life Management Coordinator ( FEMALE ONLY)
description:
**Position:** Remote Personal Assistant / Family Support Coordinator



**Location:** Philippines (Remote)



**Schedule:** Part-time initially, approximately 20–25 hours per week, with potential to become full-time.



**Working Hours:** Must be available during agreed-upon Eastern Time (USA) hours.



**Compensation:** Competitive, based on experience and qualifications.



## About the Position



We are a US-based family seeking an exceptionally organized, patient, and highly articulate Personal Assistant to provide dedicated support to an adult family member living in Florida.



This is not a traditional administrative assistant position. We are looking for someone who can become a trusted, long-term point of contact and help manage the everyday details of someone's life.



Our family member needs assistance with organization, communication, shopping, finances, appointments, household responsibilities, and other daily activities.



The ideal candidate will be someone who genuinely enjoys helping people, communicates exceptionally well, and can independently take ownership of tasks from beginning to completion.



**Our goal is to find someone who can become a reliable, long-term member of our family's support system.**



---



## 1. Exceptional English Communication — C2 Required



This is our most important qualification.



We are specifically seeking someone with **CEFR C2-level English proficiency**, including exceptional spoken and written communication skills.



You must be able to:



* Speak English with near-native fluency, comparable to someone who has lived and worked in the United States.

* Communicate naturally and comfortably with Americans during everyday conversations.

* Understand American expressions, humor, conversational nuances, and informal language.

* Handle extended phone calls and conversations with patience and confidence.

* Communicate clearly with American businesses, landlords, customer service representatives, and healthcare offices.

* Write professional
s and concise reports in excellent English.



A neutral or American accent is welcome but not required. Clear pronunciation, natural conversational fluency, and excellent comprehension are essential.



**Applicants must demonstrate C2-level English proficiency through a live interview. A certificate is welcome but not required.**



---



## 2. Daily Communication & Personal Assistance



You will serve as our family member's primary contact for routine questions, requests, and everyday administrative needs.



Your responsibilities will include:



* Communicating regularly through phone calls, text messages, and WhatsApp.

* Conducting scheduled daily check-ins.

* Listening patiently and helping organize questions, concerns, and requests.

* Assisting with everyday decisions and practical problem-solving.

* Maintaining a record of outstanding requests and following up on them.

* Helping prioritize tasks and identify actionable next steps.

* Redirecting repetitive conversations toward practical solutions when appropriate.

* Maintaining a calm, supportive, professional approach during challenging conversations.



Our family member may sometimes require additional patience, reassurance, and help organizing his thoughts.



We need someone who is genuinely comfortable communicating with people who have mental health challenges, while understanding that this is a nonclinical support role.



You will have defined working hours, and urgent safety concerns will follow a separate escalation procedure.



---



## 3. Financial Organization & Budget Tracking



You will help organize and monitor everyday household finances.



Responsibilities include:



* Maintaining a monthly budget.

* Tracking rent, utilities, groceries, household purchases, and other expenses.

* Organizing receipts and payment confirmations.

* Monitoring upcoming bills and payment deadlines.

* Preparing payments for family approval.

* Tracking purchases and reimbursements.

* Helping identify unnecessary or duplicate expenses.

* Preparing simple weekly financial reports.



You will not be expected to make independent financial decisions or have unrestricted access to family bank accounts.



All significant purchases and payments require authorization.



---



## 4. Shopping, Furniture & Household Management



You will help coordinate the ongoing needs of an apartment in Ocala, Florida.



Responsibilities include:



* Searching
 Marketplace for affordable furniture.

* Communicating with sellers and negotiating prices within approved budgets.

* Comparing furniture and household products across online retailers.

* Coordinating deliveries and arranging pickups with local providers.

* Communicating with apartment management.

* Scheduling maintenance and repair requests.

* Coordinating internet, utilities, and other household services.

* Maintaining shopping lists and tracking purchases.



You should be comfortable researching products, comparing prices, and finding creative solutions to everyday problems.



---



## 5. Grocery Shopping & Daily Essentials



You will help manage recurring grocery and household purchases.



Responsibilities include:



* Creating weekly grocery lists.

* Ordering groceries through Walmart, Instacart, or similar services.

* Comparing prices and managing grocery budgets.

* Scheduling and confirming deliveries.

* Ordering household supplies and everyday necessities.

* Tracking spending and maintaining purchase records.



You will also occasionally assist with purchasing pet supplies and coordinating veterinary appointments for a dog.



---



## 6. Scheduling, Appointments & Life Organization



You will help maintain an organized daily routine.



Responsibilities include:



* Managing a shared Google Calendar.

* Scheduling appointments and sending reminders.

* Maintaining daily and weekly to-do lists.

* Coordinating transportation when needed.

* Organizing important documents.

* Following up on unfinished tasks.

* Helping complete administrative paperwork.

* Researching local services and resources.



You may also assist with scheduling healthcare appointments, researching community support services, and organizing government-benefit paperwork with appropriate authorization.



You will not provide medical advice, make treatment decisions, or function as a therapist or licensed care provider.



---



## 7. Family Communication & Daily Reporting



An essential part of your role will be reducing the amount of time family members spend coordinating everyday responsibilities.



We want someone who can solve routine problems independently rather than constantly asking for guidance.



You will be responsible for:



* Handling routine questions and administrative requests.

* Identifying which matters require family approval.

* Consolidating nonurgent questions instead of sending numerous separate messages.

* Providing one concise daily summary of completed tasks, spending, outstanding requests, and important updates.

* Communicating urgent concerns promptly according to established procedures.

* Participating in periodic family planning calls.



**Success in this role means providing excellent support while allowing the family to focus on their own work and responsibilities.**



---



## 8. Required Qualifications



We are looking for someone who meets the following requirements:



* C2-level English proficiency with exceptional conversational fluency.

* Excellent spoken and written communication skills.

* Previous experience as a Personal Assistant, Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or in a comparable support role.

* Exceptional patience, emotional maturity, and interpersonal skills.

* Strong organizational abilities and attention to detail.

* Ability to independently manage multiple ongoing responsibilities.

* Proficiency with Google Workspace, including Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Drive, Google Docs, and Google Sheets.

* Experience with WhatsApp, online shopping, and customer service communication.

* Reliable high-speed internet and a professional remote work environment.

* Ability to work during agreed-upon US Eastern Time hours.

* Strong confidentiality standards and respect for personal boundaries.



### Preferred Qualifications



* Experience supporting US-based clients or families.

* Experience with household management, personal budgeting, or administrative coordination.

* Experience communicating with individuals who need additional support or patience.

* Familiarity with US businesses, services, and everyday American culture.

* Previous long-term employment supporting an individual or family.



---



## 9. What We Will Provide



We will provide the tools and information necessary for you to succeed, including:



* Dedicated work
 and US business phone number.

* Access to approved communication platforms.

* Shared calendar and task management systems.

* Household budgets and financial tracking templates.

* Clear written instructions and spending approval procedures.

* Relevant family and service-provider contact information.

* A defined schedule and clear escalation procedures.

* Training and ongoing support.



We are seeking a long-term working relationship with opportunities for increased responsibilities and hours as the role develops.



---



## 10. How to Apply



**Please read these instructions carefully. Applications that do not follow the instructions may not be considered.**



To apply, please submit the following:



**1. Your background**



Tell us about your previous experience as a Personal Assistant, Executive Assistant, or Virtual Assistant. Include your experience working with American clients.



**2. English proficiency**



Describe your English proficiency and whether you have completed a CEFR C2 assessment or equivalent English qualification.



**3. Voice introduction — Required**



Provide a 60–90-second voice recording introducing yourself in English.



Please speak naturally, as though you were talking to an American client on the telephone.

title: International Marketing & Business Development Executive
description:
International Marketing & Business Development Executive



US & UK Markets | Paid Part-Time Probation → Full-Time Career Opportunity



Company: Business and Project Analysts

Location: Philippines — Remote

Positions Available: 4

Initial Probationary Period: 2–3 months, part-time (3 days per week)

Probationary Salary: US$450 per month + performance bonuses

Upon Successful Completion of Probation: US$750 per month full-time + 



performance-based commissions

Performance Earning Potential: Opportunity to earn up to an additional US$3,000 per month across our portfolio of products and services, subject to performance, applicable commission structures and sales targets.



About Business and Project Analysts

Business and Project Analysts is an international consulting and technology company providing business consulting, CRM solutions, AI-driven systems and professional business services to businesses and professional organizations in the United States and United Kingdom. 



We are expanding our international marketing and business development operations and are looking for four exceptional and ambitious Marketing graduates based in the Philippines to join our growing international team.

This is not simply another telemarketing position. We are looking for ambitious individuals who want to develop long-term international careers in Marketing, Sales and Business Development, with the opportunity to progress into supervisory and senior management positions.



Your First 2–3 Months: Paid Part-Time Probation & Development

All four successful candidates must initially be available to work part-time, 3 days per week, for approximately 2–3 months.



This will be your paid probationary, training and assessment period and is an important part of our career-development process.



During this period you will receive:

•	US$450 per month

•	Additional opportunities to earn performance bonuses

•	Structured training in our products and services

•	Practical exposure to US and UK markets

•	CRM, AI, marketing and sales training

•	Direct mentoring and professional development

•	Practical experience working on international business-development campaigns



The purpose of this period is two-way: we assess your performance, potential and suitability for long-term progression, while you have the opportunity to experience our company, products, international markets and working environment before progressing into a full-time career.



Candidates who successfully complete probation and demonstrate the required performance, attitude and potential may be offered progression into the full-time International Marketing & Business Development Executive position at US$750 per month plus applicable commissions and performance incentives.



The Opportunity

You will help us strategically market a growing portfolio of products and professional services to businesses in the United States and United Kingdom.



Our portfolio includes CRM and technology solutions, AI-enabled products, business consulting and other professional services. The existing position already covers B2B lead generation, telesales, decision-maker engagement, demonstrations and CRM management. 



Your responsibilities will include strategically marketing our CRM and technology solutions; promoting our business consulting and professional services; researching target industries, companies and prospective customers; generating and qualifying B2B leads; conducting outbound telesales and telemarketing campaigns; and communicating professionally with business owners, managers and other decision-makers in the US and UK.



You will also book product demonstrations, consultations and business meetings; follow up with prospective clients; support digital and direct-marketing campaigns; manage prospects through our CRM; use AI and technology to improve marketing effectiveness; and work toward clearly defined marketing, lead-generation and sales targets.



Who We Are Looking For

We are particularly interested in academically strong and ambitious graduates who want to combine their Marketing education with practical international business experience.



You should be commercially minded, confident communicating with people and interested in developing into a high-performing international marketing and business-development professional.



Academic Requirements

Applicants should hold a Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Marketing Management, Business Administration majoring in Marketing, Communications, Entrepreneurship, or another closely related Marketing/Business discipline. 

We are particularly interested in candidates who:



•	Graduated with honors or achieved an outstanding academic record.

•	Graduated Magna Cum Laude or Summa Cum Laude, or achieved equivalent exceptional academic performance.

•	Demonstrated academic excellence in Marketing, Business or a closely related discipline.



High-achieving graduates from leading Philippine universities are strongly encouraged to apply.



Experience

Ideally, you should have approximately 1–2 years of relevant professional experience, particularly in sales, telesales, telemarketing, business development, lead generation, B2B marketing, appointment setting, digital marketing, CRM-based sales/marketing or international customer engagement. 



You must be comfortable speaking on the telephone with prospective customers and communicating professionally with US and UK business professionals.



What We Value

We want candidates who are ambitious, career-driven and commercially minded.

You should have excellent spoken and written English, confidence speaking with business decision-makers, a professional telephone manner and the resilience to work in a performance-driven environment.



You should also be organized and disciplined when working remotely, interested in technology, CRM and artificial intelligence, willing to learn continuously and interested in developing future leadership and management skills.

Most importantly, we are looking for people interested in a long-term international career rather than simply a short-term job—an expectation already central to this position. 



Compensation & Earning Potential

Stage 1 — Paid Part-Time Probation: First 2–3 Months

3 days per week

US$450 per month + performance bonuses

This is a paid probationary, training and assessment period. You will begin learning our products, markets, systems and sales methodology while demonstrating your ability to generate results.



Stage 2 — Full-Time Career Opportunity

Candidates who successfully complete the probationary period and meet our required standards may be offered progression to:

US$750 per month guaranteed full-time starting salary + applicable commissions and performance incentives.



Performance-Based Earnings

Our business operates across multiple products and professional services. This creates opportunities for high-performing employees to earn commissions and incentives from different revenue streams.

Once applicable to your role, there is potential to earn up to an additional US$3,000 per month, subject to individual results, applicable commission structures and achievement of sales targets.

The existing advert already connects increased earnings, salary reviews and promotions to performance and business results. 



International Career Progression

We are not recruiting four people simply to fill vacancies.

We want to identify individuals who could become future leaders within the company.

A successful employee could potentially progress through:



Part-Time Probationary Executive → International Marketing & Business Development Executive → Senior Executive → Supervisor → Assistant Manager → Manager → Senior Manager

Progression is not automatic and will be based on performance, leadership capability, business results, professional development and organizational requirements.



As you progress, you may have opportunities to supervise other employees and participate in increasingly important projects supporting our US and UK operations. 



International Mentoring & Professional Development

A major benefit of this opportunity is direct professional mentoring and management.

Successful candidates will have the opportunity to be mentored and managed by an experienced international Management Consultant with extensive professional experience in the United States and United Kingdom who has led and contributed to innovative and groundbreaking international business and professional initiatives. 



The objective is not simply to teach you how to make sales calls.



We want to develop your practical expertise in:

International Marketing Business Development B2B Sales Consultative Selling CRM Artificial Intelligence Business Strategy Client Acquisition Professional Services Marketing Leadership Management

For ambitious graduates, this is an opportunity to combine international exposure, practical experience, professional mentoring, earning potential and a defined pathway toward management.



Training & Development

You will receive structured training and ongoing development in company products and professional services, international B2B marketing, US and UK target markets, CRM systems, AI-assisted marketing and sales, lead generation, prospect research, telephone sales, consultative selling, appointment booking, objection handling, professional international communication, sales pipeline management and KPI analysis. 



Your 2–3 month part-time probationary period is specifically designed to provide this training while allowing us to assess your practical performance and long-term management potential.



Working Arrangement — Please Read Before Applying

Applicants must be available to begin with a 2–3 month paid, part-time probationary period working 3 days per week.

Compensation during probation: US$450 per month + applicable performance bonuses.



Following successful completion of probation, selected candidates may be invited to progress into the full-time role at US$750 per month plus applicable commissions and performance incentives.



This is a remote, performance-driven international position. You must have a professional remote working environment, reliable internet connection and the discipline to work effectively as part of an international team.

Recruitment Process



Stage 1 — Application: Submit your CV/resume and short cover letter, together with your university, Bachelor's degree, academic classification/GPA, details of academic honors, and a brief summary of your sales, telesales, telemarketing or business-development experience. The existing application process already requests these academic and professional details. 



Your cover letter should briefly answer:

“Why do you believe you have the potential to become an outstanding international Marketing and Business Development professional?”

Please also confirm:

“I am available to work 3 days per week during the initial 2–3 month paid probationary period.”



Stage 2 — Telephone Assessment: Shortlisted candidates will be assessed on spoken English, professional communication, confidence, telephone manner and sales aptitude.



Stage 3 — Final Management Interview: Finalists will meet with management to discuss the role, probationary period, career objectives, compensation structure and performance expectations.



Ready to Build an International Career?

We are selecting four high-potential individuals.

If you are a high-achieving Marketing graduate with sales ability, ambition and the determination to build an international career, we would like to hear from you.



You will begin with a paid 2–3 month part-time probationary period, giving you an opportunity to learn, demonstrate your ability and earn performance bonuses while working only 3 days per week.



For the right candidates, this could be the beginning of a much longer journey—from Marketing & Business Development Executive to Supervisor, Assistant Manager, Manager and potentially Senior Manager.



Apply Now

Send your CV and Cover Letter to:



Position: International Marketing & Business Development Executive – US/UK Markets

Location: Philippines — Remote

Initial Arrangement: 2–3 months | Part-Time | 3 days/week

Probationary Pay: US$450/month + performance bonuses

Full-Time Opportunity After Successful Probation: US$750/month + applicable commissions and incentives



Business and Project Analysts

International Business Technology Consulting Professional Services

title: Content Strategist + Social Media Manager for Christian Woman Brand
description:
I’m looking for an exceptional Content Strategist + Social Media Manager to help build the social presence for FULLNESS, a new Christian women’s podcast and media/teaching movement launching in November.



This is not a traditional social media VA role.



I’m not looking for someone who simply takes a list of posts, creates graphics, edits the clips I select, and schedules them.



I’m looking for someone who can listen to a 30-minute podcast episode or read a Substack article that I write and recognize:



That sentence is a Reel.

That idea should become a carousel.

That tension is the hook.

That thought could become a text-led post women will send to their friends.



I also need someone with a strong creative-director instinct—someone who can originate Reel concepts and tell me exactly what needs to be filmed to bring those concepts to life based on what is working right now.



I want you to be able to come to me with: The concept. The hook. The format. The visual treatment. What I need to say. What B-roll I need to shoot.



Ideally, I can open a weekly filming brief from you, shoot what you’ve requested, upload the footage, and hand the rest back to you.



You should understand ideas, language, people, visual storytelling and social media—and know how to turn thoughtful long-form content into compelling short-form content.



ABOUT FULLNESS



FULLNESS is for Christian women who want to become fully awake and alive to God, step fully into who He created them to be, and become fully engaged in what He has given them to do.



We explore intimacy with God, identity, desire, calling, work, wealth, influence, authority, beauty, responsibility, stewardship and what it means to actually live the life of the Kingdom.



The brand is thoughtful, sophisticated, warm, elevated and spiritually substantive.



This is not generic Christian inspiration.



Aesthetically, it is not loud, overly feminine “girlboss” content or typical Canva ministry graphics.



Think: Editorial. Intelligent. Elegant. Spacious. Modern.



Because FULLNESS is an explicitly Christian brand, you need a strong understanding of Christian faith, Scripture, Christian language and theological nuance, and you must be comfortable working deeply within that worldview.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



I create: podcast episodes, long-form writing, weekly teachings,
s and other source content.



Your job is to help that thinking reach the women it is meant to serve, create connection, and grow the audience.



Content Strategy + Repurposing:

Review podcast episodes, teachings, articles and
s

Identify the strongest ideas, hooks, quotes, tensions and moments for social

Determine what should become a Reel, carousel, written post, Story or other format

Develop compelling hooks and angles

Translate long-form ideas into short-form content without making everything feel repetitive

Write strong captions and copy while learning and preserving my voice



Reels + Creative Direction:

Originate Reel concepts, not simply edit existing footage

Develop creative and visual treatments for ideas

Create clear filming briefs and shot lists for me

Tell me what B-roll should be captured each week

Identify opportunities for lifestyle, environmental, detail and narrative B-roll

Help me batch filming efficiently by giving me clear direction in advance

Edit raw footage into polished, compelling short-form videos

Understand pacing, text placement, music, storytelling and visual rhythm

Find strong clips from podcast and teaching footage without needing me to provide timestamps



Design + Social Content:

Create sophisticated, editorial carousels

Create text-led and aspirational content

Develop thought-provoking static posts

Create intentional Stories

Maintain a cohesive, elevated visual identity



Publishing + Optimization:

Schedule and publish content

Adapt core content appropriately across Instagram,
, TikTok and YouTube Shorts



Support community engagement:

Monitor analytics

Identify what is resonating and why

Recommend adjustments based on performance



Instagram will be our primary social platform, and we will also use
 and YouTube. I am considering TikTok as well.



I care much more about excellent content than massive content volume.



THE CONTENT YOU’LL HELP CREATE



Our social content will generally fall into three categories:



1. Founder-Led Content



Strong moments from my podcast, teachings and direct-to-camera content that establish connection, trust and authority.



2. Thought Leadership



Ideas, frameworks, distinctions and perspectives pulled from my long-form work and translated into compelling social content.



3. Aspirational + Recognition Content



This content puts the woman we are speaking to at the center.



It names what she is thinking, wrestling with, desiring, sensing or becoming—sometimes before she has language for it herself.



It should make her think:



“That’s exactly what I’ve been feeling.”

“I didn’t know how to put that into words.”

“This is the woman I want to become.”

“I need to send this to someone.”



This might be a text-led Reel, visual concept, carousel, single statement, thought-provoking question, contrast or aspirational piece.



It does not always need my face or voice.



YOU MAY BE A GREAT FIT IF...

You have a strong understanding of Christianity, Scripture and Christian culture

You are genuinely interested in creating content for Christian women

You are an excellent writer

You have a strong instinct for hooks and compelling ideas

You can hear an idea and immediately begin imagining how it could be communicated visually

You naturally think in concepts, not just captions and graphics

You understand B-roll, pacing and visual storytelling

You can confidently direct a founder remotely and tell her what to film

You can find the strongest moments inside long-form content without needing me to point them out

You understand what makes people stop, save, share and respond

You have experience editing polished short-form video

You can create beautiful, elevated carousels and graphics

You have excellent visual taste

You understand founder-led/personal brands

You can learn someone else’s voice instead of imposing your own

You are proactive, organized, reliable and comfortable working independently

You want to help build a brand, not simply complete tasks



Experience with podcasts, authors, speakers, coaches, thought leaders or founder-led personal brands is a MAJOR PLUS.



THIS PROBABLY ISN’T FOR YOU IF...

Your portfolio consists primarily of generic motivational graphics

You need me to give you every hook, clip, caption and post idea

You need finished footage handed to you rather than helping determine what footage should exist

Your idea of social strategy is simply posting more often

You rely heavily on generic AI-generated copy

You don’t enjoy consuming long-form content and finding the strongest ideas inside it

You can make content look attractive but struggle to determine what is actually worth saying

You are primarily looking for a task-based VA role

You do not have the skillset to edit video



INITIAL PROJECT + LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY



The FULLNESS podcast launches November 16, 2026.



I’d like the right person to begin on October 12.



The first week will focus on onboarding, learning the FULLNESS brand and my voice, reviewing our existing launch strategy, establishing workflows, and preparing the first round of content.



The formal launch campaign for the podcast begins October 19, followed by the podcast launch on November 16 and post-launch momentum through the end of November. The campaign strategy is already developed and mapped out.



This initial project will allow us to learn how we work together.



For the right person, I am very interested in this becoming a long-term role as FULLNESS grows.



I’m looking for someone who could eventually become an important part of the FULLNESS content team.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send a cover letter and samples of your work.



In your cover letter, please answer these questions:



1. FULLNESS is an explicitly Christian brand. Tell me about your familiarity with Christian faith, Scripture and Christian women’s content, and why this particular brand and audience interest you.



2. Send examples of social content you personally created that best demonstrate your writing, video editing, creative direction, carousel/design and/or content strategy abilities. Tell me specifically what you were responsible for. Please include, if you have it, at least one example of a Reel where you were responsible for the creative concept—not just the editing. Tell me what the original idea was, what you directed the client/founder to film, and what you personally created.



3. Tell me about one personal brand, podcast, thought leader, author or founder whose social content you admire. What specifically makes their content effective?



4. Imagine I give you a 30-minute podcast episode with no instructions about what to pull from it. Walk me through how you would d
 what should become a Reel, carousel, text-led post or Story.



5. What tools do you use for video editing, graphic design, scheduling and content management?



6. What is your desired hourly compensation for an ongoing role like this. We are aiming for 30 hours a week.



Finally:



What separates content that merely looks good from content that actually makes someone stop, think, share and want to hear more?



Thank you for your interest!

title: Venue Outreach VA: Email and Call Bars to Book Our Bar Crawls | $2.90/hr | 12AM-8AM PH time
description:
We run ticketed bar crawls in more than 200 cities across the US, Canada, the UK, Ireland, Europe, Australia and New Zealand. Our biggest season is Halloween (October 29 to 31). We need one self-driven VA to own venue outreach: getting bars and clubs in dozens of cities to say yes to hosting our crawls, and locking every detail, until every city is fully booked.



THIS IS A BIG PROJECT, NOT A TASK LIST



You will own a large group of cities, often 20 to 30 or more, each needing 4 venues on up to 3 nights. That means thousands of emails and hundreds of calls before a deadline that does not move. We need someone who decides each morning what matters most, finds more venues when a list runs dry, keeps going on the hard cities, and reports progress without being chased. If you need to be told what to do every hour, this is not the job for you.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Answer bars and clubs that reply to our outreach emails, the same day, in clear friendly English.

- Call venues that have not answered email, or that asked for a call. Scripts are provided.

- Confirm venues properly: nights, hours, contact name and mobile, recorded in our outreach system (a web app, we train you).

- Research new venues and contact details on Google, Google Maps and Facebook when a city is short.

- Send a short progress update at the end of each day.



PAY AND HOURS



- $2.90 USD per hour.

- 8 hours a day: 12:00 PM to 8:00 PM Toronto time, Monday to Friday. That is 12:00 AM to 8:00 AM Manila time (1:00 AM to 9:00 AM after November 1, when Toronto changes its clocks). This is a night shift for you, every shift. Please only apply if you can work it reliably.



YOU MUST HAVE



- Excellent written and spoken English, with a clear accent that American, Canadian, British and Australian bar managers understand easily on the phone.

- A good microphone: a headset with a boom mic or a USB mic, and a quiet room. Laptop mics and noisy rooms are not accepted.

- Tech skills: a laptop or desktop computer, internet of 10 Mbps or better, comfortable learning a web app, working in many browser tabs and researching online quickly.

- Initiative and follow-through on a large project.

- Availability to start right away.



HOW TO APPLY (please read)



1. Apply here.

2. Read our training page and take the test at the bottom. No account needed: https://nightspotters.com/outreach-training/

   The test includes a written reply, a short plan, a small research task and a 60-second voice recording made with your work mic.

3. If you pass, the page gives you a pass code and tells you how to reach me for a quick interview.



We listen to every recording before booking interviews. Only applicants who pass the test get an interview.
