Our clients are leaders in their industry and have built strong relationships with the customers they serve. Our job is to ensure that their brand image stays consistent online and offline and, more importantly, that their business is growing.





Summary of The Position:



The Shopify Post Purchase CRO Specialist is responsible for the strategic implementation and optimization of post-purchase upsell funnels, primarily utilizing platforms like Aftersell. This role focuses on enhancing Average Order Value (AOV) and Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV) for Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) e-commerce brands by creating highly relevant and effective post-purchase offers. The specialist will manage the full lifecycle of implementation, from strategic planning and A/B testing to performance monitoring and continuous optimization, ensuring seamless integration and alignment with brand objectives.



Responsibilities:



• Implement and manage post-purchase upsell funnels using platforms such as Aftersell, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives to increase AOV and CLTV.

• Conduct systematic A/B testing across various elements including product selection, offer and pricing structures, pricing angles, copywriting, psychological angles, user interface (UI) optimization, and customer segmentation.

• Monitor and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) such as Acceptance Rate, AOV Lift, Incremental Profit/Session, and Upsell Conversion Rate, optimizing for Revenue Per Visitor (RPV) and Profit Per Visitor (PPV).

• Ensure technical and creative requirements are met for all implementations, including fulfillment safety (e.g., 'Order on Hold' feature), mobile responsiveness, brand consistency, and effective inventory management.

• Collaborate with marketing and design teams to ensure brand consistency and compelling offer presentation.

• Identify and avoid common pitfalls such as the 'Wall of Text' error and the 'Irrelevance' trap, focusing on clear value propositions and relevant offers.

• Leverage customer data, loyalty programs, and other add-ons to enhance post-purchase strategies and maximize incremental revenue.

• Continuously refine and improve post-purchase strategies based on performance data and evolving market trends.



Our Culture:



• No one is bigger than the team

• We don’t make excuses, we take responsibility

• Innovate everywhere

• Communicate. Communicate. Communicate. We have a culture of open communication.



Required Skills:



• Proven experience in implementing and optimizing post-purchase upsell strategies, preferably with platforms like Aftersell.

• Strong understanding of e-commerce metrics and their impact on business growth (AOV, CLTV, ROAS, RPV, PPV).

• Demonstrated expertise in A/B testing methodologies and data-driven optimization.

• Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to quality assurance in all implementations.

• Knowledge of mobile UI/UX best practices for e-commerce.

• Ability to analyze performance data and translate insights into actionable strategies.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex ideas clearly.

• Experience with project management software (e.g., Clickup) is a plus.

• Proactive approach with a sense of urgency and purpose in daily tasks.



Perks:

- Flexible working hours

- Remote working

- Room to grow - we're an early stage start up with a proven track record

- Competitive compensation

- Work with some amazing brands



This Role Is Perfect for You If…



- You love working as a team.

- You are a self-starter.

- You can work under pressure

- You have exceptional communication skills

- You are results/outcome driven.

- You have a ‘can-do’ attitude. If “that’s not my job” isn’t in your vocabulary, you’ll fit in great!



This Role is NOT the Right Fit For You If You Are…

- A ‘me first’ type of person

- Not a self-starter.

- Not a ‘people person’

- Problem driven, not solution oriented. If you complain about problems/issues/bottlenecks, without proposing a solution, this is not for you.

If we have something that needs to get done, we’ll have all hands on deck. Sometimes you might have to work late but sometimes you’ll get the afternoon off, it’s not all work no play, but we’re here to help business grow!

title: Remote High-Ticket Closer | Make Up to ₱300,000 Per Month | Inbound Calls Only
description:
We book the calls. You close them. Make up to ₱300,000 per month.



Authorify is a 17-year-old US company. We help American real estate agents win more listings with professionally published books. Our ads and webinars fill your calendar with booked appointments every day. You never hunt for leads or cold call.



This is a long-term, full-time remote role. You can live anywhere in the Philippines. What matters is that you can work US Eastern business hours and prove you can close. We are hiring 3 to 4 closers.



THE ROLE



- Take 5 to 6 booked, inbound Zoom appointments a day with US real estate agents who watched our webinar and started a paid trial.

- Sell annual memberships. We have several packages at different prices. You sell the one each customer qualifies for. Most sales land between $2,000 and $3,000 USD, mostly paid in full on the call.

- Follow our proven script and process, and join the daily team role-play huddle.

- Every call is recorded and scored by AI. We use it to coach you and to make sure every customer hears the same honest offer.

- Update your deals in the CRM the same day.



THE PAY



- You earn a base pay of ₱40,000 per month, based on working full time, plus commission on every sale you close.

- Base plus commission comes to a total of ₱150,000 to ₱300,000 per month, depending on how much you sell. A solid closer on our team makes at least ₱150,000 a month. Our superstars make ₱300,000.

- Commission is paid on the cash you collect, once a month. We will walk you through the exact commission rates before you accept, so nothing surprises you later.

- We also run a monthly sales contest and a weekly prize wheel for reps who hit the KPIs we focus on that month. That money is extra.

- You are paid weekly in USD through 
 and track your time with a time tracking tool we set up for you.

- We will show you our sales team's real numbers in the interview. We do not inflate anything, to candidates or to customers.



SCHEDULE



- Full time, 40 hours a week, Monday through Friday.

- You must work US Eastern business hours. That is a night shift in Philippine time. Please only apply if that works for you every day, not just some days.



WHO GETS HIRED



- A proven closer with 2 or more years closing high-ticket sales ($1,000+ USD) by phone or Zoom to US or English-speaking customers, with numbers you can show us.

- Fluent, natural, confident English. You will talk with American small-business owners all day.

- Someone who runs the play. We role-play every day, we follow the script, and we review our calls. Lone wolves wash out here.

- A reliable remote setup: a quiet space, solid internet, and a good camera and mic.

- Honest with customers, always. You sell what we can actually deliver, and you never promise results we cannot back up. If stretching the truth is part of how you sell, this is not the team for you. If selling the honest way is already how you work, you will feel right at home.



HOW TO APPLY (read this carefully, it is the first test)



1. Read this whole post.

2. Fill out our application form. That is the only step:



3. On the form, include your closing numbers and a link to a short 1 to 2 minute video, camera on, telling us about your experience and why you are a good fit for this role. Any link anyone can view works: Loom, Google Drive, or an unlisted YouTube link.

4. No video means no interview. We watch every one. If you are a fit, we will reach out to schedule a live Zoom interview within 2 business days, and an offer decision within a week. We move at closer speed.

Work Location: Remote (Philippines)

title: Security Compliance Program Lead
description:
About the Engagement



We're pursuing SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certification concurrently, on a fixed schedule, and need someone to take the program from kickoff to a clean report/certificate — then hand off a running program to an internal owner.



Two dates anchor the engagement and do not move: the ISO 27001 certificate in March 2027 and the SOC 2 Type II report in May 2027. There's no slack before January, so month one is spent locking auditor commitments, not writing documents.



This is a hands-on individual contributor role, not a supervisory one. You'll write the policies, chase the evidence, and sit in the audit meetings yourself — working across engineering, IT, HR, legal, and field operations, none of whom report to you. The work runs on influence and follow-through, not authority.



Key Deliverables

-ISMS scope statement and SOC 2 system description — Due Nov 2026 / Jan 2027

-Risk assessment (ISO 27001 clause 6.1) + risk treatment plan — Due Dec 2026

-Approved policy set (~20 policies, Annex A structure) — Due Nov 2026

-Statement of Applicability, all 93 Annex A controls — Due Dec 2026

-Compliance platform configured and collecting evidence — Due Nov 2026

-Remediation complete and evidenced across all teams — Due Dec 2026

-Vendor risk register, third-party reports, signed DPAs — Due Dec 2026

-Penetration test commissioned; critical findings closed — Due Dec 2026

-ISMS internal audit and management review documented — Due Dec 2026

-SOC 2 Type I report issued — Due Jan 2027

-ISO 27001 certificate issued — Due Mar 2027

-SOC 2 Type II report issued, no material exceptions — Due May 2027

-Handover pack + trained internal owner — Due Jun 2027



What You'll Do

-Own the program plan, schedule, and budget; report progress to leadership monthly

-Contract and manage the CPA firm and certification body — scheduling, evidence requests, walkthroughs, findings/responses

-Define and document one scope boundary serving both frameworks

-Write the policies, Statement of Applicability, and system description

-Drive cross-team remediation (access control, logging, encryption, change management, onboarding/offboarding), holding owners to dates and escalating early

-Administer the compliance automation platform and keep evidence collection running

-Run vendor risk reviews; collect third-party reports and DPAs

-Coordinate the penetration test, internal audit, and management review

-Document the running program and train the internal owner who takes it on



Requirements



Required

-Has personally taken a SOC 2 or ISO 27001 engagement through to a clean report/certificate — as the owner, not a contributor

-3+ years in security compliance, GRC, IT audit, or closely related field

-Working knowledge of core security controls: IAM, MFA, logging & monitoring, encryption, endpoint management, change management

-Clear, plain writing — policies, system description, and audit responses are most of the output

-Able to hold people to commitments without line authority

-Available to start in October 2026, with a fixed end date



Preferred

-Has run both frameworks together, or mapped one control set across two

-Hands-on with a compliance automation platform (Vanta, Drata, Secureframe, Sprinto, or similar)

-Background in IT services, managed services, or field services (environments with subcontractors/technician access to customer systems)

-CISA, CISM, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor certification



Terms

-Structure: Open to independent contractor or fixed-term employment, whichever the candidate prefers

-Commitment: Full time; October 2026–February 2027 is the heaviest build sprint, pace eases once audits are underway

-Completion: Engagement ends when the Type II report is issued and handover is complete; an extension into the ongoing program may be offered but is not guaranteed to either party

-Milestone structure (contractors): A portion of fee may be tied to deliverables #10, #11, and #12 — terms to be agreed



How to Apply



Please submit:

-A summary of a SOC 2 or ISO 27001 engagement you personally owned end-to-end, and the outcome

-Relevant certifications (CISA, CISM, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor), if any

-Your availability for an October 2026 start

We are looking for an experienced Product Development Coordinator to support our product development team with research, sampling, costing packages, trim details, sourcing, vendor communication, logistics coordination, and production follow-up.



This is a remote independent contractor engagement. The contractor will work with the Synergy team on product development tasks, production timelines, vendor follow-ups, sample tracking, and shipment coordination. The right person is organized, self-motivated, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple moving pieces without constant supervision.



At Synergy Wetsuits, we move fast, solve problems, and care deeply about creating great products for triathletes and swimmers. We are looking for someone proactive, reliable, flexible, and comfortable jumping in where needed. Every day is a little different, which keeps things interesting.



JOB DESCRIPTION:



The Product Development Coordinator will support the product development process from concept, design, sampling, production, and release. This role will help track product development timelines, communicate with overseas vendors, follow up on samples and revisions, organize product details, and coordinate information between internal teams and external partners.



The contractor will collaborate closely with the product development team and management to understand the creative direction of each product and help move projects forward. This includes supporting seasonal product calendars, vendor communication, sample tracking, shipment coordination, costing updates, and product documentation.



Regular team overlap is needed Monday–Friday, 11:00am–5:00pm US Pacific Time / 2:00am–8:00am Manila Time.



A background check may be required as part of the contractor screening process.



MUST HAVES:



• 4+ years of project management, supply chain, logistics, product development, sporting goods, apparel, or related experience

• Experience using Asana or a similar project management platform

• Strong problem-solving skills

• Strong follow-up and follow-through

• Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines at the same time

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Ability to build and maintain professional relationships with vendors and internal teams

• Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office, especially Word, Excel, and Outlook

• Strong organization, attention to detail, and ability to improve processes

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, goals-oriented environment

• Ability to communicate professionally with vendors, tea
mbers, and management

• Availability for regular team overlap Monday–Friday, 11:00am–5:00pm US Pacific Time / 2:00am–8:00am Manila Time



NICE TO HAVES:



• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Manufacturing, Textiles, or a related field

• Experience with Adobe Creative Cloud, especially Photoshop or Illustrator

• Experience in triathlon, swimming, sporting goods, apparel, or performance products

• Personal interest in triathlon, swimming, endurance sports, or fitness



SCOPE OF SERVICES:

• Support product development from initial concept, design, sampling, production, and release

• Conduct viability research for concept products

• Communicate product updates, timelines, and issues to internal teams and overseas vendors

• Track samples, revisions, approvals, and development progress

• Coordinate with product development, design, production, planning, materials, and quality-related teams

ABOUT SYNERGY WETSUITS:



Synergy Wetsuits was founded in the early 1990s by Stefan Laursen. The brand was built around creating high-quality triathlon wetsuits, apparel, and accessories at a strong value, while staying connected to the sport and the athletes we serve.



Synergy is a tight-knit, high-performance multisport brand. We are looking for people who care about doing great work, improving processes, collaborating with the team, and helping us build one of the top triathlon brands in the world.



Our culture is entrepreneurial, fast-paced, collaborative, and practical. We work hard, solve problems, and keep moving.



INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR NOTICE:



This is a remote independent contractor engagement and does not create an employer-employee relationship. The contractor is responsible for their own taxes, government contributions, insurance, equipment, workspace, internet, and personal benefits unless otherwise agreed in writing.



HOW TO APPLY:


 the following to 



1. Responses to the questions below

Application Questions:

3. Tell us about a time you had to follow up repeatedly with vendors, suppliers, or tea
mbers to keep a project on schedule.

title: Direct Response Video Editor | Dog supplement brand
description:
Remote · Long-term · 10 to 20 hours/week to start, full time possible · up to $1,500 USD per month + performance bonus



Hi, nice to meet you! 👋



We are not looking for someone who just wants another editing gig.



We are looking for one editor who wants to get really good at making video ads that sell, and who wants to grow with us over the long term.



We are a small team building a dog supplement brand 🐶 for the US market. We move fast and test a lot. Every week we run new video ads on Meta 
 and Instagram), all in English.



We provide the ad concepts and deliver clear briefs, with references where possible. What we need is an editor who turns our ideas into finished ads we can run right away.





🎯 THIS IS NOT A NORMAL EDITING JOB



We don't need someone who just puts clips in order. When you open a new task, you should ask yourself:

- Does this hook catch the viewer in the first second?

- Is every clip good enough to run?

- Is anything cut off in Feed, Stories or Reels?

- Is the file named correctly, or will anything cause issues?

- Are there any AI errors in the footage, like a sixth finger?



Your job is not only to edit what you get. Your job is to deliver ads we can trust without checking every frame.





🎬 WHAT YOU WILL DO

You get ideas, references, the copy, sometimes B-roll clips, and a written spec. Sometimes we explain it in a short Loom video. You create content with AI. In the end, you deliver finished ads that are ready to run.



- Create stunning B-roll with AI video models

- Turn ad concepts into finished ads for
 and Instagram

- Think about hooks that CATCH the viewer

- Add subtitles and on-screen elements

- Follow the naming convention we give you





🔍 WE WANT SOMEONE WHO CARES ABOUT DETAILS

- If a clip has an AI error, like a strange face or a broken dog paw, you notice.

- If text sits where Instagram will cover it, you move it.

- If a spec is unclear, you ask before you start.

- If you think a cut would work better another way, tell us and show us.



We don't want someone who waits for us to find the mistakes.





📈 YOUR GROWTH PATH

We start with 10 to 20 hours per week. In the mid term, we can also hire you full time.



The better and more reliable your work, the sooner we move to full time, with higher pay and more responsibility.





💰 PAY = BASE + BONUS



- Monthly base: $1,000–$1,500 USD

- Performance bonus on top, paid monthly. It depends on the quality and reliability of your work and how well your edits perform.

- Payment through Payoneer (EasyPay) or Wise. We can talk about other options if you prefer another one.

- We always pay on time. No chasing invoices, no delays, no excuses. You focus on great ads, we make sure your money arrives. If you prefer, we can start with a weekly payment.



The better your ads →

the more we can scale them →

the more work and responsibility you get →

the more money you make.





🙋 WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- 3+ years of experience editing video ads. Most of ours are 10 to 45 seconds, some are longer.

- Hands-on experience with AI video models (e.g. Veo, Kling, Runway, Sora). This is a must.

- You fully understand Meta safe zones. You know what gets cut in Feed, Stories and Reels and place everything correctly without being told.

- A sharp eye for mistakes in footage, both AI-generated and real.

- Good written English.

- Reliable delivery times.



We don't require a specific editing program. Use whatever you are fast in.



⭐ Experience with D2C / supplement ads is a strong plus.





🚫 DO NOT APPLY IF…

- You miss deadlines without telling us early

- You don't know what safe zones are

- You have never created video with AI models

- You deliver files with random names

- You send ads with mistakes you haven't checked yourself

- You need us to explain every small step

- You are an agency or plan to pass the work to someone else





🛠️ HOW WE WORK

- 10 to 20 hours per week to start, full time possible in the mid term.

- Tools: Slack, Asana, Airtable, Google Drive. A clear structure is important.

- We work async. We are based in Europe (CET/CEST), no fixed hours needed.

- No agencies and no outsourcing. We want to work with you directly.





🤝 HOW WE HIRE

Application on our careers page → Small trial task → Ongoing work



The trial task will be fully paid after a successful hire.





✍️ HOW TO APPLY

We only accept applications through our careers page.

👉 



It takes about 5 minutes. Please have ready:

- Your portfolio or showreel link (2 or 3 video ads you edited for Meta, Instagram or TikTok)

- The editing and AI tools you use

- How many hours per week you can take on (10 to 20 to start)

- Optional, but a big plus: a short personal video intro (Loom or YouTube, max 2 minutes)



Please do not send your application by message,
 or chat.

Applications that don't come through the careers page will not be considered.



We look forward to seeing your work! 🚀

title: Podcast Producer & Marketer
description:
ICABA World Network seeks a producer who combines editorial judgment, dependable production management and growth marketing. The role is responsible for the complete episode lifecycle—from concept and guest preparation through publishing, content repurposing, distribution, audience development and conversion optimization.



•Establish a distinctive, high-trust podcast brand aligned with ICABA’s positioning: a global ecosystem for accomplished Black professionals and entrepreneurs to succeed, lead, and prosper.





•Convert attention into measurable action: membership inquiries and subscriptions, event registrations, community participation, sponsor leads and partner opportunities.



•Create a sponsor-ready media product with consistent programming, audience intelligence and professional reporting.



•Build a reusable content library that strengthens ICABA-TV, Black Professionals Month and other priority programs.



Recording and Production



•Produce and direct remote, studio, hybrid and live-event recordings; manage platform setup, audio routing, lighting/framing guidance and recording redundancy.



•Open each episode with a strong audience hook and structure conversations for pace, clarity, emotional resonance and retention.



•Edit audio and video to professional standards, including cleanup, color correction, leveling, music, branded graphics, captions, lower thirds and sponsor elements.



•Deliver platform-appropriate masters, thumbnails and metadata; perform final quality control before release.



•Create and maintain production templates, brand standards, file naming, archives and backup procedures.





Content Marketing and Repurposing



•Turn each full episode into a coordinated content package designed for discovery, engagement and conversion.



•Identify the strongest insights, stories and quotable moments; edit vertical and horizontal clips with captions and compelling opening text.



•Create or direct supporting assets such as audiograms, quote cards, carousels, blog/article summaries and newsletter features.



•Build an evergreen redistribution plan so high-performing episodes continue generating traffic after launch week.



Audience Growth and Conversion



•Create a clear conversion path for every episode: one primary CTA, trackable link or QR code, relevant landing page, and follow-up nurture sequence.



•Coordinate with ICABA’s web, CRM and email resources to capture source data and reduce friction from content to registration or purchase

title: VirtuaL Operations Assistant
description:
VIRTUAL OPERATIONS ASSISTANT



Role & Job Description | Report to Founder & Chief Servant Officer Support

Reports To Founder & Chief Servant Officer, ICABA World 

Position Type Virtual / Remote —Part-Time 

Location Remote (cloud-based); primary working hours aligned to U.S. Eastern Time

Classification Virtual Operations Assistant (VOA)



POSITION SUMMARY

The Virtual Operations Assistant (VOA) is a high-trust, high-capacity partner to the Founder & Chief Servant Officer of ICABA World. This role exists to absorb the recurring, detail-intensive work of running the organization's marketing, revenue generation, digital platforms, and membership operations — so the Founder can spend his time on vision, partnerships, and executive-level decisions rather than execution.

The ideal VOA is assertive and organized: comfortable managing multiple priorities at once without losing sight of what matters most, comfortable pushing deadlines forward and following up without being asked twice, and confident enough to flag risks, gaps, or conflicts directly rather than waiting to be asked. This is not a passive support role — it is a proactive one.



WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

ICABA's growth depends on the Founder's ability to delegate with confidence. The VOA's core value is measured by how much can safely move off the Founder's plate and onto theirs — with the same quality, timeliness, and attention to brand standards the Founder would apply himself. Success in this role means the Founder trusts the VOA with recurring responsibilities and no longer has to think about them.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Project & Priority Management

▪ Track all active workstreams (programs, campaigns, partnerships, events) across a shared project management system, keeping owners, deadlines, and status current.

▪ Translate the Founder's priorities into task lists, timelines, and follow-up sequences — and proactively resurface items before they become urgent.

▪ Run daily/weekly check-ins on open items, surfacing what's overdue, at risk, or waiting on someone else.

▪ Coordinate across ICABA's team and contractors to keep multi-person projects moving without the Founder having to chase status personally.



Database & CRM Management

▪ Maintain accurate, de-duplicated member and contact records in ZOHO Forms and the CRM (Zoho CRM Plus), including data entry, list segmentation, and record hygiene.

▪ Manage membership lifecycle data — applications, renewals, lapses, and upgrades — and flag trends or issues to the Founder.

▪ Build and maintain reporting views/dashboards that give the Founder a fast, accurate read on membership and pipeline health.

▪ Ensure CRM and
 platform data stay in sync so outreach lists are always current.

 Marketing & Campaign Management

▪ Build, schedule, and manage
 campaigns in ActiveCampaign — newsletters, program promotions, membership communications, and automated sequences.

▪ Maintain and refine marketing automation (welcome series, renewal reminders, event follow-ups) with minimal ongoing input from the Founder.

▪ Monitor open/click performance and report what's working, what isn't, and recommended adjustments.

▪ Proofread and quality-check every send against ICABA brand and messaging standards before it goes out.

Marketing, Social Media & Content Support

▪ Coordinate with Virtual Marketing Coordinator to ensure proper social content management across ICABA's channels, maintaining a consistent posting cadence and brand voice.

▪ Coordinate with designers/contractors (or produce directly in Canva) to keep graphics, captions, and campaign assets on-brand and on-schedule.

▪ Support promotion of ICABA programs (Black Professionals Month, Faith Works Friday, ICABA Biz Connect, the Founders Circle, the Thrivin' podcast, and others) across digital channels.

▪ Track engagement and flag opportunities or issues to the Founder rather than waiting for a debrief.

Revenue, Membership & Digital Platform Support

▪ Support membership growth and retention operations — onboarding communications, payment/renewal follow-up, and Stripe transaction monitoring.

▪ Assist with sponsorship and partnership administration: tracking commitments, deliverables, and deadlines tied to revenue agreements.

▪ Maintain ICABA's digital properties (website updates, registration pages, event platforms) or coordinate directly with the web/technical contractor.

▪ Flag revenue-related risks (failed payments, churn signals, missed deadlines) to the Founder promptly and with context, not just data.

 

Executive & Administrative Support

▪ Assist the Founder by taking on recurring, time-consuming tasks to protect time for the Founder’s executive-level priorities.

▪ Assist the Founder in managing daily operations by overseeing various internet applications, tools, and online platforms for database management, online community management, virtual meetings, merchant processing, and invoicing

▪ Prepare the Founder for meetings with concise briefs, agendas, meeting summaries, and follow-up action items for projects and ongoing operations.

▪ Make calls to executive-level individuals and businesspeople to set up or confirm meetings and/or participation in ICABA events, the ICABA online community, or for other purposes.

▪ Assist Founder with HR related tasks, operations and record-keeping

▪ Coordinate travel, event logistics, and vendor/partner communications as needed.

Technology & Digital Platform Administration

▪ Serve as a confident daily user and administrator across ICABA's cloud toolset, troubleshooting first-line issues before escalating.

▪ Keep documentation, file organization (Google Drive), and access permissions clean and current.

▪ Identify opportunities to automate or streamline recurring tasks across the toolset.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

▪ 3+ years of experience as an Operations Assistant, or Operations/Marketing Coordinator supporting a senior executive or founder.

▪ Demonstrated experience with CRM platforms (Zoho CRM or comparable) and
 marketing platforms (ActiveCampaign or comparable).

▪ Working proficiency with project management tools (e.g., Asana or comparable) and cloud productivity suites (Google Workspace and/or Microsoft 365).

▪ Experience supporting social media scheduling/management and basic design production (Canva or comparable).

▪ Comfort with membership, nonprofit, or association operations a strong plus.

▪ Excellent written communication — able to draft and proofread professional, on-brand copy independently.

 



CORE COMPETENCIES

▪ Assertive and self-directed — Comfortable making decisions, setting deadlines for others, and following up without being asked twice.

▪ Detail-oriented — Catches errors, inconsistencies, and gaps before they become the Founder's problem; treats brand and quality standards as non-negotiable.

▪ Strong multitasker with clear prioritization — Manages multiple active workstreams without losing track of what's most important; knows when to triage versus when to push forward.

▪ Excellent interpersonal skills — Builds trust quickly with members, partners, vendors, and team members on the Founder's behalf; represents ICABA professionally in every interaction.

▪ Discreet and trustworthy — Handles sensitive member, financial, and partnership information with judgment and discretion.

▪ Tech-fluent and resourceful — Learns new cloud tools quickly and troubleshoots independently before escalating.



PRIMARY TOOLS & PLATFORMS

CRM & Membership Zoho CRM Plus ICABA Community, Seamless AI

Communication WhatsApp, Ring Central

Website Management Word Press, Elementor

 Marketing & Automation ActiveCampaign

Invoicing Payments & Revenue Stripe

Data and Project Management ZOHO Forms,Asana, MS Excel

Scheduling & Calendar Calendly, Google Calendar

Design & Social Content Canva, Metricool, Buffer

Files & Collaboration Google Drive, Gmail

Meetings Zoom

Proficiency across this stack (or demonstrated ability to learn it quickly) is expected. Specific tools may evolve as ICABA's systems evolve.

title: Part-Time Executive Assistant & Project Coordinator
description:
Location: Philippines – Remote



Hours: Approximately 10 hours per week to start

Pay: $7–$8 USD/hour, depending on experience

Schedule: Monday–Friday with flexibility throughout Philippine business hours

Position: Independent Contractor



About the Role



We are looking for a highly capable, organized, and resourceful Executive Assistant & Project Coordinator to support a U.S.-based business owner with a mix of business, personal, financial, and project-related responsibilities in both the United States and the Philippines.



One of the primary responsibilities will be helping coordinate a housing development project in the Philippines. The role will also include executive support, personal administration, expense tracking, financial organization, vendor coordination, travel, and general problem-solving.



This is not a traditional Virtual Assistant role where you wait for a list of tasks and simply check them off.



We need someone who can take a request, figure out what needs to happen next, coordinate the right people, follow up consistently, organize the details, and keep things moving without constant supervision.



The position will start at approximately 10 hours per week, with the potential for additional hours as the role develops and project needs increase.



Executive & Personal Assistance



Responsibilities may include:



• Managing appointments, reminders, deadlines, and follow-ups

• Booking flights, hotels, transportation, and other travel

• Organizing itineraries and travel documents

• Researching products, vendors, services, and solutions

• Making calls and sending
s on behalf of the executive

• Coordinating property, vehicle, boat, equipment, and other repairs or maintenance

• Assisting with rental properties and housing-related matters

• Obtaining and comparing quotes

• Coordinating service providers

• Tracking renewals, subscriptions, payments, and outstanding items

• Handling personal errands that can be managed remotely

• Maintaining organized digital files and important documents

• Following up until issues are actually resolved



The goal is not simply to remind someone that something needs to happen.



The goal is to help make it happen.



Financial & Expense Organization



An important part of this role will be keeping the executive's personal and business-related financial activity organized.

This is not an accounting position, but you should be comfortable working with numbers, spreadsheets, receipts, expenses, invoices, and financial records.



Responsibilities may include:



• Tracking personal and business-related expenses

• Maintaining organized expense spreadsheets and trackers

• Collecting and organizing receipts and supporting documentation

• Categorizing expenses

• Tracking reimbursements and amounts owed

• Monitoring recurring expenses, subscriptions, and payments

• Keeping records of major purchases and project-related costs

• Matching receipts and documentation to transactions when needed

• Organizing invoices, bills, statements, and financial documents

• Flagging missing receipts, duplicate charges, unusual expenses, or items needing clarification

• Preparing clear expense summaries when requested

• Coordinating with accounting or finance personnel when additional documentation is needed



We need someone who can take a messy collection of receipts, transactions, invoices, and notes and turn it into something organized and easy to understand.



Accuracy, discretion, and confidentiality are extremely important.



Housing Project Coordination



A significant part of the role will involve supporting a housing development project in the Philippines.

You do not need to be an architect, engineer, or construction expert.

You do need to be excellent at organization, research, communication, follow-up, and keeping people accountable.



Responsibilities may include:



• Maintaining project task lists and trackers

• Following up with contractors, suppliers, vendors, and service providers

• Requesting and comparing quotes

• Tracking deadlines and outstanding decisions

• Coordinating meetings, appointments, deliveries, and site-related needs

• Organizing contracts, invoices, receipts, specifications, and project documentation

• Tracking project expenses against estimates or budgets

• Following up on materials, production, construction, and delivery timelines

• Researching Philippine suppliers and service providers

• Helping coordinate permits, utilities, government requirements, or local services when needed

• Identifying delays before they become larger problems

• Researching possible solutions before escalating an issue

• Preparing short, clear project updates



Your job is to keep the day-to-day details moving so the executive can focus on larger decisions.



What We're Looking For



We are looking for someone who is:



• Extremely organized

• Resourceful

• Independent

• Persistent with follow-ups

• Comfortable making phone calls

• Confident communicating with vendors and contractors

• Excellent in written and spoken English

• Able to communicate clearly and professionally on calls and video meetings

• Detail-oriented

• Comfortable working with numbers and financial information

• Strong with spreadsheets

• Comfortable researching unfamiliar subjects

• Good at comparing quotes, pricing, and options

• Able to juggle unrelated projects without losing track of details

• Comfortable handling highly confidential personal, business, and financial information

• Able to recognize what they can solve independently and what genuinely needs to be escalated



Strong experience with Google Workspace, spreadsheets, task-management systems, document organization, expense tracking, and financial recordkeeping is preferred.



Experience That Would Be Especially Valuable



We are particularly interested in applicants with experience in:



• Executive Assistance

• Personal Assistance

• Project Coordination

• Operations

• Expense Tracking or Administrative Finance

• Property Management

• Hospitality

• Construction Coordination

• Real Estate

• Facilities Management

• Vendor or Contractor Management



Experience supporting an executive with both personal and business financial organization is a strong plus.

Hospitality experience is also valuable because this role requires someone who can coordinate vendors, properties, maintenance issues, unexpected problems, and different personalities at the same time.

What Resourcefulness Looks Like

If you are told:

“I need someone to repair a boat. Please handle it.”

We don't want your first response to be:

“Who should I call?”

We want you to research repair companies, check reviews, contact several providers, get pricing and availability, compare the options, follow up, and come back with a clear recommendation.



The same approach applies to project work.



If a supplier tells you an important delivery will be three weeks late, don't simply forward the message.

Find out why.



Determine what will be affected.



Ask whether the timeline can be improved.



Research alternatives if appropriate.



Then provide a short summary of the issue, available options, and any decision that needs to be made.



Hours & Availability



This position will start at approximately 10 hours per week, or around 2 hours per weekday.

As the role develops and project needs increase, there may be an opportunity for additional hours.

Most work can be completed during Philippine business hours so you can communicate with local vendors, suppliers, contractors, and government offices.



You must also be available for a brief early-morning check-in with the U.S.-based executive, generally around 6:00–7:00 AM Philippine time (3pm PST).



We are looking for someone who can consistently stay on top of tasks, expenses, follow-ups, and project coordination throughout the week rather than completing all hours in one block.



Compensation



$7–$8 USD per hour, depending on experience and qualifications.

There is potential for additional hours and increased responsibility based on performance and project needs.



How to Apply



Please submit all of the following:



• Your current resume

• Your answers to the written questions below

• A link to your 1–2 minute video introduction

• Your expected hourly rate in USD



Please begin your application with the words:

“I figure things out.”



Applications that are missing the resume, written responses, or video introduction may not be considered.



Written Questions



1. Tell us about your experience supporting a business owner, founder, or executive directly.

2. Describe a project you personally helped coordinate. What were you responsible for?

3. Tell us about your experience dealing with contractors, vendors, property maintenance, construction, hospitality, or service providers.

4. Tell us about a situation where your boss gave you a problem to solve without telling you how to solve it. What did you do?

5. You are told: “I need someone to repair my boat. Please handle it.” Walk us through exactly what you would do.

6. An important supplier tells you their delivery will be three weeks late. What would you do before escalating the issue?

7. Describe any experience you have organizing an executive's or business owner's expenses, receipts, bills, reimbursements, or financial records.

8. If you were given a credit card statement, a folder of receipts, and several expenses with no documentation, how would you organize and reconcile the information?

9. What system do you use to keep track of tasks, deadlines, follow-ups, and things you are waiting for other people to complete?

10. Are you comfortable making phone calls to Philippine vendors, contractors, government offices, and service providers?

11. Are you currently working for any other clients or employers? If yes, please describe your current schedule.

12. Are you consistently available approximately 2 hours per weekday and for the early-morning check-in described above?

13. What is your expected hourly rate in USD?



Video Introduction Required



Please include a link to a 1–2 minute video introduction with your application.



This does not need to be professionally produced. A simple Loom, Google Drive, or similar video is fine.



In your video, please:



• Introduce yourself

• Briefly describe your Executive Assistant or project coordination experience

• Tell us why you believe you would be a strong fit for this role

• Share one example of a problem you were asked to solve independently



Because this position involves frequent phone calls and direct communication with executives, vendors, contractors, and service providers, clear and professional spoken English is essential.



Applications without a video introduction may not be considered.



A Little More About the Right Fit



This role is a great fit for someone who genuinely enjoys making life easier for the person they support.

You don't need to know how to solve every problem on day one. What matters is that you're curious, resourceful, organized, and willing to figure things out. You should be comfortable asking questions, doing the research, making the call, following up, and staying on something until it is actually resolved.



We're looking for someone who can become a trusted right hand over time — someone who notices what needs attention, keeps the details organized, and helps prevent small things from turning into bigger problems.



The position starts part-time, but there is room for the role to grow as trust is built and responsibilities increase.



If you enjoy solving problems, keeping things organized, and being the person others can rely on to get things done, we'd love to hear from you.



We look forward to learning more about you.

title: # Cold Calling & Sales Role-Play Coach — 1-on-1 Training
description:
I am looking for an experienced **Sales Coach / Sales Trainer / Cold Calling Trainer** to work with me one-on-one.



I am **not looking for someone to make cold calls for me**. I am looking for someone who will **personally train and coach me so I become much better at cold calling and selling.**



The right person should be comfortable actively coaching me, challenging me, correcting me, and doing realistic role-plays with me.



## What I Want to Learn



I want to become confident and effective on the phone, including:



* How to start a cold call confidently

* How to create and deliver a strong pitch

* What exactly to say and how to say it

* How to sound confident, natural, and conversational

* How to avoid sounding nervous, robotic, or overly scripted

* How to ask good questions

* How to keep the prospect engaged

* How to identify the prospect's needs

* How to transition naturally into the offer

* How to ask for the appointment or sale

* How to handle rejection

* How to handle difficult prospects

* How to overcome common objections

* How to think on my feet when the prospect says something unexpected

* How to become more comfortable and confident through repeated practice



## I Want REAL Role-Playing



This is extremely important.



I want you to actually **play the role of the prospect** while I practice calling you.



For example, you might act like a prospect who says:



> "I'm not interested."



Then I respond.



You challenge me again.



You might say:



> "Just send me an
."



Or:



> "We already have someone."



Or:



> "How much does it cost?"



Or:



> "Where did you get my number?"



Or give me another realistic objection.



I want you to **challenge me instead of making the role-play easy.**



After the role-play, I want you to explain:



* What I did well

* What I did poorly

* Where I sounded uncertain

* What I should have said instead

* How I could improve my wording

* How I could sound more confident

* Where I talked too much

* Where I should have asked a question

* Where I should have pushed back

* How I could have moved the conversation toward an appointment or sale



Then I want to **do the role-play again** and apply your corrections.



## I Want a Coach Who Will Push Me



Please don't simply tell me that everything sounds good.



I want someone who will respectfully **challenge me and point out my weaknesses**.



If my pitch is weak, tell me.



If I sound nervous, tell me.



If I'm talking too much, stop me.



If I'm asking the wrong question, explain what I should ask.



If I'm avoiding asking for the sale, challenge me to actually ask.



The goal is for me to improve through **repetition, feedback, and realistic practice.**



## Help Me Build My Pitch



I would also like help developing and improving my actual sales pitch.



You should be able to help me:



1. Understand the product/service I'm selling

2. Create a strong opening

3. Develop the pitch

4. Create good discovery questions

5. Prepare responses to common objections

6. Practice the entire conversation

7. Adjust the script so it sounds natural rather than memorized

8. Practice until I can deliver it confidently



## Experience I'm Looking For



You should have significant experience in one or more of the following:



* Cold calling

* B2B sales

* B2C sales

* Sales training

* Sales coaching

* Sales management

* SDR/BDR training

* Business development

* Appointment setting

* Closing

* Objection handling

* Phone sales

* Sales role-playing

* Sales performance coaching



**Teaching/coaching ability is very important.**



Being a good salesperson alone is not enough. You need to be able to **teach another person how to sell.**



## Sample Video — VERY IMPORTANT



If you have a video showing yourself doing any of the following, please send it with your application:



* Sales coaching

* Cold-call training

* Role-playing a sales call

* Teaching someone how to sell

* Demonstrating a cold call

* Handling objections

* Training salespeople



It does **not** have to be a professionally produced video.



I mainly want to see **how you actually teach and coach.**



If you don't have an existing video, you may record a short sample explaining how you would coach someone through a cold call.



## Please Include Your Desired Rate



Please tell me **how much you are asking per hour** for this type of one-on-one coaching.



Do not simply write "negotiable."



Please provide your actual requested hourly rate.



## Please Answer These Questions



1. How many years of sales experience do you have?

2. How many years of sales training/coaching experience do you have?

3. Have you personally trained people to cold call?

4. Have you done live sales role-play with students or salespeople?

5. What types of products/services have you sold?

6. What type of sales were you involved in — B2B, B2C, high-ticket, appointment setting, closing, etc.?

7. How do you normally structure a one-on-one sales coaching session?

8. How do you teach someone to sound more confident on the phone?

9. How do you teach objection handling?

10. Are you comfortable challenging the student rather than simply giving encouragement?

11. Do you have a sample video? **Please provide the link.**

12. What is your desired hourly rate?



## Top 3 Skills



Please make sure your profile/application highlights these three skills:



**1. Cold Calling & Sales Training**



**2. Sales Role-Play & Objection Handling**



**3. Sales Pitch, Confidence & Communication Coaching**



I am looking for someone interested in **ongoing one-on-one coaching**, not just a one-time session.



Please apply with your experience, sample video if available, and desired hourly rate.

title: SEO and Digital Marketing Specialist - SaaS B2B
description:
We are looking for a hands-on SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist to create and implement the right SEO & Digital Marketing strategy to optimize our websites, drive traffic and convert all traffic into trial signups.



This role his highly synchronized with the Sales Lead role: https://www.onlinejobs.ph/jobseekers/job/Sales-Lead-Head-of-Sales--B2B-SaaS
.



We are looking for an experienced and results-driven SEO & Digital Marketing Executive who will be responsible for optimizing our websites, driving traffic, and generating qualified leads for our software products. This role involves executing a comprehensive SEO & Digital Marketing strategy, managing PPC campaigns (if/when needed), and using data-driven insights to improve marketing performance.



This is a high-impact role reporting directly to the CEO, with the entrepreneurial upside of running your own team as the business scales.



About Us

We build and operate a portfolio of B2B SaaS products for small and medium-sized businesses: Payrun (payroll and HR management), and 
 (All in One CRM & HelpDesk solution), with roots going back to Gain Solutions AS, a technology consultancy founded in 2011 in Norway with developers and operations team in Dhaka, Bangladesh.



We're currently consolidating our three products into two, sharpening our focus on AI-first tools that SMBs actually adopt and keep using.



About the Role

In few weeks, you have established a clear technical SEO baseline (crawlability, indexation, site structure), and built a keyword strategy that feeds directly into what our Content Lead writes next.



As the SEO and Digital Marketing Specialist, you will be responsible for enhancing our online visibility, driving organic traffic, and optimizing our digital presence to support lead generation and business growth. This role requires a solid understanding of SEO best practices, performance marketing, and analytics. You will collaborate closely with the product, content, and sales teams to ensure consistent, targeted, and impactful marketing efforts aligned with our SaaS offerings and business objectives.



This is a remote work position, but you will report directly to CEO and will have to work with other team members from different parts of the world.



What You'll Do

- Run technical SEO audits across our product sites and fix crawlability, indexation, and structural issues

- Own on-page optimization (titles, meta, headings, internal linking) across all product sites- Monitor rankings, impressions, clicks, and CTR via Google Search Console and Ahrefs, and report on trends weekly

- Investigate and address the cause of any ranking or traffic drops as they occur

- Build and maintain keyword strategy in partnership with the Content Lead

- Maintain sitemap structure and internal linking across our websites

- Work closely with the Sales Lead to ensure they have everything they need to successfully close deals.



What We're Looking For — Required

- 2+ years of hands-on technical and on-page SEO experience

- Practical, day-to-day experience with Ahrefs and Google Search Console

- Solid understanding of AI Driven SEO and Digital Marketing work

- Fluent written English for reporting and cross-team communication

- Comfortable working independently and flagging issues before they become bigger problems



Preferred (Nice to Have)

- Experience managing SEO across multiple sites or brands at once

- Experience in SaaS or other B2B software companies

- Basic HTML/CSS literacy for diagnosing technical issues without needing a developer for everything

.

Preferred (Nice to Have)

title: AI-First Video Ad Creator | Dog Supplement Brand
description:
Remote · Long-term · 10 to 20 hours/week to start, full time possible · up to $1,500 USD per month + performance bonus



Hi, nice to meet you! 👋



We are not looking for someone who just wants another editing gig.



We are looking for one editor who wants to get really good at making video ads that sell, and who wants to grow with us over the long term.



We are a small team building a dog supplement brand 🐶 for the US market. We move fast and test a lot. Every week we run new video ads on Meta 
 and Instagram), all in English.



We provide the ad concepts and deliver clear briefs, with references where possible. What we need is an editor who turns our ideas into finished ads we can run right away.





🎯 THIS IS NOT A NORMAL EDITING JOB



We don't need someone who just puts clips in order. When you open a new task, you should ask yourself:

- Does this hook catch the viewer in the first second?

- Is every clip good enough to run?

- Is anything cut off in Feed, Stories or Reels?

- Is the file named correctly, or will anything cause issues?

- Are there any AI errors in the footage, like a sixth finger?



Your job is not only to edit what you get. Your job is to deliver ads we can trust without checking every frame.





🎬 WHAT YOU WILL DO

You get ideas, references, the copy, sometimes B-roll clips, and a written spec. Sometimes we explain it in a short Loom video. You create content with AI. In the end, you deliver finished ads that are ready to run.



- Create stunning B-roll with AI video models

- Turn ad concepts into finished ads for
 and Instagram

- Think about hooks that CATCH the viewer

- Add subtitles and on-screen elements

- Follow the naming convention we give you





🔍 WE WANT SOMEONE WHO CARES ABOUT DETAILS

- If a clip has an AI error, like a strange face or a broken dog paw, you notice.

- If text sits where Instagram will cover it, you move it.

- If a spec is unclear, you ask before you start.

- If you think a cut would work better another way, tell us and show us.



We don't want someone who waits for us to find the mistakes.





📈 YOUR GROWTH PATH

We start with 10 to 20 hours per week. In the mid term, we can also hire you full time.



The better and more reliable your work, the sooner we move to full time, with higher pay and more responsibility.





💰 PAY = BASE + BONUS



- Monthly base: $1,000–$1,500 USD

- Performance bonus on top, paid monthly. It depends on the quality and reliability of your work and how well your edits perform.

- Payment through Payoneer (EasyPay) or Wise. We can talk about other options if you prefer another one.

- We always pay on time. No chasing invoices, no delays, no excuses. You focus on great ads, we make sure your money arrives. If you prefer, we can start with a weekly payment.



The better your ads →

the more we can scale them →

the more work and responsibility you get →

the more money you make.





🙋 WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- 3+ years of experience editing video ads. Most of ours are 10 to 45 seconds, some are longer.

- Hands-on experience with AI video models (e.g. Veo, Kling, Runway, Sora). This is a must.

- You fully understand Meta safe zones. You know what gets cut in Feed, Stories and Reels and place everything correctly without being told.

- A sharp eye for mistakes in footage, both AI-generated and real.

- Good written English.

- Reliable delivery times.



We don't require a specific editing program. Use whatever you are fast in.



⭐ Experience with D2C / supplement ads is a strong plus.





🚫 DO NOT APPLY IF…

- You miss deadlines without telling us early

- You don't know what safe zones are

- You have never created video with AI models

- You deliver files with random names

- You send ads with mistakes you haven't checked yourself

- You need us to explain every small step

- You are an agency or plan to pass the work to someone else





🛠️ HOW WE WORK

- 10 to 20 hours per week to start, full time possible in the mid term.

- Tools: Slack, Asana, Airtable, Google Drive. A clear structure is important.

- We work async. We are based in Europe (CET/CEST), no fixed hours needed.

- No agencies and no outsourcing. We want to work with you directly.





🤝 HOW WE HIRE

Application on our careers page → Small trial task → Ongoing work



The trial task will be fully paid after a successful hire.





✍️ HOW TO APPLY

We only accept applications through our careers page.

👉 



It takes about 5 minutes. Please have ready:

- Your portfolio or showreel link (2 or 3 video ads you edited for Meta, Instagram or TikTok)

- The editing and AI tools you use

- How many hours per week you can take on (10 to 20 to start)

- Optional, but a big plus: a short personal video intro (Loom or YouTube, max 2 minutes)



Please do not send your application by message,
 or chat.

Applications that don't come through the careers page will not be considered.



We look forward to seeing your work! 🚀

title: # PROFESSIONAL VOICE TRAINING SPECIALIST / VOCAL COACH – ZOOM
description:

My goal is to improve my voice as much as realistically possible — including making it **clearer, stronger, more pleasant, better controlled, more confident, and more professional-sounding**.



This is **NOT simply a singing teacher position**. I am specifically looking for someone who understands the **voice itself** and can professionally assess and train an individual's voice.



## WHAT I AM LOOKING FOR



You should have strong professional knowledge and experience in areas such as:



* Vocal training and voice development

* **Vocal and throat anatomy**

* Breathing and breath support

* Vocal production

* Resonance

* Projection

* Pitch and pitch control

* Tone and vocal quality

* Articulation and clarity

* Vocal placement

* Voice strength and control

* Proper vocal technique

* Identifying weaknesses in a person's voice

* Creating exercises specifically for an individual's needs



You should be able to **listen carefully to my voice, identify what can be improved, explain what is happening, and create a structured training program to work on it.**



## ZOOM TRAINING



Training will primarily be done **one-on-one through Zoom**.



You should be comfortable demonstrating exercises remotely, listening carefully, correcting technique, and giving clear instructions that I can practice between sessions.



I am looking for someone who can develop a **personalized practice routine** rather than simply following a generic lesson plan.



If there are certain things that genuinely require an in-person professional, I can arrange that separately locally. The primary training will be done remotely.



## IMPORTANT



I am looking for a **professional**, not someone who simply enjoys singing or has casual experience.



Professional voice coaching, vocal training, singing instruction, speech/voice training, or related professional experience is strongly preferred.



A strong understanding of **vocal/throat anatomy and how the voice physically works** is particularly important.

* How many years you have professionally trained voices

Applications without a clear hourly or session rate may not be considered.

title: # HOLISTIC WELLNESS / MIND-BODY PRACTITIONER
description:
**Remote / Zoom | Part-Time / Sessions | Integrative & Experiential Approaches**



I am looking for an **experienced holistic wellness, mind-body, or therapeutic practitioner** who has broad knowledge of different approaches to emotional well-being, personal transformation, mind-body work, and deeper patterns of the mind.



I am specifically **NOT looking only for traditional talk therapy or CBT**.



I am interested in working with someone who understands approaches that go beyond simply discussing thoughts and can work with **emotions, the body, nervous system, subconscious patterns, internal parts, beliefs, and deeper experiential processes**.



## MODALITIES I AM INTERESTED IN



You do NOT need to practice every modality below. However, I am particularly interested in applicants with professional training or substantial experience in several of these areas:



* **Internal Family Systems (IFS) / Parts Work**

* **Somatic approaches / body-based work**

* **Mind-body approaches**

* **Inner-child work**

* Emotional processing

* Nervous-system regulation

* Breathwork

* Meditation and mindfulness

* Guided visualization

* Subconscious beliefs and patterns

* Trauma-informed approaches

* Attachment-oriented approaches

* Emotional-release techniques

* Integrative or holistic psychology

* Hypnotherapy, where appropriately trained

* Yoga / yoga-based therapeutic practices

* Acupuncture / Traditional Chinese Medicine knowledge

* Energy-oriented practices or energy healing

* Other legitimate holistic or complementary wellness modalities



I am also interested in practitioners familiar with ideas surrounding **meditation, consciousness, the mind-body connection, visualization, emotional states, and personal transformation**, including some of the themes discussed in the work of **Dr. Joe Dispenza and other mind-body/consciousness teachers**.



However, I am **not looking for someone who simply follows one teacher or repeats spiritual ideas**. I want someone with real training, experience, critical thinking, and a broad understanding of different modalities.



## WHAT I WANT TO LEARN AND EXPERIENCE



Part of my goal is educational.



I want someone who can help me understand:



**What different modalities exist? How do they work? What is each one designed to address? What happens during a session? How are they different from conventional talk therapy?**



Where appropriate to your qualifications and scope of practice, I would also like to **experience and practice different techniques through Zoom sessions**, rather than only hearing about them theoretically.



I am interested in discovering approaches that work with the person on multiple levels — **mind, emotions, body, internal patterns, habits, beliefs, awareness, and overall well-being.**



## WHO I AM LOOKING FOR



The ideal person might be a:



* Holistic wellness practitioner

* Mind-body practitioner

* Integrative therapist or counselor

* IFS-informed/trained practitioner

* Somatic practitioner

* Trauma-informed practitioner

* Breathwork practitioner

* Meditation/mindfulness teacher

* Hypnotherapist

* Holistic coach with substantial professional training

* Acupuncture/TCM professional with mind-body knowledge

* Integrative wellness practitioner

* Or someone professionally trained across several related modalities



You should be able to clearly distinguish **which modalities you are formally trained/certified/licensed in, which you have practical experience with, and which you are simply knowledgeable about.**



## IMPORTANT



I value open-mindedness, but I also value **professionalism and honesty**.



Please do not claim that a particular technique can cure a medical or psychological condition unless that claim is within your professional scope and supported appropriately.



If you are not a licensed therapist, psychologist, physician, acupuncturist, or other licensed healthcare professional, that is okay — just clearly state your actual qualifications and professional scope.



I am looking for someone who knows **what they know and what they do not know**.



## ZOOM SESSIONS



Sessions will primarily take place remotely through **Zoom**.



You should be comfortable:



* Teaching and explaining different modalities

* Guiding appropriate exercises remotely

* Giving personalized practices between sessions

* Discussing what we observed during an exercise

* Recommending which approaches may be worth exploring further

* Explaining when something should instead be handled by an appropriately licensed or in-person professional



If a modality genuinely requires in-person treatment — for example, acupuncture — I can work with an appropriate local professional. You can still help educate me about the modality and how it fits into the larger mind-body picture.



## APPLICATION



Please answer the following: 



1. **What is your professional background, education, training, licenses, and certifications?**



2. **Which holistic, therapeutic, somatic, mind-body, or complementary modalities are you professionally trained in?**



3. **Do you have experience with IFS/parts work, somatic work, inner-child work, nervous-system regulation, breathwork, meditation, or subconscious-pattern work? Please explain.**

, Instagram, YouTube, and other advertising platforms

Required Experience and Skills

- Several years of professional video-editing experience

- Expert knowledge of professional color correction and color grading

title: Operations Assistant | 100% Remote | US-Based Company (URGENT)
description:

About Bee Man Dan



Bee Man Dan is a growing Houston, Texas-based company specializing in humane bee and wasp removal.

 approach, thermal imaging technology, and live bee extraction.



As our business grows, we're looking for a reliable, organized, and proactive Operations & Administrative Assistant to help keep our daily operations running smoothly.



You'll work closely with our Operations Manager, provide administrative support to our CEO, and help maintain organized systems, records, and workflows.



This is primarily an operations and administrative role, with additional responsibilities in executive support, backup phone coverage, and light bookkeeping.



We're looking for someone who enjoys organizing information, solving problems, taking initiative, and helping a business operate efficiently.



What You'll Be Doing



Your responsibilities will cover four main areas.



1. Operations & Administrative Support



Your primary responsibility



You'll work closely with our Operations Manager to keep daily activities organized and ensure important tasks, information, and follow-ups are properly managed.



Your responsibilities will include:



- Assist the Operations Manager with day-to-day administrative and operational activities.

- Organize company documents, files, and important operational information.

- Help coordinate schedules, appointments, and internal activities.

- Assist with preparing reports, summaries, and operational updates.

- Help maintain and improve administrative processes and workflows.

- Support the Operations Manager with other reasonably related administrative tasks.



You'll help make sure our team stays organized and has the information needed to complete its work effectively.



2. Backup Phone Support & Customer Coordination



A supporting responsibility, not your primary function



We have dedicated phone-support staff. However, you'll serve as a backup resource when additional assistance is needed.



Our business typically receives a maximum of approximately 5-10 incoming customer calls per day across the team, so this is not a high-volume call center position.



Your responsibilities may include:



- Answer incoming customer calls when the dedicated phone-support team member is unavailable or requires assistance.

- Provide scheduled phone coverage when our dedicated phone-support team member is on a rest day, including weekends when assigned. U

- Assist customers with basic service inquiries.

- Help coordinate appointments and customer follow-ups.

- Make occasional outbound calls for customer follow-ups or community outreach.

- Record important customer information and communicate relevant details to the Operations Manager or appropriate team member.



You will not be expected to handle customer calls throughout your entire shift.

However, you must be comfortable speaking with US customers professionally whenever backup coverage is required.



3. Executive Support



You'll provide administrative and organizational support directly to our CEO.



Your responsibilities will include:



Manage and organize the CEO's
 inbox.

Assist with calendar management and appointment scheduling.

Coordinate meetings, appointments, and important reminders.

Organize correspondence and track executive follow-up items.

Help prepare documents and information needed for meetings.

Assist with routine executive administrative requests.

Handle company information with professionalism and discretion.



We're looking for someone who can anticipate administrative needs, communicate clearly, and help keep the CEO's schedule and priorities organized.



4. Light Bookkeeping & Financial Administration



Approximately 5% of your working time



Bookkeeping is a small supporting function within this role, not a full-time accounting responsibility.



Your responsibilities will include:



Maintain and organize routine financial records using Xero.

Help ensure financial documents and transactions are properly recorded.

Assist with basic bookkeeping and recordkeeping.

Prepare and organize financial information for review.



Bookkeeping reviews take place twice per month.



Your responsibility is to help ensure that records are accurate, organized, and ready for these scheduled reviews.



You do not need to be a professional accountant.



Basic bookkeeping knowledge and familiarity with Xero or similar software would be helpful.



Who We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who is dependable, organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable supporting different areas of a growing business.



Required Qualifications

Clear and professional spoken and written English.

Previous experience in operations assistance, administrative support, executive assistance, or a similar role.

Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

Experience managing tasks,
, calendars, and business records.

Comfortable using computers, spreadsheets, and online business tools.

Able to manage multiple responsibilities and work independently.

Comfortable handling occasional customer calls and communicating with US customers.

Able to follow instructions, maintain accurate records, and meet deadlines.

Reliable internet connection and a quiet working environment suitable for calls.

Available to work six days per week during the agreed Houston-time schedule.

Experience using ClickUp or similar project management software.

Previous executive assistant experience.

Experience supporting a US-based business.

Familiarity with Xero, QuickBooks, or basic bookkeeping.

Previous BPO or customer service experience.

Experience using Google Workspace.



Experience in the bee removal industry is not required.



We're interested in applicants who have strong administrative skills, relevant experience, and the ability to learn new systems.



What Makes Someone Successful in This Role?



You'll be a great fit if you:



- Enjoy organizing tasks, information, and business processes.

- Take initiative and follow through on your responsibilities.

- Can manage different priorities without losing track of important details.

- Communicate clearly and professionally.

- Are comfortable supporting both the Operations Manager and CEO.

- Can adapt when occasional customer phone coverage is needed.

- Pay attention to details and maintain accurate records.

Compensation & Working Arrangements



Compensation



Compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, qualifications, and demonstrated skills.

Our current hiring budget is up to $280 USD biweekly.



Work Arrangement

s, schedules, or company records?

Bee Man Dan LLC

Houston, Texas, USA

title: GOHIGHLEVEL EXPERT (FUNNEL BUILDER, AI AND AUTOMATION)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



We help coaches and consultants run online events that actually convert. Every event we run is built inside GoHighLevel. The funnel, the emails, the SMS, the portal, the tracking, and the automations behind all of it.



You do not need to be a full stack developer. You need to be genuinely good at GoHighLevel, and comfortable using AI and automation to take repetitive work off a person's plate.



You will own the build. Pages, workflows, sequences, portals, and the systems that keep an event running smoothly while everyone else is busy delivering it.



We are a small team and we look after each other. You will have room to build things properly and someone to ask when you need a decision.



WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO



Build complete event funnels in GoHighLevel. Registration, thank you, VIP upsell, order, sales, portal, replay.



Build the workflows behind them, so the right person gets the right message at the right time and nobody falls through a gap.



Set up the email and SMS sequences inside those workflows.



Make GoHighLevel do things it does not do out of the box. Countdown timers, carousels, progress bars, gamification, and custom pieces that still work properly on a phone.



Use AI to save real hours. If a person is copying, pasting or chasing something every week, you build the thing that does it instead.



Set up tracking so we can see where people drop off, not just how many bought.



Test everything before it goes live, and fix things calmly when they move.



Build reusable templates so the second event takes half the time of the first.



WHAT WE NEED YOU TO ALREADY KNOW



Three years or more with GoHighLevel as your main tool.



Funnels you have built yourself, start to finish, that were used for real events or launches.



Workflows and automations inside GoHighLevel, comfortably and without hand holding.



Enough HTML, CSS and JavaScript to make a page behave the way you want, including on mobile.



AI tools used in real work, not just experimented with. We would love to see what you built and what it saved.



An events or marketing background, so you understand why a page converts and not only how to build it.



NICE TO HAVE



Membership portals and gamification. Experience with live launches and event days. Connecting GoHighLevel to other tools so information moves across by itself.



WHO THIS SUITS



Someone who likes seeing a build work properly. If you have ever noticed a problem in a funnel before anyone else did and quietly fixed it, you will enjoy it here.



HOW TO APPLY



Skip the long cover letter, we would rather see your work.



Send us:



Two funnels you built in GoHighLevel. Links, and one line on what each was for.



One thing you automated using AI. What it was, and what it replaced.



Your answer to this: a registration page is converting at 22 percent and we would like it closer to 40 percent. What would you look at first, second and third, and why in that order.
