title: Senior Accountant — Veritas Management Group
description:
Location: Remote, working US Central Time hours Schedule: Full-time, fixed hours (see below) Reports to: Guilherme Albergaria, CFO Compensation: Competitive, based on experience. Contractor or W-2 depending on location.



Who we are



Veritas Management Group is an outsourced finance department for owner-led companies in the $5M to $50M range, with a concentration in construction, manufacturing, healthcare and professional services. We are not a bookkeeping shop and we are not a one-person CFO practice. Clients get one team and one system: clean books, a monthly close that ties, cash and A/R discipline, and a CFO who can stand behind every number. We are small, we are growing, and the work is visible. What you produce goes in front of business owners and their banks.



The role



You own the monthly close and the reconciliation work for a portfolio of clients, end to end. That means bank and credit card reconciliations, payroll workpapers, A/R and A/P subledgers, fixed assets, accruals, intercompany, and the client financial package that comes out the other side. You work alongside our Controller and our Accounting lead, and you report directly to the CFO.



You will spend most of your time in QuickBooks Online, Excel and Google Sheets, with payroll platforms (iSolved, Gusto, ADP), and in our internal trackers. Construction clients mean WIP schedules and job costing; if you haven't done those, you'll learn them here.



What you'll do

Close the books monthly for assigned clients, on the calendar date we committed to the client, with every balance sheet account reconciled and supported.

Build and maintain reconciliation workpapers that someone else can pick up and follow without asking you a question.

Prepare payroll workpapers and tie payroll to the GL, including prepaid and accrued payroll and field-labor allocations.

Maintain A/R aging and collections trackers; flag DSO movement before it becomes a cash problem.

Prepare client financial packages (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, KPI pages) for CFO review, tied to the penny.

Clean up and restate books when we onboard a client whose prior accounting doesn't hold up.

Document what you do. Our standard is that every recurring task has a written procedure.

How we work, and why it matters



We run on a few rules that are not negotiable, because the whole model depends on them:



Fixed hours. You work a set block of hours, Monday through Friday, in US Central Time, and you are reachable inside that block. We don't care where you are in the world. We care that when we say you're on, you're on. If you have another job, that's your business, but it can't overlap with this block.

Every status update ends with a RISK line. "RISK: none" or "RISK: the bank feed is three days behind and the close may slip." Every time.

Anything that changes a deliverable, a date, or the meaning of a number goes to the CFO the same day, in its own
. If you're not sure whether it qualifies, it qualifies.

Numbers tie or they don't go out. Close enough isn't a thing here.



If those rules sound like relief rather than pressure, you'll like it here.



What you bring

5+ years of full-cycle accounting, with at least 2 years owning a monthly close. Multi-client or outsourced accounting experience is a strong plus.

Deep QuickBooks Online skill. QBO ProAdvisor certification preferred.

Strong Excel: lookups, pivots, structured workpapers. You build models that someone else can audit.

Payroll accounting experience (iSolved, Gusto, ADP or similar).

Construction accounting, job costing, or WIP exposure is a plus, not a requirement.

CPA, CMA, ACCA or equivalent preferred; a degree in accounting required.

Written English that's clear and direct. Most of our communication with clients and with each other is in writing.

A track record of hitting dates. We will ask your references about this specifically.

What you get

Direct work with a CFO and a small senior team; no layers.

A portfolio of real operating businesses, not one company's back office.

Clear scope, clear standards, and a say in how the procedures get written.

Room to grow into a Controller seat as the firm scales.

title: Healthcare Insurance Verifications Specialist
description:
PLEASE INCLUDE A LINK TO YOUR RESUME IN YOUR MESSAGE. APPLICANTS WHO DO NOT INCLUDE A LINK IN YOUR MESSAGE WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED.



Position Overview:

An Insurance Verifications Specialist is responsible for ensuring the accuracy and completeness of healthcare insurance information for patients or clients. This role involves verifying insurance coverage, confirming if prior authorizations are needed or not, and working closely with insurance companies.



Pocket Overview:

Pocket provides a cheaper and faster insurance verification process for physical therapists.

We know that insurance verification is painful and can take up to 1-2 hours to verify a patient's insurance coverage, potentially delaying appointment scheduling and care.

Pocket will take on the pain of dealing with insurance so front desk staff can focus on customer-facing interactions and PTs can focus on what they do best – treating patients.



Key Responsibilities:

1. Healthcare Insurance Verification:

Confirm patient eligibility and insurance coverage by contacting insurance carriers via phone.

Responsible for effective and efficient verification of all patients’ benefits before their appointment.

Verify benefits for physical therapy services.

Ensure accurate documentation of coverage details, including co-pays, deductibles, out-of-pocket expenses, authorization requirements and visit limits.

2. Authorizations:

Confirm if authorization is needed or not

If it’s needed, confirm what is required to submit authorization

3. Data Entry and Record Maintenance:

Accurately input insurance details into our internal database or client’s EMR platform.

Update patient accounts with the latest insurance information and maintain confidentiality in compliance with HIPAA regulations.

Record calls using online recording software (provided by Pocket)

4. Customer and Team Support:

Serve as a point of contact for physical therapy admin staff with questions about their insurance coverage or billing.

5. Problem-Solving:

Identify and address insurance coverage issues or errors proactively.

Follow up with insurance companies if there is conflicting information.



Qualifications and Skills:

1. Experience:

2+ years of experience in insurance verification, medical billing, or a related field.

Familiarity with U.S. based insurance plans, benefits, and medical terminology.



2. Technical Skills:

Proficiency in using EMR systems, insurance portals, Google Suite (Google Docs, Google Sheets) and Microsoft Office Suite.

Strong data entry skills with high attention to detail.

3. Interpersonal Skills:

Excellent written / verbal communication and customer service skills.

Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.

4. Problem-Solving: Analytical skills to resolve coverage discrepancies

5. Security:

Must adhere to all HIPAA guidelines and regulations.

Maintain patient and company confidentiality.



Work Environment:

Remote

Must be able to work weekdays 9am - 5pm Eastern Time Zone

Must have reliable internet connection and use their personal computer

Requires heavy interaction with insurers via phone



This role is ideal for individuals who thrive in a detail-oriented, fast-paced environment and have a passion for supporting healthcare processes.



Interview Process:

1) Short Case Study

2) Testing

3) Behavioral Interview

title: Virtual Assistant – Travel, Marketing & Outreach
description:
PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING



We receive a high volume of applications and are looking for candidates whose skills and experience closely match this position.



Before applying, please make sure you:



* Have strong English communication and administrative skills.

* Have experience with, or an aptitude for, social media and online marketing.

* Are comfortable with the $5–$7 USD hourly range and an initial schedule of 10–12 hours per week (to start)

* Can provide some availability during daytime Pacific Time hours.

* Have your own reliable computer, high-speed internet, and a quiet workspace.

* Are willing to submit the required video introduction.



Applications missing any required information, including the video introduction, may not be considered.



ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY



We're looking for an organized, dependable Virtual Assistant to support a growing U.S.-based company specializing in Biblical travel and group tours.



This is a long-term opportunity to work closely with a business owner who creates meaningful travel experiences and needs help bringing those tours to a wider audience.



The role combines administrative support, tour coordination, marketing assistance, and outreach to churches and pastors.



We're hoping to find one person who can handle as much of the role as possible. Some specialized marketing projects may be handled by outside professionals, so you won't be expected to be an expert in everything.



THIS ROLE COULD BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU:



* Enjoy keeping projects organized and making sure details don't fall through the cracks.

* Have strong administrative skills and can work independently.

* Are comfortable learning new software and systems.

* Have experience with, or an aptitude for, social media and online marketing.

* Communicate professionally and confidently in English.

* Enjoy coordinating with different people to get things done.

* Understand and respect the company's Christian mission and Biblical values.

* Are interested in a long-term opportunity with room to grow.



Previous experience in the travel or tour industry is a strong plus! Experience with group tours, travel booking systems, or tour administration would be particularly valuable but is not required.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



* Provide administrative and clerical support, organize tour information, and learn the company's travel software.

* Coordinate with the website provider to publish new tours and distribute promotional materials across online platforms.

* Help maintain the company's social media presence and coordinate with outside marketing professionals when needed.

* Research speaking opportunities with churches and pastors, assist with outreach, and track follow-ups.

* Coordinate with the business owner and other service providers to keep projects moving.

* Potentially assist with tour payment processing, depending on how responsibilities are divided.



SCHEDULE & GROWTH



The position will begin at approximately 10–12 hours per week, with the potential to grow to 20–30 hours and eventually full-time as the business grows. Additional hours are not guaranteed.



Some availability during daytime Pacific Time hours is required, although not all working hours need to overlap.



HOW TO APPLY — FOLLOW ALL INSTRUCTIONS



STEP 1: SUBJECT LINE



Include the exact phrase "Biblical Travel VA" in your application subject line.



STEP 2: SUBMIT YOUR INFORMATION



Include ALL of the following:



* Your résumé or a summary of your relevant work experience.

* A brief explanation of your experience with administration, social media, marketing coordination, travel, or tour-related work.

* Your expected hourly rate in USD.

* Your availability, including your ability to overlap with daytime Pacific Time hours.



STEP 3: VIDEO INTRODUCTION (REQUIRED)



Provide a link to a short video introduction, approximately 2–3 minutes, answering these questions:



1. What experience makes you a good fit for this position?

2. When you're given several tasks with different deadlines, how do you organize your work and make sure nothing gets overlooked?

3. Imagine you're given a completed tour itinerary and promotional graphic. How would you approach getting that tour promoted online?



Please ensure your video link is accessible without requesting additional permission.



Applications missing any required information, including the video introduction, may not be considered.



Due to the volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Customer Support Associate (Remote)
description:
This is a fully remote position and may require shifting schedules, weekend coverage, and overtime based on business needs.



Who We Are



At Neuro, we empower better minds with innovative, science-backed formulas. Our products are accessible, portable, shareable, and designed to work fast, wherever life takes you.



We're a premium functional wellness brand helping people optimize focus, clarity, energy, and cognitive performance through clean, effective gum and mints.



Neuro has been featured by The Joe Rogan Experience, Fast Company, The New Yorker, and The Daily Beast, and our founders appeared on Shark Tank Season 11.



About the Role



We're looking for an experienced Customer Support Associate who genuinely enjoys helping people and thrives in a fast-paced environment.



This role goes beyond answering tickets - you'll be responsible for delivering an exceptional customer experience across phone,
, live chat, and social media while exercising sound judgment, solving problems independently, and representing the Neuro brand with professionalism and empathy.



The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator who can think critically, prioritize effectively, and take ownership of customer issues from start to finish. We're looking for someone who communicates naturally not someone who relies on scripted responses. Clear writing, sound judgment, and genuine empathy are far more important to us than memorizing processes.



What You'll Do

- Deliver thoughtful, empathetic, and on-brand support across
, live chat, phone, and social media.

- Resolve customer inquiries related to orders, subscriptions, shipping, billing, products, and promotions.

- Prioritize multiple customer requests while maintaining accuracy and response quality.

- Investigate issues independently and determine the best course of action before escalating.

- Take ownership of customer concerns through resolution while keeping customers informed every step of the way.

- Communicate clearly, professionally, and confidently across all support channels.

- Maintain accurate documentation, tagging, and customer records within our CRM.

- Identify recurring customer issues and proactively suggest process improvements.

- Collaborate with Operations, Fulfillment, Marketing, and Ecommerce teams to resolve customer issues.

- Assist during product launches, promotions, and seasonal volume spikes.

- Adapt to changing priorities, workflows, and support channels based on business needs.

- Use AI-powered tools responsibly to improve efficiency while maintaining personalized customer interactions.



What We're Looking For

**Required Qualifications**

- 2+ years of experience in customer support, customer success, or another customer-facing role.

- Excellent written English with strong grammar, spelling, and the ability to communicate naturally and concisely.

- Professional verbal communication skills and confidence speaking with customers by phone.

- Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to prioritize competing tasks and remain organized in a fast-paced environment.

- Demonstrated ability to work independently while knowing when to seek guidance.

- Exceptional attention to detail.

- Customer-first mindset with empathy, professionalism, and accountability.

- Comfortable switching between phone,
, live chat, and social media support depending on business needs.

- Reliable internet connection and a distraction-free remote work environment.

- Willingness to work shifting schedules and overtime when required.



**Preferred Qualifications**

Experience using one or more of the following:

- Shopify

- Gorgias

- Zendesk

- Amazon Seller Central

- TikTok Seller Center

- Skio, Recharge, or other subscription platforms

- ShipHero or similar warehouse/order management systems

- AI tools that support customer service workflows



**What Success Looks Like**

You'll be successful in this role if you:

- Deliver accurate, thoughtful, and timely responses across every customer interaction.

- Know how to balance multiple priorities without compromising quality.

- Take ownership of customer issues instead of simply responding to tickets.

- Communicate with confidence, empathy, and professionalism.

- Make sound decisions independently while recognizing when escalation is appropriate.

- Continuously look for opportunities to improve the customer experience and internal processes.

- Represent the Neuro brand with every interaction.



**Why You'll Love Working at Neuro**

- Fully remote work environment.

- Opportunity to grow with one of the fastest-growing functional wellness brands.

- Collaborative, supportive, and high-performing team.

- Work that directly impacts our customers and business growth.

- A culture that values ownership, initiative, and continuous improvement.



**How to Apply**



If you're interested in joining the Neuro team, please
 the following to 

- A PDF copy of your resume.

- A 1–2 minute video introduction (Loom, Google Drive, or another shareable link) telling us a little about yourself, your customer support experience, and why you're interested in joining Neuro.

- Your response to the customer scenario below.



Customer Scenario



A customer
s the following:



Subject: Subscription Charge



Hi,



I was charged for my Neuro subscription again, but I was sure I canceled it last month. I'm pretty frustrated because I wasn't expecting this charge. Can you please refund me and let me know what happened?



Thanks.



Please draft the
 you would send to this customer.



**** We're looking for your natural communication style, problem-solving approach, and ability to deliver a thoughtful customer experience. Please complete this exercise using your own words.



 Subject Line



Rockstar CS – [Your Full Name]



***Please Note***

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Due to the high volume of applications, only candidates selected to move forward in the interview process will be contacted.

- Eczema Nourish: 12 products. Replo and native Liquid.

- EarBalance: 8 products. Replo and native Liquid.

- Three Shopify stores, three themes, three Klaviyo accounts, three GA4 properties, one shared Meta ad account.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



Revenue growth

- Own a monthly Shopify revenue target across all three stores.

- Identify where revenue is being lost (traffic, conversion rate, AOV, repeat purchase) and build a prioritized, measurable growth plan.

- Estimate the commercial impact of a change before building it, then report what the completed initiative actually changed.

- Improve free-shipping qualification, bundles, quantity discounts, subscriptions, and product availability.



Storefront development and maintenance

- Build and update product pages in Replo; maintain legacy PageFly pages and native Shopify templates.

- Repair broken buy boxes, variant selectors, subscription displays, and quantity ladders.

- Work in Shopify Liquid (sections, snippets, templates, theme settings), app embeds, cart drawers, navigation, and tracking scripts.

- Make careful changes to live storefront code and verify every change on the live storefront.



Pricing and merchandising

- Maintain prices using approved SRPs and landed costs.

- Create quantity and bundle pricing within a maximum 20% discount.

- Manage compare-at prices, free-shipping thresholds, and discount codes.

- Confirm every published bundle or pack exists as a real inventory variant that Fulfillment can pick and ship.

- Check margins before stacking bulk, promotional, and subscription discounts.



Subscriptions

- Manage Subscribe and Save across all three stores.

- Attach the correct selling plans to eligible products and variants.

- Ensure the advertised subscription price matches the amount charged in the cart.

- Support subscriber and selling-plan migrations when products move between stores.



 capture, tracking, and analytics

- Work across three Klaviyo accounts: embedded forms, pop-ups, flows, and abandoned cart and checkout automation.

- Maintain and troubleshoot GA4, Meta Pixel and datasets, Google Ads tags, Microsoft Clarity, and Shopify custom pixels.

- Investigate missing or duplicated conversion events and prove fixes with test orders.

- Reconcile advertising-platform results against Shopify's actual order data.



Reporting and SEO

- Prepare weekly revenue, profit, and margin figures for the divisional scorecard, and monthly item-level sales files for Finance.

- Identify and explain discrepancies between Shopify, analytics platforms, and agency reports.

- Maintain product metadata, redirects, structured data, and internal links, and improve product copy for both search visibility and conversion.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

- At least 2 years hands-on operating a live Shopify store.

- A specific example of growing a store or sales channel, supported by measurable results.

- Strong understanding of conversion rate, average order value, repeat purchase rate, contribution margin, and customer acquisition and payback.

- Daily working knowledge of the Shopify Admin, and the ability to read and safely edit Shopify Liquid.

- Strong experience with a page builder, preferably Replo. PageFly, Shogun, or GemPages also relevant.

- Experience with product variants, selling plans, and subscription apps such as Seal or Recharge.

- Strong pricing and margin arithmetic: landed cost, compare-at pricing, bulk and subscription discounts.

- Analytics literacy, including the ability to explain what a reported number includes and excludes.

- A habit of verifying your work on the live site through the real customer journey.

- Clear written English and the ability to work across time zones.



NICE TO HAVE

- Shopify Admin API (GraphQL or REST)

- Klaviyo flow building

- Meta Ads and Google Ads reporting

- Zoho Inventory or Zoho Books

- Technical SEO and structured data

- Basic JavaScript and browser-console debugging

- Experience operating multiple Shopify stores or brands



DETAILS

- Full-time, remote.

- Reports to the Shopify Director.

- Compensation: Based on Experience.

- Shortlisted candidates complete a short paid practical exercise in a sandbox Shopify store.



HOW TO APPLY



Apply via our careers page (includes a short 60-second Loom):







In your application, tell us about a Shopify store or sales channel you helped grow: what you changed, the measurable result, and how you verified that your work produced the result. Please include specific numbers. No ghosting, we reply to everyone.

title: High-Ticket B2B Sales Closer - Contractor Marketing
description:
ABOUT US



Spark Marketing Agency is a fast-growing digital marketing firm dedicated to scaling home service contractors across the US. We utilize data-driven advertising, local SEO, and in-house media production to build predictable revenue engines for our clients. Our commitment to operational excellence and real ROI over vanity metrics has allowed us to deliver measurable growth and keep our clients winning month after month. We are focused on turning ad spend into signed contracts while building a team of highly accountable, top-tier professionals.



THE ROLE



You take complete ownership of four things:



* Scaling Calls on your calendar. We place 25+ qualified, booked calls a week in front of you. Setters and marketing fill the pipeline, so you never cold dial.

* The pipeline. No-shows, unclosed calls, and reactivations. The highest earners in this seat win on the follow-ups others ignore.

* CRM hygiene. Every call logged in GoHighLevel, every follow-up dated and scheduled. Clean records are non-negotiable.

* Ruthless qualification. You disqualify bad fits on the call instead of selling bad accounts to the delivery team.



Self-sourced deals are optional and pay 15% instead of 10%.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



* Run one-call closes on Zoom with trade business owners who have often been burned by past agencies.

* Diagnose their current advertising spend and metrics during the call, then present a clear path forward.

* Collect payment on the call. The standard initial agreement ranges between $6k and $12k for three months.

* Manage and work your pipeline in GoHighLevel daily, tracking follow-ups and reviving cold deals.

* Protect client quality. Disqualify prospects who lack budget, capacity, or realistic expectations.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



* 2+ years closing high-ticket B2B over phone and Zoom (not retail, door-to-door, or direct consumer sales).

* $500,000+ in provable lifetime closed revenue with verified references.

* Proven experience selling to contractors or trades businesses. You understand why they are skeptical of monthly agency retainers.

* Experience selling intangible services like marketing or software where prospects carry past negative experiences.

* Total command of your sales data. You must know your exact close rate from last quarter without guessing.

* Financial runway for a 90-day ramp. Month one pays roughly one-third of closed volume because commissions pay on cash collected, not contract signatures.

* Flexibility for Saturday calls, as weekend mornings are often the only time contractors can step away from job sites.

* A former manager or business owner willing to verify your performance numbers on a quick call.



NICE TO HAVE



* An existing network or warm relationships with residential contractors.

* Habitual pipeline tracking and CRM maintenance without management oversight.

* Coachability. Top closers audit their recordings, identify gaps, and adapt instead of blaming lead quality.



LOGISTICS



* Full-time remote contractor position (1099).

* Commission only, no base, no draw, no earnings cap. Real OTE sits between $8k and $12k per month.

* US hours (Pacific time preferred, though Eastern contractors take calls early).

title: Experienced Phone Sales ISA — Natural English, Long-Term Role (Real Estate, EST Hours)
description:
Booked & Ready? Read this whole post. The application instructions are at the bottom, and we only review applications that follow them exactly.



Ottawa Property Shop · Realty Inc. Brokerage

Full-Time (40 hrs/week) · Monday–Friday, EST hours

Pay: $5–$7 USD/hour (based on experience)

+ $100 bonus for every deal you booked that closes

(Estimated base: ~$800–$1,120 USD/month, plus bonuses. Strong ISAs booking 5+ held appointments a week earn an extra ~$400+/month.)



We're not looking for someone to "just make calls." We're looking for someone who wins.



ABOUT THE TEAM



I'm Rony Rizk, one of Ottawa's top-performing REALTORS®, with 113 five-star Google reviews and a growing team at Ottawa Property Shop, Realty Inc. Brokerage.



We generate a consistent, high-volume flow of real buyer and seller leads through CINC, one of the most powerful real estate lead platforms in North America. The leads are real. The volume is consistent. What we need is the right person to convert them.



This is a full-time, long-term role for someone who treats appointment setting as a craft and wants to be rewarded for results.



MUST-HAVES (NON-NEGOTIABLE)



We will not review applications that are missing any of these:



1. 2+ years of phone sales or outbound calling experience. That means real selling or appointment setting on the phone. Customer service, chat support and
 support do NOT count.

2. A stable work history. You have held at least one job for 2+ years. We are building a long-term team, so we do not consider applicants who change jobs every few months.

3. Natural, near-native spoken English. You sound like a friendly, confident local caller, not someone reading a script. Our leads are Canadian homebuyers and sellers, and they hang up on callers who sound robotic.



STRONG PLUSES



- Real estate ISA experience (US or Canadian market)

- Experience with CINC, Follow Up Boss, kvCORE or a similar CRM

- Backup power and backup internet



THE ROLE



Engage. Qualify. Nurture. Book. You'll be the first voice our leads hear after they come in. Your job is to separate motivated buyers and sellers from browsers, and to turn real opportunities into booked appointments.



- Call and follow up with buyer and seller leads daily through CINC CRM

- Build rapport fast: uncover motivation, timeline and goals in the first 2 minutes

- Qualify relentlessly: know who deserves your time and who doesn't

- Book consultations directly onto the agent's calendar

- Keep CRM notes sharp, accurate and organized after every call

- Send strategic follow-up texts and
s to keep leads warm between calls

- Hit daily and weekly KPIs consistently, not occasionally



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



- Outbound dials per day: 120–180

- Lead response time: under 5 minutes

- Appointments booked: consistent, week over week

- CRM accuracy: 100%, every call logged



Please note: All calls are recorded and reviewed. A lead may only be marked lost/dead in the CRM after a real, logged conversation or a documented, reasonable number of contact attempts, never on assumption or lack of effort. Marking leads dead without a genuine attempt to reach and engage them is grounds for immediate termination.



WHO YOU ARE



- Clear, confident and professional on every call

- A natural rapport-builder who asks the right questions and actually listens

- Comfortable with objections. You don't freeze when someone says "I'm just browsing."

- Self-disciplined. You perform whether or not someone is watching.

- Coachable. You take feedback and apply it immediately.

- Set up to work professionally: reliable internet and a quiet workspace

- Available Monday–Friday during EST hours



TRIAL PERIOD



The first 7 working days are a mutual trial. During this window:

- We review your first 10–15 calls together before you work leads unsupervised

- We're listening for real energy and engagement on the call, not just call volume

- Either side can end the arrangement with no hard feelings if it's not the right fit. Better to know in week one than month two.



WHY PEOPLE STAY ON THIS TEAM



- Competitive base pay + $100 for every deal that closes. Your hustle pays off directly, every week.

- Full scripts, training and systems support from day one

- Clear growth path: ISA → Senior ISA → Team Lead → Leadership roles

- A stable, full-time role with a team that's actively growing

- Your results are seen and rewarded, not buried in a team quota



Payment: Wise or PayPal, paid bi-weekly.



HOW TO APPLY (FOLLOW EXACTLY)



Start your application with the words: Booked & Ready



Then include ALL of the following:



1. YOUR WORK HISTORY WITH DATES

For each job in the last 5 years, list:

Company | Job title | Start month/year – End month/year | Phone sales? (Yes/No)



2. YOUR LONGEST-HELD JOB

One line: company name and how long you worked there.



3. A VOICE RECORDING (REQUIRED, 2–3 MINUTES)

Record on Vocaroo, Google Drive or Loom and paste the link. Make sure it's set to public and plays.

- Part 1: Introduce yourself naturally, with NO script. Tell us about your phone sales experience and what you enjoy about it.

- Part 2: Role-play this call. A lead named Sarah just registered on our website to look at homes in Kanata (Ottawa). You call her, and she says: "I'm just browsing, I'm not ready to buy yet." Show us how you handle it.



4. YOUR AVAILABILITY AND DESIRED HOURLY RATE



We do NOT accept written role-plays.

We will not review applications without "Booked & Ready," dated work history, or a working voice link.



Final step before hire: Shortlisted candidates will do a live phone screening call with us, not just a submitted recording. We're listening for real, sustained energy on an unscripted call, since that's the single biggest predictor of success in this role.



If you're ambitious, dependable and ready to build something long-term with a serious real estate team, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now.

title: Meta Ads Specialist
description:
PLEASE READ



We are a US marketing agency that generates leads for home service companies — pest control, plumbing, electrical, cleaning, waste, etc.



 How to apply



 Two parts. Follow the format exactly. We are hiring someone who follows instructions precisely, so this application is

 the first test of that. Anything that skips a step is not read.



 Part 1 — Your message. Start with the exact words "META" followed by the lowest cost per lead you have personally achieved & other achievements relevant for a home service or local business on Meta — the number, the industry, and the country. Then state your available hours in US Mountain Time Zone.



 Part 2 — A Loom video, 90 seconds maximum. Cover these four things in this order:

 1. Your name and your home service / local business experience. Which industries, which countries, how long, and what

 you achieved. Give me real numbers.

 2. Walk me through your numbers. Screenshots, a spreadsheet, a report, a dashboard, whatever you have — share your

 screen and talk me through it. I want to see cost per lead, spend, and lead volume, and I want to hear which of

 those results were yours. You do not need live account access. Any document you can speak to is fine.

 3. Answer this out loud: a client's cost per lead has doubled over the last 7 days. Nothing was changed in the

 account. Walk me through what you check, in order. Be specific about where you look first and why.

 4. Tell me why you are the best fit for this role and why you deserve an interview with me.



Follow these instructions exactly or you will not get interviewed.



We read and watch every application that follows the format.



The job



You own client ad accounts. You handle the manual onboarding setup — ad account access, pixel and conversion setup, lead form/landing pages, targeting, page connections. Then you build, launch, and optimize campaigns every day using the creative system and copy we provide.



Every client has a cost per lead target. That number is your scoreboard. Your bonuses and your raises come from how many of your clients sit at or under it. We are transparent about this because it is the entire system.



You need

 - 1+ year running Meta lead gen campaigns for home service or local businesses — not ecommerce, not national brands,

 not boosted posts

 - Fluent in Ads Manager and Business Manager without a tutorial

 - You understand pixels, custom conversions, standard events, and lead forms

 - Comfortable managing $50 to $1,000+ per day in spend

 - You can diagnose an account, not just describe it. When cost per lead moves, you know where to look first and why

title: SEO Specalist
description:
Project Overview

Our company operates on an innovative, agile "pod" structure. Each pod is a self-contained digital media and technology team capable of executing projects across software development, video production, and marketing.

We are seeking a highly analytical and results-driven SEO Specialist to join our team. In this role, you will be the search engine authority within your pod, responsible for driving organic traffic, ranking growth, and technical health for both our diverse client websites and our own internal Atsap brand accounts.

You will work closely with our Pod Leads and Tech Leads to align content creation with deep keyword strategy, clean technical performance, and robust link ecosystems. This is a part-time, ongoing hourly position with room to scale as our portfolio of accounts expands.

Scope of Work & Deliverables

As our SEO Specialist, you will manage end-to-end organic search performance, including:

Keyword & Topic Research: Discover, evaluate, and map high-intent search queries for new content planning and metadata optimizations.

On-Page Optimization: Revamp and perfect title tags, meta descriptions, header structures, image alt attributes, and internal linking structures across target pages.

Technical SEO Audits: Run regular site crawls to identify indexing errors, broken redirects, slow page speeds, mobile-friendliness issues, and duplicate content problems.

Collaboration on Technical Fixes: Work in tandem with the pod's Tech Lead to implement schema markup (structured data), clean up sitemaps, and fix complex technical search issues.

Content Optimization Strategy: Audit existing site content, identifying gaps and providing structured content briefs for creators and designers to target featured snippets and rank higher.

Off-Page & Authority Building: Guide off-page strategies, monitor backlinks, perform competitor profile analyses, and assist with outreach opportunities.

Performance Reporting: Monitor search performance, rankings, and conversions using Google Search Console, GA4, and key tool suites. Update data regularly so Pod Leads can present up-to-date success metrics on client dashboards.

Day-to-Day Activities

Checking in with the Pod Lead to align priorities, review content briefs, and report search milestone achievements.

Auditing specific client or internal Atsap landing pages using industry-standard SEO platforms (SEMrush, Ahrefs, Moz, etc.).

Documenting clear technical SEO tickets for our Tech Lead to execute backend or site architecture adjustments.

Writing search-optimized meta tags, headers, and optimization instructions for new blog content or product pages.

Accessing CMS platforms (such as WordPress, Wix, etc.) to apply on-page optimizations directly.

Reviewing keyword positioning shifts and Google Search Console index status reports.

Organizing search research into clean client deliverables and keeping project progress updated in our project management system.

Who You Are & Desired Experience

SEO Tool Proficient: You are highly experienced with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, and Google Analytics 4 (GA4).

CMS Confident: You have direct, hands-on experience optimizing websites hosted on WordPress, Wix, and other modern web development stacks.

Analytical & Data-Driven: You don't just export reports—you analyze the underlying data to figure out why traffic changed and what strategy is needed next.

An Excellent Communicator: You can explain complex search metrics (like crawl budget, domain authority, and structured data) to client stakeholders in simple, commercial terms.

Proactive Collaborator: You thrive working alongside writers, designers, and developers to build beautiful, highly-searchable web experiences.

title: Full-Time Remote Editor
description:
Skilled CapCut / TikTok Editor (Clone + Green Screen Content) — PH Time Zone



Looking for a skilled short-form editor to produce TikTok videos for a high-performing page. This is not basic talking-head trimming. A large share of the work is multi-clone videos and green-screen edits that need precise compositing, timing, and audio.



You can use CapCut or another editor you are fast and accurate in.



What the work actually involves

Many videos require real editing skill and close attention to detail, including:

- Clone videos: background removal, placing multiple clones on one background, even spacing, and natural conversation timing so clones do not talk over each other or leave awkward gaps

- Green-screen videos: clean keying, background removal, and accurate image/asset placement

- Selecting the strongest take for each line or clone

- Audio overlays so cuts between clips have no pops, hard cuts, or dead air

- Dynamic zooms, crops, and on-screen text (including sizing/callout text as in the reference videos)

- Clean talking-head assembly when a video is simpler



Please review a few examples of my content so you know the style before applying:



1. Talking head with overlays — tight cuts plus images placed on screen to support what is being said.


 



2. Clone video — multiple versions of the same person on one background. Needs clean background removal, even clone placement/spacing, and dialogue timed like a real conversation (no talking over each other, no awkward pauses).


  



3. Green screen video — clean keying, background removal, and accurate image/background placement so the subject sits naturally in the scene.


 



You will work directly with me on a page that already gets strong reach. On-time delivery and videos that perform can earn bonuses, with room to grow hours and pay.



Requirements

- Proven skill with short-form editing (portfolio or sample required)

- Clean background removal / keying and multi-layer clone placement

- Strong English (you will judge takes and conversation flow)

- Stable, fast internet

- Experience with CapCut and/or TikTok

- Comfortable taking notes and revising quickly

- Available **6–8 hours per day, 6 days per week** (PH or similar time zone)

- Paid via Wise



Pay

$1,000 USD per month for 6–8 hours/day, 6 days/week, plus bonuses for meeting deadlines and strong video performance. Strong long-term fit can move toward higher pay.



To apply

Complete the paid-style test below so I can see your actual skill.



Reference video: 
 

Video Task:


 



Full steps:

- Open the Drive folder and download the Video Task.

- Import the footage into your editor. The audio effect you need is in that same folder.

- Opening section (three-clone sequence):

- Remove the background from the raw takes.

- Choose the best take of each clone.

- Place all three clones on the provided background that can be found in the beginning of the Video Task. 

- Scale and space them so all three fit fully in frame with even gaps, no cut-off heads or feet, and the same ground line as the reference. Do not guess a formula — match the reference.

- Right at the start, place a different country flag on each clone for a short beat, matching the reference for size, position, and timing.

- Time the dialogue so it plays as one natural conversation — no overlapping speech and no awkward pauses.

- Use the audio effect from the folder to censor the word in this section, timed like the reference.

- Add zoom in / zoom out as shown in the reference video.



Remainder of the video:

- Pick the best takes.

- Add zoom in / zoom out where it helps.

- Add text on clips related to sizing, matching the reference.

- Across the whole video, use audio overlays so every transition is seamless — no pops, cuts, or dead air.

- Send me a GOOGLE DRIVE link to your finished recut.



If the test looks like the reference and the conversation between clones feels natural, we can start quickly.

title: Media Buyer — Google, Meta & Bing (LSA Certified)
description:
Mapless Marketing is a boutique, Google Partner marketing agency serving law firms and salon/beauty brands nationally. We're looking for a media buyer who genuinely loves the craft. Someone who lives inside ad platforms, tests relentlessly, and gets a thrill out of cracking a campaign that isn't converting. You'll own paid media across Google, Meta, and Bing for a portfolio of client accounts across different industries, including managing our Google Local Services Ads program and helping maintain our Google Partner standing.



This is a fast-moving, hands-on role. Some of our clients can't run ads the traditional way due to industry/website restrictions, so we need someone who can think creatively around those limits and still drive lead flow. You'll work directly with our team, need to be comfortable making fast decisions, and should be excited by variety rather than needing a rigid playbook.



Duties & Responsibilities

- Manage and optimize Google Local Services Ads (LSA) for lead generation clients.

- Run structured A/B tests on creative, copy, targeting, and landing pages, and report clearly on what's working and why.

- Maintain and support our Google Partner agency status through account performance and best practices.

- Develop creative, non-traditional ad strategies for regulated or restricted industries (e.g., legal) where standard ad approaches aren't allowed.

- Monitor budgets, pacing, and performance daily; make fast adjustments as needed.

- Communicate directly and proactively with the internal team on account status, wins, and problems



Requirements

- 2+ years of hands-on experience running paid ads on Google, Meta, and Microsoft/Bing.

- Demonstrated experience with Google Local Services Ads (LSA) setup and optimization.

- Strong understanding of A/B testing methodology (not just running two ads and guessing).

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, fluid agency environment with shifting priorities.

- Available to work core US business hours.

- Excellent written and spoken English; able to communicate directly and clearly.

- Reliable internet.

- Portfolio or case studies showing measurable lead-flow or conversion results.

- Experience with GA4, Google Tags, etc.



Send us a video to 
 answering these four questions: Walk us through one A/B test you ran. What did you test, what did the data show, and what did you change because of it? Tell us about a time you had to advertise for a business that couldn't run traditional ads. What did you do instead? You're managing 8+ live accounts at once. How do you decide where to spend your time each day? What's your experience with Google Local Services Ads specifically?
